jobs.description:
Job Description:

JOB SUMMARY

This position is responsible for implementing Vertex’s Cloud and On-Premise products with host applications such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, and other strategic partner applications, as well as implementing Vertex tax technology solutions.

The role focuses on delivering consulting services and project deliverables that support the deployment of Vertex tax technology products. It requires knowledge of Vertex products and familiarity with how Vertex applications integrate with host applications. The position may also require the ability to identify and deliver tax process solutions and other value-added services that contribute to Vertex’s revenue and profitability objectives.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with experienced Senior Consultants on implementation projects while executing against client Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Continually develop knowledge of consulting methodologies and the Vertex market and ecosystem through the delivery of consulting services and participation in formal and informal learning opportunities.
  • Continue developing consulting, industry, and project implementation knowledge while taking guidance from senior Vertex Consultants and contributing to projects as needed.
  • Participate in all phases of Vertex software implementations while adhering to Vertex best-practice methodology.
  • Assist with all phases of Vertex projects, including reviewing and analyzing client requirements, solution design and build, testing, and providing client support as needed.
  • Conduct solution design, Vertex application configuration, and solution documentation to support successful implementations.
  • Exercise sound judgment in managing day-to-day client relationships and expectations.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer satisfaction throughout project engagements.
  • When appropriate, assist Consulting Business Development with the development of Statements of Work.
  • Assist with the training and development of new team members as needed.
  • Participate in other projects and perform additional duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of implementation and consulting practices, customer service, and vendor practices.
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies and implementation and testing techniques appropriate for Windows, legacy, and/or client-server database applications.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, work effectively in a team environment, and remain responsive to project and customer needs.
  • Ability to adapt and function effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment while working under deadlines.
  • Solid analytical, presentation, troubleshooting, and solution-design skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • ERP knowledge is a plus.
  • Ability to maintain expected attendance at work.
  • Effective time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage job-related and personal stress effectively.
  • Knowledge and understanding of Vertex’s business, industry, and marketplace.
  • Willingness to work overtime, holidays, and weekends based on business needs.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Four or more years of experience in a corporate environment through internships and/or professional work experience.
  • Prior experience involving client or customer interaction is a plus.
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Pay Transparency Statement:

Annual Salary Range: ₹1,016,400.00 - ₹1,321,320.00

Pay Basis: Monthly

The posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for successful candidates at the time of hire, based on relevant job‑related skills, experience, geographic location, and business needs. Base pay offered to new hires may vary within the posted range depending on individual qualifications and market considerations.


The posted salary range reflects compensation at the time of hire. Employees may experience additional compensation growth over time through performance‑based increases, expanded responsibilities, role progression, or internal career opportunities, in accordance with company policies and local practices.

jobs.excerpt: Introduction Circit is a fast growing B2B SaaS company that is on a mission to make business verifiable in real-time.
jobs.description:
Introduction

Circit is a fast growing B2B SaaS company that is on a mission to make business verifiable in real-time. We are creating a global asset verification platform that allows auditors to deliver higher quality financial audits and spend more time helping businesses to create greater value for all economic stakeholders. Our current customer base includes big four accountancy firms as well as global banks.

We are looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager to help us drive adoption, retention and growth across our customer accounts in the US market, and build strong relationships within these key customer networks.

You will own a portfolio of accounts, ensuring customers get lasting value from Circit, renew on time, and continue to grow with us. This is our second US Customer Success hire, and you will work closely with the existing team to build out our US customer success function.

Role and Responsibilities

In this role you will

  • Own the customer relationship end to end, driving product adoption, retention and long-term value across your account portfolio
  • Manage renewals across your portfolio, ensuring contracts renew on time and proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk
  • Plan and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers at C-suite and senior stakeholder level
  • Build strong relationships with customer networks, identifying key decision makers and stakeholders, and developing account plans to deepen engagement
  • Train your customers: develop a deep understanding of our product to deliver onboarding, demos and ongoing training across all features to existing customers and new stakeholders within those accounts
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including new teams, regions, or use cases, and work with the wider commercial team to progress them
  • Manage customers on a proactive basis throughout the customer journey, including pilots, onboarding, adoption, annual contracts and renewals, ensuring their satisfaction with and adoption of the product
  • Monitor and improve the health of all existing accounts, ensuring maintenance of key KPIs and objectives
  • Be available for onsite visits with customers across the USA
  • Develop customer training materials and collateral with support from the marketing team, tailored for the US market
  • Pioneer Circit rollout within the US and help drive the formation of an SOP playbook for the USA market
  • Maintain accurate account records and renewal forecasting in the CRM

Key Performance Indicators

Your performance will be measured against:

  • On-time renewals
  • Customer retention
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

Requirements

You must be ready to work in a fast paced, high growth environment, with a large amount of flexibility required.

  • 3–5 years’ experience in Customer Success, ideally within a fintech or B2B SaaS subscription-based product environment
  • Experience working with auditors or financial institutions is a bonus
  • Exceptional communication and relationship building skills, with the confidence to engage and run QBRs at C-suite level
  • Proven ability to drive customer adoption, retention and growth across an existing portfolio, including managing renewals
  • Experience delivering customer training and product demos
  • Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot experience – bonus) and Microsoft Office suite
  • Willingness and ability to travel across the USA for onsite customer visits

This role is remote, and we are open to applicants based in the United States – East coast preferred. Regular travel across the USA for onsite customer visits is expected.

Benefits

This is an exciting opportunity for an all-rounder, highly motivated candidate to get involved at the ground level of a fast-growing company. We’re committed to making sure our employees are well-treated. If there’s something that’s important to you that’s not on the list, talk to us.

  • Competitive salary;
  • A small team with a friendly environment that promotes autonomy for you to self-manage your time;
  • Flexible working hours;
  • Great opportunity for career progression with hands on experience;
  • Freedom of expression is encouraged.

jobs.title: People Operations & AI Transformation Architect
jobs.excerpt: What You'll Do Avalara makes tax compliance faster, easier, more accurate, and more reliable for businesses.
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara makes tax compliance faster, easier, more accurate, and more reliable for businesses. We're now applying that same standard to how we run our own People & Culture (P&C) function, Avalara's term for Human Resources. A new internal team, AI Transformation & Operational Excellence, has been created to redesign how P&C delivers services to employees, managers, and the business, using AI and automation as core tools rather than afterthoughts. This team's mandate is to rebuild P&C's processes and technology from the ground up: not just make today's processes faster, but decide, process by process, what should be fully automated, what should be enhanced with AI, and what should remain human-led. This role owns that end to end: you dig into how a process actually works today, document it clearly, decide what belongs on each side of that automate / augment / human line, and then build or oversee the build of the solution, partnering closely with Avalara's People Technology (engineering) team where needed. This role calls for someone who has genuinely done architecture work for process before: not just documented how something works today, but designed what it should become, end to end. Paired with deep, hands-on AI fluency: the ability to dig into a messy, real-world process, understand it fully, document it clearly, and see exactly where AI can fully automate a step, where it should augment a person doing the work, and where the work should stay human, and then design for it. The impact of this role is to completely reimagine how People & Culture's processes work: building a genuinely strong operating model underneath P&C, and envisioning what the experience should be for each persona who touches it, including employees, people managers, candidates, the business, and P&C itself. This role owns the process architecture, the operating model, and the vision for each solution. From there, the actual AI tool build can go either way: hand it to the People Technology (engineering) team to build, or build it yourself, including building AI agents directly, depending on the complexity of the tool and where capacity sits at the time. You'll operate with significant autonomy on ambiguous, cross-functional problems, and be a trusted partner to P&C leadership and to Avalara's People Technology (engineering) leadership alike.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Dig Into & Document Current State
  • Get into the details of how a process actually works today, not just what's documented, through direct observation, data review, and conversations with the people doing the work.
  • Build clear, step-by-step process maps and a prioritized list of pain points and gaps that others can act on.
  • Gather baseline data on existing processes, such as cycle time, volume, and error rates, to ground redesign decisions in evidence, not assumptions.
Envision the Future Experience by Persona
  • Reimagine what the process should look and feel like for each persona it touches (employee, people manager, candidate, business, and P&C itself), rather than incrementally improving the current experience.
  • Turn that persona-based vision into a clear target state: what changes for the person going through it, and what has to be true of the process and technology to deliver it.
  • Use that target-state vision as the basis for the automate, augment, or human-led decisions that follow.
Decide What's Automated, Augmented, or Human
  • For each step of a process, make the call: fully automate with AI, augment a person with AI, or keep it human-led, and be able to explain why.
  • Translate that judgment into concrete technical requirements and specifications an engineering team can build against.
  • Assess build-vs-buy for each opportunity: build in-house, buy a vendor solution, or integrate with an existing platform (e.g., Workday), and sequence the work into phases that deliver value quickly.
Design & Build the Solution
  • Design the target-state solution architecture for each process, not just the requirements, but how the pieces fit together, and decide whether to hand the AI tool build to People Technology or build it yourself, based on complexity and where capacity sits.
  • Where you build it yourself, build the AI agents and automations directly. Where People Technology builds it, partner closely with their engineers on requirements, testing, and QA throughout.
  • Identify upstream and downstream impacts on other processes, systems, and teams before committing to a build.
Own the Operating Model & Roadmap
  • Own and maintain the AI & automation roadmap for the processes you're responsible for, aligning priorities with P&C leadership and People Technology.
  • Build a strong, durable operating model underneath each redesigned process: one that holds up after the initial build, not just at launch.
  • Build ROI models and success measures for each tool or automation, track performance against them, and recommend retiring what isn't delivering.
Support Agent Governance & Org Design
  • Partner with P&C leadership to determine where each AI agent “reports into” within the P&C org structure: which team is accountable for its use, oversight, and outcomes.
  • Help define how to assess an agent's performance much like you would an employee's, with clear ownership, accountability, and performance criteria.
  • Maintain a current map of every agent and automation in production, its owning team, and its performance status.

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Demonstrated experience doing architecture work for process: designing a target-state process and operating model end to end, not just mapping how something works today.
  • Strong process aptitude: you can take a messy, real-world process, dig into how it actually works, and turn it into a clear, documented, step-by-step map.
  • Deep, hands-on AI experience: not just familiarity with generative AI features, but real experience building or deploying AI agents and automations in a live operational environment.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI specifically: building multi-step, tool-using AI agents, working with prompt design and LLM orchestration, and applying that to real business processes rather than isolated experiments.
  • Demonstrated judgment for deciding what should be fully automated, AI-augmented, or kept human-led, and designing for each accordingly.
  • Comfort owning both ends of the build decision: building an AI agent or automation yourself when that's the right call, and handing off a clear, buildable spec to an engineering team when it isn't.
  • Direct experience with build-vs-buy decisions for software or AI tools, including evaluating vendor solutions against custom builds.
  • Experience partnering with software engineers through implementation: testing, deploying, and iterating, not just handing off a spec.
  • Experience sequencing large initiatives into phases that deliver value quickly and can be adjusted along the way.
  • Strong communication skills: credible with engineers, understandable to business and operations stakeholders.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in HR, People Operations, or a comparable operations function (recruiting, employee lifecycle, service delivery). Helpful context, not a prerequisite.
  • Hands-on Workday experience (configuration, reporting, or implementation).
  • Background in solutions architecture, technical product management, or a similar hybrid business/technical role.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or RPA tools beyond agentic AI.
  • Experience defining org structure or governance models for AI agents or automated systems.
Pay Range DetailsThe base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may different in other locations. Colorado $153,300-$252,900 (annually)Washington $153,300-$279,600 (annually)California $153,300-$306,300 (annually)NYC $169,400-$306,300 (annually) The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business consideration This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Scientist, FinCrime
jobs.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

About our Machine Learning FinCrime Team:

Our Financial Crime Data team consists of over 25 people across 4 data specialisms: Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Machine Learning Scientists and Data Scientists. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be working in a fast moving environment, building and iterating on our financial crime defensive capabilities to ensure we keep Monzo and our customers safe.

Our financial crime team has a large impact on Monzo’s bottom line as fraud and scams are usually some of the largest cost line items in a bank's P&L. We have a major influence on the overall customer experience and it’s our duty to keep our customers safe. The work we do results in directly measurable customer or company benefit, which is incredibly satisfying.

Our Machine Learning Scientists work on a range of problems within the different financial crime areas ranging from fraud detection and prevention, transaction monitoring for different types of suspicious activity through to customer risk assessment and operational tooling.

What you’ll be working on:

A Lead Machine Learning Scientist at Monzo is a technical Individual Contributor (IC) leadership position. As a technical Machine Learning expert, working with billions of rows of data stored on a modern cloud native data platform, we’ll be expecting you to leverage your deep experience of developing and deploying advanced Machine Learning models to:

  • Automatically and accurately detect suspicious user behaviours while minimising impact to genuine customers and operational costs
  • Adapt quickly and appropriately to changing fraud and financial crime trends, ensuring our detection systems remain performant through time.

The technical approaches you take to help solve these problems will be very much in your hands and we’ll strongly encourage and support experimentation and innovation. We’ll be expecting you to justify and demonstrate effectiveness along the way, making sure the approach meets our business and customer needs.

Your day-to-day:

As a technical individual contributor, you’ll be providing technical leadership and shipping highly impactful ML-based solutions. You’ll be embedded in a cross functional product squad, working closely with product managers, data scientists, backend engineers and designers in an agile environment. You’ll also be a technical leader within the Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.

This will involve:

  • Working with stakeholders across the organization to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to tackle Financial Crime and Fraud with Machine Learning.
  • Leading the design and development of advanced real time Machine Learning models, for example exploring how neural network, graph-based, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in detection of financial crime.
  • Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.
  • Working closely with our MLOps team to steer the ongoing development of tools to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company
  • You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact
  • You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production
  • You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so
  • Reducing financial crime and protecting customers with data driven strategies sounds exciting to you
  • You have extensive experience writing production Python code and a strong command of SQL. You are comfortable using them every day, and keen to learn Go lang which is used in many of our backend microservices
  • You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity
  • You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain
  • You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with financial crime and in regulated institutions
  • Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices

The interview process:

Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

30 minute recruiter call

45 minute call with hiring manager

Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on . Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

What’s in it for you:

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

Explore our organization's core competencies in greater detail here.

EdReports exists to improve teaching and learning. Our independent reviews and resources help educators and leaders make better decisions about the materials they select and how they use them. But our work only makes a difference if the right people know about it and put it to use.

The Lead, Growth Marketing helps make that happen. By developing and executing data-informed marketing strategies, the Lead works to expand EdReports’ reach and influence, deepen engagement with priority audiences, and increase meaningful use of our products and guidance. This hands-on role combines strategic marketing expertise with strong digital execution, including paid advertising, email, social media, and integrated campaigns. Partnering with colleagues across MarComms and Product, the Lead brings fresh thinking, experimentation, and modern marketing practices to advance EdReports’ mission and impact.

Location: Pune, India (Offshore)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Consultant to provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle GRC solutions deployed in Oracle Fusion Cloud environments. The role focuses on application security, Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls, access governance, compliance monitoring, audit support, and continuous improvement within a global support model.

Job Description

The consultant will manage production support, administration, and enhancement activities for Oracle GRC applications. The role involves resolving application issues, managing security access, conducting SoD assessments, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

The position also requires coordination with business, security, and Oracle Support teams to manage incidents, support quarterly patch testing, maintain documentation, and improve operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle GRC applications and related security processes.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and application issues within agreed SLAs.
  • Support Oracle GRC modules, including Advanced Access Controls (AAC), Transaction Controls Governor (TCG), Preventive Controls Advisor (PCA), Risk Management Cloud, and Access Certification.
  • Conduct user access reviews, role analysis, SoD conflict assessments, and mitigation activities.
  • Manage security roles, privileges, provisioning, and deprovisioning within Oracle Fusion.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with Oracle Support, manage service requests, and support quarterly patch testing and release activities.
  • Maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, and support runbooks while assisting with audits and SOX compliance.

Required Skills

  • Oracle GRC – Production Support and Administration.
  • L2/L3 Application Support.
  • Oracle Fusion Cloud Security and Access Governance.
  • Segregation of Duties (SoD) Controls and Risk Management.
  • User Access Reviews and Role Analysis.
  • Incident Management, SLA Management, and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Audit Support and SOX Compliance.
  • Oracle Patch Testing and Release Management.

Mandatory Skills

  • Oracle EBS – Finance

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 5–7 years of relevant experience in Oracle GRC support and administration, with a strong understanding of application security, access governance, and compliance controls. The candidate should be comfortable handling L2/L3 production support, coordinating with global stakeholders, and supporting audit and compliance activities.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients.

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together.     Field Operations

  • Drive adoption of the core field tech stack (Salesforce, sales engagement, Gong, deal registration, and content tools), working with the Salesforce Admin on the workflow and process changes that go-to-market (GTM) strategy, product launches, and pricing updates require.

jobs.excerpt: Fractional Head of Growth (Contractor Role) 📆 Contractor role, 3.
jobs.description:
Fractional Head of Growth (Contractor Role)

📆 Contractor role, 3.5 days per week for 3-6 months

🌍 UK, Remote

💰 £500 per day

Why Hertility? 🚀

Hertility was born out of a need for preventative, personalised and dedicated expert healthcare across a woman’s hormonal lifespan. Hertility’s at-home diagnostic testing, telemedicine, treatments, prescriptions and clinical services provide advanced insights into reproductive health, fertility decline and the onset of menopause, as well as the diagnosis of 18 conditions. Hertility reduces diagnosis times for some conditions from nine years to six days.

Having done over 29 clinical studies, published in leading scientific journals and presented at over 25 national and international scientific and clinical conferences, Hertility is committed to expanding its research and clinical programmes, deepening our understanding of reproductive health and influencing policy.

By setting a new standard of scientific rigour and education in women’s health, we’re nurturing the Mother of all Movements: one powered by a new generation of women backing themselves, their bodies and their life choices, from menstruation through to menopause.

Why You’ll Love This Role 💖

As our Fractional Head of Growth, you’ll take full ownership of our direct-to-consumer (DTC) growth plan for the next 3-6 months, with one clear goal: driving revenue. Our growth function has been through a leadership transition and we need someone who has done this before: who lands quickly, works out what’s really going on in the numbers, builds a funded plan and then runs the business against it every week.

This is a senior, hands on role. You’ll set the plan and the budget, make the calls on where money goes and be close enough to the channels to fix things yourself. Your main focus is restoring first-time customer acquisition at a sustainable cost per customer. If you bring energy, tenacity and a real passion for women’s health, this role is for you!

What You’ll Deliver 🚀

In your first 2 weeks

  • A rapid full-funnel diagnostic covering demand, brand, acquisition, conversion, retention and unit economics.

  • A funded acquisition plan for the next 4-6 months, with monthly revenue and first-time customer targets linked to channel budgets, expected cost per customer and forecast sales, agreed with Finance.

  • A weekly actual-versus-plan scorecard and review running, with a named owner for every channel.

By day 30

  • Paid search stabilised, with budget moved towards the campaigns that deliver incremental sales.

  • A recovery plan for our affiliate programme, with clear agency accountability and sales targets.

  • A clear decision on our paid social investment split, based on downstream purchases rather than top-of-funnel actions.

  • One agreed source of truth for channel attribution and cost per customer, used in every report.

  • A clear joined up Growth strategy across Brand, CRM and Marketing to scale through and beyond the 6 month period

By the end of the contract

  • First-time customer acquisition back on a growing trajectory against the plan.

  • A go-to-market plan delivered for each priority product.

  • A documented growth operating rhythm and a recommendation and spec for the permanent growth leadership role.

What You’ll Own 🌟

  • The plan and the forecast: Own the DTC revenue and customer acquisition forecast and the direct marketing budget, and reconcile both with Finance every month.

  • Paid acquisition: Lead strategy and budget allocation across Google, Meta and affiliates, managing our specialist consultants and agency partners to clear targets.

  • Product marketing: Build go-to-market plans for our core test range and new launches, covering audience, message, channel budget, landing page, CRM journey and unit forecast.

  • Measurement: Work with our Data and Engineering teams to make channel performance measurable, from tracking and attribution through to cohort analysis from first visit to purchase.

  • Experimentation: Run a focused testing programme across channels, creative, offers and landing pages, judged on purchases and cost per customer.

  • Reporting: A weekly update to the Founders and a monthly performance report.

  • You’ll also connect growth with the teams you don’t directly manage. Brand and CRM are separate functions, so you’ll need to bring brand, product marketing, acquisition and CRM together into one customer journey.

  • All team members are required to work in alignment with Hertility’s Quality Management System and ensure their activities support compliance with ISO 13485 (Medical Devices) and ISO 27001 (ISMS), including following controlled processes, maintaining accurate records and participating in required training.

What We’re Looking For 🎯

You’ll thrive if you bring energy, tenacity and a real passion for women’s health, plus:

⚡ Energy & Drive: You bring pace and enthusiasm to everything you do and lift the people around you.

💪 Tenacity: You don’t give up when a channel underperforms or a test fails - you dig in, learn fast and go again.

💛 Passion for Women’s Health: You care deeply about reproductive and hormonal health and want to be part of Hertility’s mission.

📜 Relevant Experience: 8+ years in DTC growth, including leading the function, ideally in health, wellness or subscription.

📊 Commercial & Financial Planning: You build channel budget models and forecasts and you’re confident owning revenue, cost per customer, LTV and payback.

🛠️ Hands-On Channel Depth: Strong in Google Ads and Meta, plus experience growing affiliate programmes.

📈 Measurement Know-How: GA4, cookie consent and its impact on data, attribution tools and incrementality testing. You know when the data can be trusted and how to make decisions when it can’t.

🤝 Agency Management: Experience managing agencies and contractors to clear deliverables and accountability.

⚖️ Regulated Health Advertising: Experience with platform health-advertiser restrictions and ASA/CAP codes.

🧭 Calm, Structured Leadership: You bring clarity to a team that has been without a plan and influence people who don’t report to you.

Nice to have:

🔍 SEO & GEO: Experience with SEO and generative engine optimisation for buying-intent search.

💬 CRM & Attribution Platforms: Experience with CRM and lifecycle platforms (we use Braze).

Your Team 💪🏼

You’ll report directly to our COO, Dr Natalie Getreu. You’ll work with our in-house growth marketer, our paid social, our Brand, CRM, Product, Data, Engineering and Finance teams and the Founders.

Our Culture & Values 🌈At Hertility, we’re all about ovary-acting with purpose! We believe in a world where every womb has access to the healthcare it needs. We’re bold, focused, dependable and proud - lifting each other up, working with heart and staying true to our mission.💪

Flexibility in this Role

We are looking for someone to work with us 3.5 days per week for a 3-6 month contract. Our operating hours are between 9am and 6pm from Monday to Friday.

Ready to Apply? 📅

  • Rolling applications: We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and want someone to start as soon as possible. Please tell us your earliest start date and availability when you apply.

Interview Process:

  1. Initial Phone Interview

    A 15 minute conversation with a member of our Talent Team to get to know you better and answer any initial questions.

  2. Case Study and Discussion

    We’ll share an anonymised snapshot of our DTC performance and ask you to talk us through your diagnosis and your first 30 day plan with Tulsi Patel (Director of Product and Technology), Joleen Stermann (Growth Marketing Hacker) and Melanie Nordman (Head of CRM).

  3. Final Interview

    A 30-minute conversation with Dr Natalie Getreu (Co-Founder and COO) and Charlotte Armitage (Finance Director), focused on commercial planning and how you’d work with the leadership team.

  • Start Date:As soon as possible

If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s redefining women’s health, apply now! We can’t wait to meet you. 🎉

🌍 We’re Here to Support You

At Hertility, we want every candidate to feel comfortable and confident throughout the hiring process 💛. If you need any adjustments, whether that’s interview timings, communication preferences or accessibility support, just drop us a line. Let us know how we can help! 😊

🤝 Diversity & Inclusion

Just like the diversity in every cell, Hertility thrives on a range of perspectives and experiences. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrate the unique contributions each team member brings to our work.

Are you an experienced forestry auditor who enjoys combining technical certification work with building strong client relationships? Do you want to help forest managers and companies across Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region strengthen responsible forestry practices? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What you can expect:

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry Specialist based in Indonesia to manage, audit and administer our forestry certification and verification services in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region. Working with internationally recognised standards such as FSC Forest Management, FSC and PEFC Chain of Custody, SBP and Preferred by Nature’s own certification, you will lead audits, review the work of other auditors, manage a client portfolio and drive sales and market development. As one of the faces of Preferred by Nature in the region, you will play a key role in growing our forestry portfolio while keeping the quality of our audits high.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

  • Conduct forestry certification and verification audits for assigned clients, including on-site visits, remote evaluations and report writing within agreed timeframes and quality requirements.

  • Act as task manager for your client portfolio, covering client support, audit budgeting, planning and scheduling, and keeping certification and verification records up to date.

  • Carry out quality reviews of audit reports, including technical review and certification or verification decisions within your qualifications.

  • Lead sales processes with potential clients, from presentations and scoping to preparing service proposals.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, providing excellent customer service together with the Asia Pacific team.

  • Support the development of the forestry certification market in Indonesia and across the region.

  • Ensure efficiency, quality control and adherence to Preferred by Nature’s operational, certification and verification protocols.

Your first year with us:

Within three months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature’s forestry certification and verification services, internal systems and procedures.

  • Get to know your assigned client portfolio in Indonesia and establish working relationships with the Asia Pacific team.

  • Begin conducting audits and task management for assigned clients, and start the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

  • Independently lead audits and manage your client portfolio, from planning and budgeting through to reporting.

  • Prepare service proposals and take part in client presentations and sales meetings with potential clients.

  • Progress towards quality reviewer qualifications for the key standards in your portfolio.

Within twelve months, you will:

  • Hold qualifications as auditor, quality reviewer and task manager for your assigned forestry schemes.

  • Manage a stable and growing client portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.

  • Contribute actively to market development, identifying and following up on new business opportunities in Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region.

Important that you:

  • Hold a bachelor’s degree in forestry, natural resource management, environmental science or a related field.

  • Bring at least four years of relevant experience in the forestry industry, a certification body, an NGO or another international organisation.

  • Are qualified as an auditor under FSC Forest Management, FSC Chain of Custody, PEFC Chain of Custody and/or SBP.

  • Are fluent in written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia.

  • Have good communication and client management skills, and feel confident presenting to clients and preparing proposals.

  • Possess strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Have strong self-management skills, with the ability to stay focused and follow through on commitments.

  • Are comfortable travelling within Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region for on-site audits.

  • Are proficient in MS Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

  • Have experience as a quality reviewer or task manager in a certification body.

  • Bring experience in sales or business development within a certification or consulting environment.

  • Have worked in an international, multicultural team.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Global work culture

  • High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.

  • An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

  • Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

  • Potential future international travel opportunities

  • A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment

  • 20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. With 350+ employees and a network of local experts, we develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains in 100+ countries. We focus on forest and climate impact commodities and related sectors.

Application pre-screening will be conducted during the application period. Preferred by Nature wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

NorthStar Care is a next-generation, virtual treatment program for Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) and Substance Use Disorder (SUD), grounded in science, technology, and deep compassion. Our program combines genetically-informed medical care, nutrient restoration, virtual reality–based peer support, and long-term wraparound treatment. We meet patients where they are - with evidence-based tools, stigma-free language, and a care model designed to restore health, dignity, and hope.

We are a multidisciplinary team of physicians, peer guides, therapists, data scientists, designers, engineers, and professionals - all working toward one mission: to revolutionize addiction care and make recovery accessible, humane, and effective.

Role Overview

NorthStar is seeking a Production Designer to join our creative team on a temp-to-hire basis. This person will turn concepts into polished, on-brand assets quickly and accurately across clinical, marketing, and digital channels, and will play a leading role in how our team uses AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT in everyday creative production.

This role blends hands-on production design with advanced, practical AI fluency. You will not only use AI to work faster. You will help build the prompts, workflows, and standards that make AI reliable, on-brand, and compliant across our team.

This is an ideal role for a designer who is:

  • Passionate about mission-driven work
  • A daily, hands-on user of both Claude and ChatGPT who understands what each one does best
  • Fast, precise, and organized in a high-volume production environment
  • Excited to experiment with new tools and share what they learn
  • Comfortable working in a highly collaborative, compassionate environment

Key Responsibilities

Production Design

  • Produce high-quality, on-brand assets for social media, email, paid campaigns, web, presentations, print, and employer/payer-facing materials.
  • Resize, adapt, and version creative across platforms, formats, and audiences quickly and accurately.
  • Prepare final, production-ready files for print vendors, web, and digital partners.
  • Maintain organized asset libraries, templates, file naming, and version control.
  • Uphold NorthStar's brand pillars of compassion, clarity, and scientific integrity in every deliverable.

AI-Powered Creative Workflows

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT daily to speed up production, including drafting copy variations, building creative briefs, exploring layout and concept options, checking work against brand standards, and solving technical problems.
  • Write, test, and refine prompts that produce consistent, high-quality, on-brand results, using techniques such as clear context, audience framing, examples, constraints, and structured outputs.
  • Know when to use Claude, when to use ChatGPT, and when a task needs a human, and help the team make those choices.

jobs.description:
REALADVISOR CHEGOU A PORTUGAL
Business Development Representative - Mercado Português | Freelancer / Trabalhador Independente
Ajude-nos a construir e a desenvolver o mercado português

A RealAdvisor é uma das principais plataformas digitais do setor imobiliário na Europa. É uma empresa internacional PropTech, fundada na Suíça, que utiliza dados, transparência e tecnologia para ajudar os profissionais do imobiliário a fazer crescer os seus negócios.
Fundada na Suíça, a empresa trabalha atualmente com mais de 5.000 agências imobiliárias e atrai mais de 10 milhões de utilizadores por ano em vários mercados europeus.
Após o sucesso da RealAdvisor na Suíça, Itália, França, Espanha e Polónia, estamos agora a lançar o mercado português.
Portugal é um mercado totalmente novo para a RealAdvisor. Isto significa que estamos numa fase inicial de desenvolvimento, o que cria oportunidades significativas para profissionais de vendas ambiciosos que queiram entrar desde o início, ajudar a construir o mercado e crescer com a empresa.
Não irá apenas gerir um mercado já estabelecido - terá a oportunidade de ajudar a construí-lo e a moldá-lo de raiz.

A FUNÇÃO

Como Sales / Business Development Representative, será responsável por desenvolver o mercado português e apresentar a solução da RealAdvisor aos profissionais do setor imobiliário.
As suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Identificar e contactar novos clientes através de prospeção ativa (outbound).
  • Realizar chamadas (cold calls) e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Acompanhar leads e oportunidades inbound geradas pela equipa de SDR.
  • Organizar e conduzir demonstrações de vendas por videoconferência.
  • Apresentar a solução RealAdvisor a agências e profissionais imobiliários.
  • Adaptar a abordagem comercial às necessidades de cada cliente.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos.
  • Gerir todo o pipeline de vendas, da prospeção ao fecho.
  • Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e desenvolver propostas de valor relevantes.
  • Manter previsões de vendas rigorosas e um acompanhamento comercial consistente.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Marketing e Customer Success.
  • Contribuir ativamente para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da RealAdvisor em Portugal.


TIPO DE COLABORAÇÃO
A posição é oferecida em regime de freelancer / trabalhador independente.
Deverá já ser trabalhador independente (atividade aberta) ou estar disposto a registar-se como tal, de acordo com a legislação portuguesa.

Irá receber:

  • Um mercado claramente definido.
  • Um processo de vendas estruturado e comprovado.
  • Uma base de clientes-alvo definida.
  • Apoio contínuo de uma equipa internacional.
  • Um elevado grau de autonomia na organização do seu trabalho.
  • Oportunidades reais de evolução para responsabilidades comerciais ou de gestão.
  • A possibilidade de uma colaboração de longo prazo.

Requirements

QUEM PROCURAMOS
Procuramos um profissional de vendas empreendedor, autónomo e orientado para resultados, que queira fazer parte do lançamento da RealAdvisor em Portugal.

Idealmente, terá:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B.
  • Experiência significativa em cold calling / prospeção telefónica.
  • Forte orientação para resultados e espírito competitivo.
  • Mentalidade empreendedora e grande capacidade de iniciativa.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma.
  • Excelente organização e gestão de pipeline de vendas.
  • Experiência com um CRM como Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho ou plataforma semelhante.
  • Experiência na realização de demonstrações e apresentações comerciais online.
  • Excelentes competências de comunicação, negociação e fecho.
  • Português nativo ou nível C2, com excelentes competências de comunicação profissional.
  • À vontade na comunicação com empresários e profissionais do setor imobiliário.

Experiência prévia nas seguintes áreas é uma forte vantagem:

  • Imobiliário
  • PropTech
  • SaaS
  • Produtos ou serviços digitais

Benefits

REMUNERAÇÃO
A colaboração é 100% baseada em comissões, oferecendo um potencial de ganhos significativo para profissionais ambiciosos e orientados para resultados.

  • Comissões muito competitivas.
  • Ganhos diretamente ligados ao desempenho.
  • Forte potencial de rendimento para os melhores profissionais.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver um novo mercado numa empresa internacional de PropTech em rápido crescimento.

Para se candidatar ou receber mais informações sobre a posição e o processo de recrutamento, envie-nos o seu CV.

jobs.description:
Triptease is a hotel technology company helping independent hotels and groups drive more direct bookings. We invoice customers worldwide through three regional entities, each with its own ledger and multiple currencies.

We are moving to a new finance system in December. Before then, we want our sales ledgers clean, reconciled and accurate, so we migrate good data and start the new year strong.

Working alongside the Credit Control team, you will focus primarily on collections while supporting ledger clean-up and migration readiness.

This is a role for an experienced, self-sufficient credit controller who can take ownership of a collections workload and deliver results with minimal supervision.

Key responsibilities

    • Chase overdue invoices by phone and email, prioritising the oldest and largest balances
    • Manage dunning sequences and customer correspondence activity in Upflow
    • Resolve invoice queries and disputes with Customer Success, Billing and Sales to unblock payment, within SLAs
    • Negotiate payment and maintain accurate records of contact, promises to pay and account status
    • Escalate payment plans, credit-risk concerns and high-risk accounts to the line manager
    • Carry out customer account reconciliations, matching receipts, invoices and credit notes
    • Reallocate unapplied cash, debits and credits to the correct invoices, customers and entities
    • Clear unreconciled items and receivables-related suspense balances
    • Assist in cleansing customer master data and support validation of opening AR balances for migration
    • Flag process gaps and data issues so they are fixed at source, not carried forward
    • Provide regular updates on collections, aged-debt movement, cleared items and outstanding issues.

What success looks like

    • Week 1: Up and running in Xero and Upflow; priority accounts and aged-debt exposure identified with line manager
    • Weeks 2–6: Collections underway on the oldest balances; reconciliations and reallocations progressing entity by entity; credit balances reduced.
    • Weeks 7–10+: All allocated accounts resolved, opening AR balances validated, and handover notes completed

Requirements

  • 2+ years recent Xero experience
  • 3+ years credit control experience
  • Extensive account and bank reconciliation experience
  • 3+ years credit control experience, including proactive telephone and email collections, dispute resolution, dunning workflows and escalation of high-risk accounts
  • 2+ years, recent, hands-on Xero experience, including allocations, credit notes, customer reconciliations and AR reporting
  • Extensive account and bank reconciliation experience, using Excel, Xero and other tools to match receipts to invoices, investigate variances and clear unapplied cash
  • Experience managing multi-currency AR ledgers across multiple entities
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivots and reconciliations
  • Confident chasing customers by phone and email, firmly and professionally
  • High attention to detail and a methodical approach to cleaning up historic data
  • Able to start immediately and work independently with minimal supervision.

Benefits

Why join us?

  • Be part of a fast-paced, dynamic team at the forefront of travel technology innovation.
  • Enjoy a collaborative and fun working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Competitive salary package and rewards for high performance.

We're growing: get on board fast, be part of the journey, and have a real impact on an award-winning, fast-growing company.

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

MniMed is seeking an experienced Sr. Principal Field Clinical Research Specialist to support and lead clinical research initiatives, ensuring high-quality clinical data and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. This role will collaborate cross-functionally with clinical, medical, and research teams to support study execution, site management, and overall clinical trial success. The position is fully remote and open to candidates anywhere in the United States, with travel required as needed to support clinical study activities. We’re looking for a seasoned clinical research professional with strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

A key member of the team to lead the technical aspects of New Venture programs. In this exciting role as a Field Clinical Research Specialist, you will have responsibility for providing technical diabetes leadership to the Centers of Excellence and cross-functional New Venture programs.

DIABETES

Transforming diabetes care together, for greater freedom and better health. Our strategy is to become a holistic diabetes management company focused on making a real difference in outcomes and cost. We want to transform healthcare toward value-based models by driving both product and business model innovation with the goal of elevating patient experience, improving clinical outcomes and lowering the total cost of care for our customers.

We value what makes you unique. Be a part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations. Visit to see an overview of the product portfolio.

NEW VENTURES

New Ventures is focused on developing new diabetes systems, products and solutions in an inorganic, accelerator environment. Our team is unique in that we can adapt to a variety of business, patient and marketplace needs that span the entire spectrum of our product portfolio today and in the future. Our mission drives the need to be a highly skilled, flexible, extremely efficient, versatile and agile in medical device product development for the benefit of our patients with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes in need of intensive insulin therapy.

FIELD CLINICAL RESEARCH SPECIALIST

In this exciting role as a Field Clinical Research Specialist, you will be responsible for overseeing and executing clinical programs for a powerful, developing therapy to treat a small but critical cohort of patients on a humanitarian basis. Leveraging a broad and diverse clinical experience and skillset, you will provide clinical and technical leadership to key centers, HCPs and patients on a national and international level.


The Clinical Specialist will support research and development in evaluating concepts for new therapy and product development and the modification of existing devices; serving as a clinical resource between engineering, leadership, clinical research, and the medical community. Among these responsibilities, the highest priority is given to the support of patients. We will strive to empower people with diabetes to live life on their terms by delivering a pump that truly matters and providing support in ways that is needed. We are committed to meeting people with diabetes in their journey, always with an aim to make their life easier. Our focus is to provide a better life, better health, greater freedom and extend their lives of people living with diabetes.

A Day in the Life

  • Technically lead field activities such as selecting sites, performing activation duties such as certification of clinical centers both nationally and internationally, providing training, helping to enroll participants, providing technical support and ensuring quality data acquisition.
  • Identify and support new clinics that may want to establish capability based on existing clinical models
  • Identify and educate new patients, physicians on new therapy development
  • Troubleshoot clinical and technical issues related to therapy and product
  • Provide clinical input for user needs, product development, and user validation by providing feedback on patient voice for current and next generation product.
  • Train and mentor clinical staff and product development team
  • Oversees and interpret results of clinical investigations in preparation for new drug device or consumer application.
  • Build and maintain optimal relationships and effective collaborations with various internal and external parties.
  • Oversee and resolve operational aspects of clinical trials in conjunction with project teams and in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP), good clinical practice (GCP) and specific country regulations and may prepare clinical trial budgets.
  • Support clinical logistics with key centers, HCPs and patients for clinical research activities on a national and international level
  • Support IRB submissions for next generation product
  • Support the geographical expansion of centers

REQUIREMENTS

To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident on your resume.

Required Education and years of experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required and minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5years clinical research experience

#BetterDaysStartNow


Desired qualifications

  • Degree in engineering, life sciences, or related medical/scientific field.
  • Clinical Research (Lead) experience at Medtronic or within a medical device industry.
  • Experience working on a Global study team
  • Experience in Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and/or regulatory compliance guidelines for clinical trials.
  • Experience in managing multiple clinical research sites with proven results in study execution
  • Experience in managing clinical trial data review.
  • Ability to incorporate and adhere to good clinical practices and regulatory standards.
  • Ability to identify and implement solutions in addressing study issues.
  • Basic understanding of biostatistics and trial design.
  • Proficient knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications: Excel, PowerPoint and Word, Project (or similar scheduling software), project management techniques and tools; and web-based applications.
  • Excellent project management and organization skills.

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. About the School Quality Enhancement Program

The School Quality Enhancement Program (SQEP) is focused on elevating the educational standards within Government Schools. Our mission is to not only improve academic quality but also to foster a nurturing environment that empowers students for success. Join us in this transformative journey to revolutionize education and create lasting change in our communities.

About the Role

The Senior Program Manager will co-own the SQEP portfolio with the Program Lead, holding outcomes for every school as a direct responsibility. This role exists to ensure that every school's OKRs are on track, every PM and SPM is supported and held accountable, and every teacher training cycle lands. Over time, this role is expected to take the lead on ground-level training design and L2-to-L3 strategic thinking, working as a true thought partner to the Program Lead rather than an executor of her instructions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Portfolio Ownership and Outcome Delivery

  • Hold end-to-end accountability, jointly with the Program Lead, for learning outcomes, OKR delivery, and L2/L3 rubric progression across every SQEP school.
  • Track school-wise and portfolio-wise performance against OKRs on a regular cadence; identify risk early and drive course-correction before it reaches the Program Lead.

2. Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and mentor PMs and SPMs across Uttarakhand, Delhi, and Gujarat, holding a consistent bar for execution quality regardless of geography.
  • Build the bench for a growing portfolio: identify, hire, and develop ground-level talent (SPMs, associates) as new schools and states join the program.
  • Run the Team Operating Rhythm—reviews, cadences, and cross-school syncs—largely independently, escalating only genuine exceptions to the Program Lead.

3. Training and Instructional Capability Building

  • Personally design and, where needed, deliver training for NGO partner teachers and government school teachers and leaders.
  • Build a repeatable model for teacher training and follow-through—calendars, observation protocols, and follow-through tracking—that can be localised to each school's context.
  • Conduct and co-conduct classroom observations and instructional coaching, with particular focus on schools nearing the L2-to-L3 transition.

4. Data, Assessment and OKR Rigor

  • Own portfolio-wide assessment cycles—baseline, midline, and endline—including PARAKH-format papers, learning outcome tracking, and RAG dashboards, ensuring quality and comparability across schools.
  • Maintain OKR scoring discipline—ratio-based, milestone-based, and floor-threshold logic—so that every school's reported progress reflects results, not activity.

5. Government, Funder and Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for government and partner coordination in each geography, escalating only strategic or relationship-sensitive matters to the Program Lead.
  • Represent SQEP in state and district-level meetings as required, and prepare the Program Lead for funder and government reviews with portfolio-wide readiness.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Master's degree in education, public policy, or management, or a Bachelor's degree with exceptional relevant experience.
  • 6–10 years of program management experience, including at least 3–4 years directly managing teams and owning school- or system-level outcomes; experience in government schools strongly preferred.
  • Experience of having built and managed high-functioning team(s) to achieve outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success in project planning and execution starting from vision and goal setting, product/program design, monitoring and evaluation, and resource allocation and optimization.

Our client is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and system reliability across production environments.

This role requires deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, CI/CD, container orchestration, monitoring, and infrastructure security. The DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring systems remain scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available while enabling development teams to ship code efficiently and safely.

The ideal candidate is proactive, automation-driven, calm under pressure, and passionate about improving infrastructure reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure cloud platforms
    • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation

CI/CD & Deployment Automation

Containerization & Kubernetes

Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response

    • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations

Security & Compliance

  • Apply infrastructure security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, and least-privilege access
    • Support compliance requirements such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or GDPR where applicable
    • Conduct vulnerability scans, patch management, and security hardening activities
    • Ensure infrastructure remains secure, compliant, and audit-ready

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Partner closely with development teams to improve deployment workflows and automation
    • Support developers with infrastructure troubleshooting and environment management
    • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency
    • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational procedures

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong problem solver who thrives at the intersection of development and operations
    • Calm, analytical, and methodical during incidents and high-pressure situations
    • Passionate about automation, infrastructure scalability, and reliability engineering
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across technical teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering
    • Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Experience & Skills

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A DevOps Engineer’s day revolves around keeping systems secure, automated, scalable, and reliable. You will:

In essence: you are responsible for ensuring infrastructure remains secure, scalable, automated, and capable of supporting fast, reliable product delivery.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

What We Offer

NewGen US – Freelance Motion Designer / Animator

Location: Remote / Flexible

Engagement: Freelance – Approx. 1–2 days per week
Day Rate: $300–$600, depending on experience


About NewGen

At NewGen, we’re a global social creative and creator agency made up of over 100 talented people worldwide, with offices in London (UK), Manchester (UK), Paris (France), and New York (USA).

We partner with leading brands to shape culture, tell stories that matter, and harness the power of social-first creative and creators to drive meaningful impact.

As a fast-growing agency with a collaborative, ambitious spirit, we bring together data, strategy, creativity, and innovation to deliver work that cuts through, connects, and creates conversation.

Founded by our 30-under-30 co-founders, NewGen is an independent agency working with some of the world’s biggest brands. Privately owned and built to challenge the big networks and traditional agencies, we move fast, live social, and believe fresh ideas can compete with anyone.

Our work is trusted by some of the world’s biggest brands, including Pepsi, Samsung, Amazon, SEGA, and Cash App.

We’re also the agency of choice for leading creators shaping culture today, from KSI and Amelia Dimoldenberg to PewDiePie.

Our Non-Negotiables

We want people who embody the following values:

  • Energy – Get involved, be heard, and contribute. We want people who bring energy and ideas.

  • Quality – Quality comes first. Everything we create should push boundaries and break new ground.

  • Collaboration – We win as a team. No egos, no judgment, just support and collective success.

  • Creativity – We thrive on fresh thinking. New ideas and bold approaches keep us moving forward.

  • Partnership – Be a great partner to our clients. Everything we do should deliver against their objectives and create a positive, collaborative experience.

The Role

We’re looking for a freelance Motion Designer / Animator to bring illustrated, mixed-media, and product-led content to life for one of our leading consumer brand clients.

This is ongoing support of approximately 1–2 days per week, turning creative concepts and existing brand assets into polished, scroll-stopping animation built for social.

You’ll work closely with our creative and account teams, taking established art direction and storyboards and adding the craft, timing, and personality that make work feel native to the feed rather than advertised.

We’re looking for someone who can work independently, take feedback in their stride, and deliver consistently against production timelines.

Key Responsibilities

As a Motion Designer / Animator at NewGen, you will:

1. Bring Illustration to Life

Animate illustrated characters, hand-drawn artwork, product imagery, ingredients, typography, and graphic elements, turning static brand assets into motion that earns attention.

2. Create Social-First Motion

Build short-form animation and motion graphics for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other platforms, designed vertical-first (9:16) and adapted across formats and placements.

3. Blend Styles and Media

Combine 2D illustration, motion graphics, mixed media, and product-focused storytelling into one cohesive visual language.

4. Execute Against Art Direction

Work from existing concepts, storyboards, and brand guidelines, bringing your own craft and ideas to how things move.

5. Design for How People Watch

Build strong hooks in the first few seconds, sound-off readability, and loop-friendly endings so the work performs in-feed.

6. Collaborate and Deliver

Partner with our creative and account teams, incorporate feedback quickly, and hit agreed production timelines.

7. Keep It Organised

Maintain brand consistency and deliver clean, well-structured project files so assets can be versioned and resized easily.

Social-First x Brand Impact

Being socially native is at the heart of everything we do at NewGen.

We’re not an advertising agency. We live and breathe culture, constantly plugged into the trends, conversations, and creators shaping the world.

To succeed here, you need an instinct for what resonates online and the ability to translate trends and cultural insight into work that feels authentic, bold, and social-first.

It’s OK to be ‘chronically online’.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of professional experience in animation, motion design, or a related creative field.

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

  • Proven experience in 2D animation, motion graphics, and illustrated animation, including layered illustrations, typography, and graphic elements.

  • A strong understanding of animation principles, timing, transitions, and visual storytelling.

  • Experience creating social-first content, particularly for Instagram and TikTok.

  • Ability to work independently from existing creative assets and established art direction.

  • Strong attention to detail, organisation, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

  • A portfolio or reel showcasing relevant animation and motion design work.

Nice to Have

These aren't essential, but we'd love you to have:

  • Experience working with CPG, food and beverage, or lifestyle brands.

  • Experience with hand-drawn, illustrated, or mixed-media animation styles.

  • Familiarity with frame-by-frame and character animation.

  • Experience adapting creative for multiple platforms and placements, including paid social cut-downs.

  • Working knowledge of Premiere Pro, sound design, or basic video editing.

  • Experience with Procreate, Cinema 4D, or other 3D tools.

  • Experience freelancing with agencies or working within in-house creative teams.

Working hours overlap with New York (ET)

Schedule

Ongoing support with project-based assignments

$300–$600, depending on experience

Please share your portfolio or reel, highlighting:

  • Illustrated animation.

  • Mixed-media motion graphics.
