jobs.description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities. This multicultural team drives the company’s mission of reshaping financial services for underserved communities.To gain deeper insights into FairMoney’s pivotal role in reshaping Africa’s financial landscape, we invite you to watch informative video.

The role

We are hiring a Lead Risk Manager & Portfolio Owner to run FairMoney’s Android Quick Loans portfolio in Nigeria. Android is a mature, high-volume and strategically important lending portfolio. This is a mini-CEO role for the portfolio: you will be the delegated day-to-day owner of its commercial, economic, risk and people outcomes.

Job Description

Portfolio economics and business planning

  • Own Android revenue, sustainable Gross Loan Book growth, risk-adjusted Gross Profit, economic profit and credit-risk performance
  • Build and own the annual Android business plan and strategic roadmap
  • Produce the monthly portfolio forecast and maintain a clear bridge between actual performance, budget and prior forecast
  • Diagnose material variances and drive corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines
  • Manage Expected Credit Loss, ECL/Revenue, approval and disbursal rates, Average Loan Size, tenure, exposure, FPD, roll rates, PAR, NPL, repeat value and CAC payback
  • Partner with Finance and Portfolio Economics on loan-level and customer-level NPV, funding efficiency and performance attribution

End-to-end Android credit strategy

Own and continuously improve strategy across:

  • New-to-Bank: low-and-grow origination, first-loan ticket, tenure, pricing and risk controls
  • Returning: repeat eligibility, behavioural strategy, offer construction and exposure growth
  • Top-Ups and Internal Consolidation: eligibility, incremental exposure, pricing, conversion and post-event risk
  • High-risk segments: risk-box clean-up, pricing, short-tenure treatment and exposure caps
  • Rejected-customer re-entry: controlled requalification using risk, affordability and alternative data

You will own the commercial application of PD cut-offs and calibration, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure limits, affordability, income-source treatment, fraud overlays, MBS treatments and customer-routing logic.

Affordability, experimentation and production delivery

  • Help formalise and operationalise Android affordability using bank-statement/MBS signals, transaction behaviour, SMS-derived estimates, declared income and repayment history
  • Translate affordability into amount, tenure, price, exposure, Top-Up and Consolidation decisions
  • Design controlled A/B, multivariate and champion/challenger tests with explicit hypotheses, maturity windows, success measures and rollback triggers
  • Measure full unit economics rather than only early risk metrics
  • Translate strategy into decision-engine rules, parameters and implementation requirements
  • Own replay, back-testing, validation, staged rollout, monitoring and post-implementation review
  • Drive cross-functional dependencies through to production rather than stopping at analysis

Delegated decision rights

Within agreed appetite, budgets and authority, you will be empowered to:

  • Prioritise and sequence the Android portfolio roadmap
  • Approve and launch controlled experiments within agreed thresholds
  • Scale, pause, modify or roll back strategies against predefined evidence and guardrails
  • Reallocate team capacity across Android workstreams
  • Escalate and resolve delivery blockers

You will escalate decisions that exceed delegated financial or risk thresholds, change company-level risk appetite, create material legal or customer-conduct implications, or materially affect another portfolio.

Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Build and lead a senior Android credit-strategy team with clear workstream ownership
  • Establish strong weekly and monthly portfolio rhythms
  • Develop credible workstream owners and at least one portfolio deputy
  • Reduce key-person dependency through documentation, controls and repeatable processes
  • Work closely with Decision Science, Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, Portfolio Economics, Collections, Fraud, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Customer Service
  • Mobilise these partners around clear briefs, owners, timelines and expected economic impact

Requirements

  • 6+ years in consumer credit risk, credit strategy or lending portfolio management
  • Proven ownership of a material lending portfolio or product line, including revenue, GLB, risk and profitability
  • Experience building annual business plans, monthly forecasts and corrective action plans
  • Strong digital unsecured-lending experience; Nigerian or broader African-market experience is strongly preferred
  • Advanced understanding of PD, LGD, EAD, vintages, roll rates, IFRS 9/ECL, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure, affordability and NPV
  • Strong SQL capability and comfort with Python or equivalent analytical tooling
  • Experience translating credit strategy into decision-engine rules and controlled production changes
  • Evidence of building senior teams, developing successors and leading complex cross-functional delivery
  • Strong executive communication and the confidence to challenge decisions with evidence

Benefits

  • 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors.
  • Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET).
  • Training & Development budget.
  • Paid company business trips

Recruitment Process

  • A screening interview with one of the members of the Talent Acquisition team.
  • Business Case Study
  • Technical interview with Global Head of Android Lending
  • Final Interview with Chief Credit Officer

jobs.excerpt: About Spotted Zebra At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before.
jobs.description:
About Spotted Zebra

At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before. In short, we're making hiring something everyone loves again - both talent teams and candidates alike.

We're a multi-award-winning Series A company giving talent leaders the solution they've always needed. Skills science native. AI-amplified. Built by people who've lived and breathed TA and knew there had to be a better way.

What we do

Spotted Zebra brings Interview Intelligence, Skills Assessments, and AI Interview Agent together in one powerful platform, designed for intelligence and action. One powerful agent and assistant: Spot. Working the way talent teams need it to, always with humans in control.

The result is talent teams get the insight to predict who will succeed, the speed to move before competitors, the governance to defend every hiring decision, and the capacity to focus on the human moments that matter most.

But our product is only part of the story. Spotted Zebra isn’t just building an AI-native product; we’re building an AI-native company. AI is changing how we build, sell, support customers and make decisions. We use it to move faster, stay closer to customers, reduce unnecessary processes, and give talented people more leverage in their roles.

That means joining Spotted Zebra isn’t just a chance to work on the future of hiring. It’s a chance to help shape what the future of work looks like inside a scaling company: compact, ambitious teams using AI to collaborate better, make decisions quickly, and deliver meaningful impact at speed.

The FTSE100 and Fortune500 companies trusting us include British Airways, NIQ, Domino's, Lidl, Merlin Entertainments, AWE, United Utilities, and Paramount. We've been named Personnel Today's Talent Acquisition Supplier of the Year 2025, secured gold across multiple industry awards, and were recently named on the UK Top 100 Startups List.

But what we’re most proud of is the team. People join Spotted Zebra because the mission is real, the product is genuinely exciting, and the opportunity to shape the future of hiring is huge. What makes it special is the way we work: smart, committed people in compact teams where trust is high, decisions happen quickly, and everyone has the chance to make a visible impact.

If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work - read on.

Our Dazzle (That's Our Team!) 🦓

Fun fact: A group of zebras is called a dazzle – and ours truly is dazzling!

We create a culture in which our team thrives and gallops ahead.

As we roam free and empower our dazzle, we gallop ahead on the journey to achieving our goals. We understand this journey will pose challenges along the way, yet we brighten the trail with our positive mindset and encouragement of others. The dazzle continuously moves, gaining knowledge and skills so that we can graze new grounds.

What you'll be doing

You’ll join Spotted Zebra at a defining moment, with the opportunity to turn an ambitious product vision into the company that defines AI-native hiring. As Senior Director of Product, you’ll work closely with the CEO to set the direction across Product and Design, shape the priorities of the wider Product, Design and Engineering organisation, and translate rapid advances in AI, deep customer insight and commercial opportunity into a focused strategy that wins. You’ll influence the company’s biggest bets, help take our product into new global markets, and tell a compelling product story to enterprise customers, partners, investors and the board.

You’ll also build the organisation and operating model capable of delivering that ambition. You’ll lead and develop a growing, high-performing Product and Design organisation, building on the five crews already in place, each with dedicated Product Management and support from specialist Design SMEs. You’ll embed AI-augmented ways of working that materially increase our speed and quality, and create a close partnership with Engineering so strategy, discovery and delivery move as one. You’ll stay close to customers and hands-on with the work when it matters, while creating the clarity, culture and capability Spotted Zebra needs to scale without losing the pace, ownership or product craft that makes us special.

Key responsibilities:

1. Product & Design organisation leadership - Own and lead both the Product and Design function, providing strategic direction, clear priorities, and a high-performance culture across all teams. Directly manage and coach high-performing individual contributors, being a trusted thinking partner and raising the bar for quality and craft. Stay hands-on where it matters — rolling up your sleeves on strategy, discovery, or delivery when the work calls for it. Own organisational design, budget and headcount planning across Product and Design, ensuring the function has the structure, capability and investment needed to deliver the company’s ambitions.

2. Engineering influence & collaboration - While Engineering has its own leadership, act as a senior cross-functional partner who shapes how Product, Design, and Engineering work together. Influence technical roadmap prioritisation, drive alignment on delivery trade-offs, and ensure the Engineering organisation has the strategic context it needs to make great decisions. Step in to provide leadership continuity across the broader build organisation when needed.

3. AI Augmented Delivery (AAD) - Set the standard for AI-Augmented Delivery across Product and Design, building on the five crews already in place, each with dedicated Product Management and support from specialist Design SMEs. You will embed AI throughout strategy, discovery, research, prototyping, design, specification and decision-making, enabling crews to move from customer insight to high-quality implementation with greater speed, accuracy and ambition. This will be a deeply hands-on part of the role: you will model the behaviours and tooling you expect from others, develop the team’s capability, and evolve the operating model so that AI increases individual leverage and organisational capacity without compromising product craft, customer understanding or enterprise-grade quality.

4. Talent attraction through personal brand - Use your own professional profile and reputation to attract exceptional talent to Spotted Zebra. Whether through an active social media presence, published writing, speaking engagements, or thought leadership in the product and AI community, you will help put Spotted Zebra on the map as a destination for ambitious, talented people.

5. Global product strategy - Define and champion the long-term product vision across all markets. Lead the expansion of our product strategy to serve enterprise customers in the United States and other international markets, ensuring that global growth needs - from regulatory requirements to local customer behaviours - are embedded in how we build and position our product. Champion the voice of the customer and user at executive level, and ensure product strategy remains closely aligned with commercial priorities through strong partnerships with Sales, Customer Success and Marketing.

6. Executive leadership & CEO partnership - Serve as a true strategic partner to the CEO, stepping in to represent the company and lead across Product, Design, and Engineering during key moments such as fundraising, board engagement, and major partnership discussions. Bring the product and technology perspective into investor conversations, presenting with confidence on roadmap, vision, and competitive positioning. Represent Spotted Zebra externally with prospective enterprise customers, at industry events, and across the press and analyst community.

7. Cross-functional ownership beyond Product & Design - Take accountability for functions that sit at the boundary of product and go-to-market, including Solutions Architecture. Ensure these teams are well-integrated with Engineering and customer-facing colleagues, are resourced appropriately, and contribute effectively to both pre-sales and post-sales success.

8. Scaling through fundraising & growth stages - Bring proven experience of navigating and shaping businesses through funding rounds. Help the company build the operating foundations, processes, and team structures needed to sustain rapid growth without losing speed or quality, while supporting the CEO in building a compelling narrative for investors. We are looking to double the size of the team over the next 6–12 months, and you will play a central role in making that growth successful. Lead organisational design decisions as the company scales, including when to hire, restructure or introduce greater specialisation, and proactively identify and manage strategic risks to delivery, growth and product quality.

Requirements

Must-Haves ✅

  • Product & Design leadership at scale: Demonstrated experience leading a Product and Design organisation across multiple teams and disciplines, with a track record of directly managing and elevating high-performing individual contributors while maintaining a hands-on presence in the work
  • Engineering partnership at senior level: Proven ability to work as a true peer and strategic partner to Engineering leadership - influencing technical direction, driving cross-functional alignment, and stepping up to provide broader leadership continuity when needed, without needing to hold direct line management of Engineering teams
  • AI-native delivery: Proven experience building or transforming a product function to operate in an AI-native way - embedding AI tooling into discovery, design, and delivery workflows to increase the speed, quality, and ambition of what the team can produce
  • AI tooling fluency: Hands-on proficiency with AI tools relevant to product and design work - from prototyping and research synthesis to writing, analysis, and delivery acceleration. Sophisticated understanding of AI and its application in B2B products, including an informed view on how AI will reshape the competitive landscape and what that means for product strategy and build decisions. You don’t just advocate for AI use; you model it
  • IC management & coaching: Proven ability to directly manage, coach, and develop team members across Product and Design - up to and including a Head of Design - setting high expectations, giving honest feedback, and creating the conditions for great work without needing a management layer between you and the team
  • Hands-on capability: Comfortable and willing to get hands-on when the situation demands it - whether that’s diving into a discovery problem, shaping a strategy document, or stepping in to unblock a critical piece of work
  • Scaling through funding rounds: Hands-on experience helping a high-growth startup navigate the transition from early-stage to scaled operations, including building the processes, structures, and culture that sustain growth without sacrificing agility
  • Global product experience: Proven ability to develop and execute product strategy across international markets, with particular weight given to experience building for or expanding into the United States enterprise market
  • Executive presence & investor readiness: Comfortable operating at board and investor level, with experience contributing to or leading fundraising narratives, due diligence processes, or strategic partnership discussions
  • Cross-functional ownership: Experience owning functions beyond core product and design - such as Solutions Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Implementation - and integrating them effectively into the broader product and go-to-market motion

jobs.description:
About LokalIn 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast.

This role requires a deep understanding of storytelling, editing trends, platform dynamics, and cultural nuances to create content that drives engagement and delivers impact.

  • Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.

  • Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
  • Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
  • Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
  • Edit videos in the required language Telugu, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

Requirements

  • 1–4 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
  • Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
  • Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
  • Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
  • Language proficiency in Telugu & English and Ability to edit in Telugu with cultural sensitivity and linguistic command.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Pharmacy QA Specialist plays a critical role in the pharmacy review process, supporting PBM clients by ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and quality of pharmacy-related determinations and documentation.

This role is responsible for coordinating with clients, pharmacists, and internal teams to ensure that all reviews are completed in accordance with client requirements, regulatory standards, and turnaround time expectations.

In addition to standard QA responsibilities, the Pharmacy QA Specialist provides subject matter expertise related to pharmacy benefits, medication reviews, and PBM processes, and serves as a resource for non-pharmacy QA staff on medication-related questions.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other, and Dane Street. All employees are expected to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and high-quality outcomes.

Major Duties & Responsibilities

Client Interaction

  • Provide regular status updates to PBM clients regarding case progress and completion timelines
  • Evaluate the quality and completeness of pharmacy reviews to ensure alignment with client policies, formularies, and regulatory requirements
  • Ensure that determinations are supported by appropriate clinical and/or formulary rationale
  • Clarify ambiguous or incomplete requests with clients
  • Distribute final determinations in accordance with client-specific requirements
  • Manage and execute clarification and addendum requests from clients
  • Follow up with clients for missing or incomplete information necessary to complete reviews

Reviewer / Pharmacist Interaction

  • Work directly with pharmacists and/or reviewers to ensure all client questions are addressed accurately
  • Ensure determinations are supported by appropriate clinical guidelines, formulary rules, and PBM policies
  • Conduct follow-ups to ensure timely completion of reviews
  • Provide feedback to pharmacists regarding documentation quality and completeness
  • Issue clarification requests when additional rationale or information is required
  • Ensure final documentation is complete, approved, and properly attributed prior to release

Report / Case Review

  • Review each case for accuracy, including medication details, dosing, clinical rationale, and documentation quality
  • Ensure compliance with applicable state, federal, and client-specific PBM requirements
  • Verify adherence to client-specific workflows, including prior authorization, appeals, and exception processes
  • Ensure all special handling instructions are followed prior to case release

Education / Credentials

  • Active Pharmacy Technician Certification (CPhT or equivalent) required
  • State Pharmacy Technician registration/licensure (if applicable) required
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree preferred

Job Relevant Experience

  • Experience in a PBM, managed care, pharmacy operations, or healthcare setting required
  • Experience with prior authorizations, formulary review, or medication review processes required

Job Related Skills / Competencies

  • Strong understanding of pharmacy terminology, medications, and PBM workflows
  • Ability to interpret clinical guidelines, formularies, and coverage criteria
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong attention to detail and quality standards
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage time effectively and meet strict deadlines
  • Proficiency in computer systems and documentation platforms

Working Conditions / Physical Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer work
  • Ability to perform standard office functions

Work From Home Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Ability to maintain a secure and uninterrupted work environment

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

jobs.title: Global Product Owner, Accounting & Tax
jobs.excerpt: At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Accounting & Tax owns the A&T product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics — and leads the function as a Managing Director–level member of the Delivery leadership team.
jobs.description:
At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Accounting & Tax owns the A&T product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics — and leads the function as a Managing Director–level member of the Delivery leadership team. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of A&T worldwide.

This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for A&T in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.

You lead the A&T function globally through the Global Process Manager (GPM), the Regional Product Owners (RPOs), and the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver A&T every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership & Growth

• Own the growth agenda for A&T — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — as the primary measure of the role’s success.

• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for A&T: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.

• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.

• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so A&T can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.

• Own the reputation of the A&T product in the market.

Product Strategy & Standards

• Own the global scope, service definitions, and standards for A&T — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.

• Set global execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.

• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.

Market Insight & Service Design

• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.

• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.

• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.

Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement

• Set the global A&T operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.

• Direct the Global Process Manager (GPM) on process design, standardisation, controls, and scalability — turning product intent into repeatable, executable delivery.

• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within A&T to enable scale and quality.

Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability

• Own product-level cost-to-serve for A&T, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.

• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.

• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.

Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership

• Lead all Regional Product Owners (RPOs) for A&T as their global head, holding them and the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.

• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.

• Lead, mentor, and develop the GPM, RPOs, and OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global A&T team.

Scope & Commercial Governance

• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.

• Support enabling functions on scope-to-catalogue mapping, SKU registration, and pricing alignment.

• Validate post-implementation effectiveness of scope and commercial changes through defined metrics, and refine where needed.

Compliance, Audit & Risk

• Set the global compliance posture for A&T across accounting standards (IFRS, local GAAP), tax legislation, and statutory reporting requirements.

• Ensure A&T delivery maintains internal controls and regulatory adherence in every jurisdiction the product serves.

• Engage with internal and external audit on A&T product-level matters.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the Chief Delivery Officer, peer Global Product Owners, Revenue, Technology, and the enabling functions across Delivery.

• Represent the A&T product in cross-functional and executive forums.

Key Performance Indicators

• Revenue growth and win rate for the product.

• Retention and net revenue retention (NRR).

• Margin and cost-to-serve.

• Delivery SLA attainment and quality.

• Client satisfaction (NPS).

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

• 15+ years of experience in accounting, tax, or finance operations, with at least 5 years owning a product, service line, or regional / global function end to end.

• Managing Director–level leadership experience, with the gravitas to operate as a senior commercial and product leader.

• Track record of driving growth — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — not only delivery.

• Experience running a service-line P&L at scale — owning cost-to-serve, productivity, margin, and pricing logic.

• Strong working knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP, tax legislation, and statutory reporting requirements across multiple regions (APAC, EMEA, and ideally the Americas).

• Demonstrated experience designing service standards, commercial logic (packaging, bundling, premiums), and pricing frameworks.

• Strong client-facing and business-development capability, comfortable as the senior product voice in front of clients and prospects.

• Experience leading senior delivery and product leaders — regional heads, process leads, and outsourcing-control / vendor-management leads — across multiple regions.

• Deep market awareness, with the ability to read trends and customer demand and shape the service accordingly.

• Process-oriented mindset, believing in global standards as the foundation for scalable, sustainable delivery — with the judgement to know where flexibility serves the client.

• Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills; comfortable with financial modelling, scenario analysis, and unit economics.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

• Proficiency in accounting platforms — Xero in particular (the central A&T platform) — and other ERP / accounting systems (QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).

• Comfort with AI-assisted tools and automation as enablers of product scale and quality.

Preferred

• Prior experience as a product or service-line head in a global outsourced accounting / corporate-services firm or in a Big-4 advisory / managed-services context.

• Experience leading a P&L turnaround, transformation, or in-housing programme.

Experience operating in an EoR, PEO, or global business services environment

ABOUT US:

GoGlobal is the leading professional services company to guide, establish and manage global operations with compliance and confidence. We bring the human touch to entering new markets and consolidating vendors through a single point of management. jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer Philippines Only
jobs.excerpt: The client is a health benefits platform serving individuals, families, and small businesses across all 50 states.
jobs.description:
The client is a health benefits platform serving individuals, families, and small businesses across all 50 states. The company acts as its own search engine, broker, and third-party administrator, offering Major Medical insurance and healthshare memberships alongside a consultative approach built around transparency and finding members the right plan at the right price.

We are hiring a Senior Process Engineer to extend our process engineering capability, not just our execution capacity. This is a genuinely autonomous role: you'll be pointed at a business area (claims, billing, enrollment, customer experience) and own the full cycle: diagnose, design using Six Sigma/Lean methodology, implement, and prove the result with a number.

You'll report directly to our EVP of Operations, a Six Sigma Black Belt himself, and work the same way, with the same toolkit, on real operational problems with real budget and real visibility.

What this role is not

  • Not a role where someone else has already scoped the fix; you find root cause yourself
  • Not a people-management role at the outset (though scope expands as trust and results build)
  • Not a call center, inbound support, or scheduling role

Why this role

Real ownership of funded, meaningful projects, not a documentation or facilitation-only seat. A direct line to an EVP who applies Six Sigma at the executive level, and a clear path for scope to expand as trust builds.

Responsibilities

What independence actually means here

This is the single most important requirement, more important than certification level:

    • You find and engage the right stakeholders yourself. No contact list handed to you.
    • You diagnose the true root cause, not the symptom that got reported.
    • You design the fix using DMAIC, 5 Whys, fishbone, process mapping, and validate it before you build.
    • You implement it yourself, coordinating everyone across the company needed to make it real.
    • You're given a target, not a detailed brief, and you're expected to produce a working result.

If you've only ever executed someone else's pre-scoped plan or facilitated someone else's workshop, this isn't the right seat. If you've independently run RCA and driven a fix from diagnosis through adoption, this is built for you.

What you'll actually own in the first 90 days

Five concurrent workstreams: two with a design already scoped for you to build (onboarding/communications rollout, proactive claims-status communication), and three where you diagnose from scratch (a full CX manual-process audit, a claims call-volume root-cause deep dive, and an open enrollment risk assessment). Yes, that's an aggressive load for a first 90 days; we say so directly, and there's a built-in Day 30 checkpoint to re-sequence honestly based on real velocity. We're not looking for someone who needs that spelled out in more detail than a target and a deadline.

Requirements

  • Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus); candidates with equivalent independent RCA/DMAIC leadership experience are encouraged to apply
  • 8+ years in process improvement, industrial engineering, or business operations
  • A track record of independently leading RCA/DMAIC projects from diagnosis through implementation, not facilitating someone else's plan
  • Strong process mapping and documentation skills (Visio, Lucidchart, or similar)
  • Comfortable partnering with a data analyst to turn raw data into dashboards, SLAs, and metrics. You don't build the pipeline, but you know what a good metric looks like
  • Excellent written and spoken English; you'll present directly to U.S.-based leadership
  • Full availability across U.S. Central Time business hours
  • Healthcare, insurance, or benefits experience is a plus, not a requirement; strong business/digital/remote-work experience is an acceptable substitute
  • Possess a laptop/desktop meeting minimum specifications: 16GB RAM, i7 operating system.
  • Able to maintain a distraction-free home office setup.
  • Dual monitor is a plus
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 15 MBPS).
  • Full-time availability, committed to a 40-hour workweek.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a basic monthly salary of $3500
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): Accumulate up to 12 Paid Time Off days per year, providing flexibility for personal and vacation needs.
  • Paid Holidays: Recognize and celebrate US Holidays with paid time off.
  • Full-Time Remote Work: Embrace the flexibility of a full-time work-from-home arrangement, allowing you to create a comfortable and efficient workspace in the comfort of your home.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Principal Low-Level Graphics Programmer to join our award winning team in Middlesbrough (UK), home to the beautiful North Yorkshire coastline and countryside.

As a Principal Low-Level Rendering Programmer, you will help architect, implement, and steer the technical vision for our next-generation custom graphics engine. This role is focused on the foundational engine plumbing and Render Hardware Interface (RHI) layer. You will design and evolve a highly optimized, GPU-driven rendering pipeline, while building robust infrastructure for hardware-accelerated ray tracing and cross-platform shader compilation.

Beyond high-level architecture, you will be responsible for the core performance, stability, and efficiency of the graphics systems. You will dive deep into GPU bottlenecks to eliminate pipeline stalls using GPU profiling tools. Finally, as a principal leader, you will upskill and mentor the wider rendering team in modern API paradigms and low-level debugging techniques, ensuring our engine maximizes hardware utilization across PC and next-generation consoles.

Double Eleven is one of the largest independent video games developers and publishers in the UK. Headquartered in Middlesbrough, we employ over 400 people across our UK and Kuala Lumpur studios.

We are incredibly proud to partner with some of the world’s leading developers and publishers, including Rockstar Games, Obsidian Entertainment, Mojang, Bethesda Game Studios and Facepunch.

As a global games company, we've collaborated to create new worlds in The Outer Worlds 2, helped deliver unforgettable experiences for players of Red Dead Redemption, enabled millions to battle in Rust Console Edition and created new adventures in Fallout 76.

Double Eleven is more than a place to work, we are deeply values-driven in all that we do and we know that we are at our best when our people feel fulfilled. We offer flexible working hours to allow you to truly enjoy work/life balance and always strive to deliver a workplace experience like no other. We regularly bring our people together to connect and have fun through our many different events, parties and hobby-based clubs.

On this occasion, we’re unable to sponsor a visa for this role.

Remote working option is available for the right candidate.

What you’ll be doing

  • Help drive engine‑level rendering strategy across multiple platforms.
  • Architect and implement modern rendering back-ends and low-level features.
  • Design and evolve a GPU-driven rendering pipeline.
  • Develop robust low-level GPU memory management systems.
  • Maintain a cross-platform shader compilation pipeline.
  • Architect and optimize hardware-accelerated ray tracing infrastructure.
  • Profile, analyse and fix GPU bottlenecks and minimise GPU pipeline stalls.
  • Mentor and upskill the engineering team in modern API paradigms and low-level hardware debugging techniques.

What we’re looking for

Technical Expertise

  • Extensive experience developing core rendering engine infrastructure.
  • Expert-level proficiency in modern graphics APIs, particularly DirectX 12.
  • Mastery of C++ and GPU programming, including a deep understanding of bindless architectures, GPU-driven rendering, and asynchronous GPU compute.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of modern GPU microarchitecture across PC and consoles.
  • Deep knowledge of hardware ray tracing architecture and acceleration structures.
  • Experience with GPU memory management in modern APIs.
  • Expert-level command of low-level profiling and debugging suites.
  • Extensive experience working with modern console platforms, and bonus points for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2.
  • Strong desire to stay up-to-date with modern GPU technology and techniques.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Comfortable owning complex graphics features from planning through to delivery.
  • Proactive in identifying risks, trade-offs and technical solutions.
  • Experience collaborating with content creators ensuring assets meet performance and technical requirements.
  • Strong mentorship skills, capable of lifting the capabilities of a rendering team and guiding architectural decisions.
  • Clear communication, capable of driving technical decisions and presenting graphics strategies to directors, producers, clients, and external partners.

Qualifications

  • All relevant qualifications considered

What to expect

Working life at Double Eleven

  • Start your day any time between 8:00am and 10:00am
  • 35 working hours per week with a 1 hour lunch break (with the opportunity to flex down to 30 minutes or up to 2 hours)
  • Opportunity to apply for hybrid working (up to 2 days working from home per week)
  • 28 days annual leave (20 days annual leave + 8 days bank holiday)
  • 1 day leave for your birthday and 1 day leave if you’re moving house
  • Up to 10 days discretionary annual leave during our end of year break
  • A brand new, state-of-the-art studio facilities that includes a market hall serving nutritious, subsidised meals, round-the-clock gym access, an auditorium and more
  • Subsidised market hall with food, freshly prepared daily by our in-house hospitality team
  • Free breakfast options, juice, hot drinks and fruit.
  • Employee referral bonus (up to £2000!)
  • Electric Car Scheme
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Free game codes, game swag and merchandise
  • Family-friendly leave available

  • Best-in-class tools and workflows so you can focus on creativity

Recognising your contribution - award schemes

Professional development and wellbeing

  • Access to mental health and wellbeing support via Plumm (includes 4 free video therapy sessions per month for both the employee and up to 3 family members aged 18+), unlimited text therapy, courses, meditations

jobs.excerpt: Overview PowerLines is a national nonprofit organization that aims to modernize the utility regulatory system for American energy consumers to lower utility bills and grow the economy.
jobs.description:
Overview

PowerLines is a national nonprofit organization that aims to modernize the utility regulatory system for American energy consumers to lower utility bills and grow the economy. It focuses on state public utilities commissions (PUCs), which play a critical role in determining how much people pay for utility bills, how utilities invest in different types of energy, and where new energy projects are built. These 200 commissioners oversee more than $200 billion in utility spending each year and have significant influence over the future of our energy system.

Utility affordability is quickly becoming one of the most pressing economic challenges facing American consumers. In 2025, utilities requested a record-setting $31 billion in rate increases, double the previous record, while 80 million Americans are struggling to pay their utility bills. Meanwhile, the U.S. grid is experiencing the fastest rise in electricity demand in decades with the growth of AI data centers and manufacturing. Policymakers across the political spectrum are increasingly focused on how regulatory systems can respond to these pressures while protecting consumers and supporting economic growth.

Recognized on the 2025 “TIME100 Next” list, PowerLines is rapidly becoming a go-to source and leader in informing the national discussion of this issue and has already shaped the conversation in the New York Times, Washington Post, Wall Street Journal, Politico, Bloomberg, CBS News, NPR, Marketplace, Financial Times, TIME, Vox, The Daily Mail, and MIT Technology Review. PowerLines is quickly establishing credibility as a nonpartisan expert on utility regulatory and energy affordability issues while reaching a bipartisan set of policymakers, including initial partnerships with the National Governors Association and Western Governors Association.

PowerLines is in a period of significant organizational growth and seeks a full-time Director of Development, the first full-time fundraising professional at the organization, to build and lead a major donor fundraising program capable of scaling to more than $5-10 million in annual philanthropic support. This role will build the organization’s development strategy from the ground up and serve as a strategic partner to the Founder and Executive Director in expanding PowerLines’ philanthropic base. The Director of Development will lead strategy and execution for major philanthropic support, with a focus on major gifts, family foundations, family offices, donor advised funds (DAFs), and high-net-worth (HNW) individuals. This is a rare opportunity for an experienced fundraiser to shape the financial foundation of a rapidly growing organization working on one of the most important economic issues facing American households. This role will serve as a force multiplier that enables PowerLines to expand its programs, shape policy, and improve energy affordability for consumers.

PowerLines is headquartered in Washington, DC. The Director of Development is a remote position, with travel of up to 30% expected. The Development Director will work closely with and report directly to the Founder and Executive Director.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Lead PowerLines’ Fundraising Strategy
    • Develop and implement a comprehensive fundraising strategy focused on family foundations, family offices, donor advised funds, and high-net-worth/ultra-high-net-worth individuals
    • Collaborate with executive leadership to integrate fundraising goals with organizational planning and budgeting
    • Maintain relationships with institutional funders for PowerLines
  • Lead Generation and Prospect Cultivation
    • Identify and research new potential donors with capacity and affinity to support PowerLines
    • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective donors through thoughtful cultivation plans
    • Research and vet new prospective donors that are identified through PowerLines’ participation in conferences and events
    • Support Founder and Executive Director in funder meetings, pitches, and other fundraising opportunities, including development of briefing materials, as needed
    • Convert PowerLines' policy and media wins into actionable fundraising opportunities
    • Lead planning and execution of PowerLines dinners, small gatherings, and other events to support fundraising
    • Attend conferences and events with the objective of meeting new prospective donors
  • Donor Stewardship and Relationship Management
    • Manage stewardship and renewal of existing foundation, family office, and individual donor support, ensuring timely and meaningful engagement
    • Make direct asks for potential funder contributions
    • Build authentic, long-term relationships with funders through regular communication, thank-you notes, follow-ups, events, and personalized outreach
    • Oversee development-related communications including donor updates, briefings, memos, newsletters, and impact reports
  • Proposal and Pitch Development
    • Lead development of grant proposals for family foundations, family offices, donor-advised funds, and high-net worth individuals in collaboration with Founder and Executive Director
    • Oversee grant lifecycle after initial development, tracking reporting requirements, amendments, and renewals as needed
    • Collaborate with other PowerLines team members to prepare compelling materials—presentations, concept papers, proposals, budgets, and reports—that reflect PowerLines’ mission and strategic priorities
  • Development Infrastructure and Team Building
    • Design and implement systems that can scale as the development team grows
    • Support onboarding and mentoring of additional fundraising staff as hired
    • Develop databases, CRM, and processes to ensure efficient and accurate tracking of donor relationship
    • Maintain accurate records in PowerLines’ donor relationship system

Requirements

Role Requirements

The ideal candidate will be an experienced fundraising professional who thrives while collaborating with family foundations, family offices, donor advised funds (DAFs), and high-net-worth (HNW) individuals. The successful candidate will be both a strategist and a builder—someone excited to create a high-performing development function while working closely with leadership to grow PowerLines’ national impact. The ideal candidate will be comfortable partnering directly with a Founder and Executive Director to build out a fundraising function in an early-stage nonprofit organization and will have the flexibility to adapt fundraising strategy to align with emergent programmatic priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of fundraising experience with a demonstrated record of securing six- and seven-figure gifts from family foundations, family offices, DAFs, and HNW individual donors. Experience fundraising within the energy, consumer advocacy, democracy, public policy, or other nonprofit spaces is a plus.
  • Strong relationships with family foundations, family offices, DAFs, and HNW individual donors
  • Experience managing significant donor portfolios
  • Strong degree of comfort in making direct asks
  • Proven skills in donor stewardship and cultivation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to connect the dots between PowerLines’ programmatic objectives and donor interests, motivations, and priorities
  • Experience crafting compelling pitch decks, concept notes, and proposals for family foundations, family offices, DAFs, and HNW individual donors
  • Strong emotional intelligence skills, including the ability to understand what motivates prospective donors
  • Capacity to thrive in an early-stage, fast-paced, dynamic, and uncertain startup environment, including an ability to identify priorities, function independently, and operate with tight timelines
  • A passion for advancing PowerLines’ mission of modernizing the utility regulatory system to lower utility bills and grow the economy through a consumer-centered lens

Why This Role is Unique

  • Utility bills and energy affordability are quickly becoming a defining national economic and political issue. As the fastest drivers of inflation, utility bills are becoming one of the most important cost-of-living concerns facing American consumers.
  • PowerLines has quickly established itself as a go-to national leader on the issue of utility bills and consumer advocacy. This role would be entering an organization with a strong initial foundation while having the opportunity to serve as an impact multiplier.
  • As the first dedicated fundraising leader at PowerLines, the Director of Development will have the opportunity to build a philanthropic program from the ground up while helping scale an organization influencing national policy and consumer outcomes.
  • PowerLines is an early-stage organization with a rapid growth trajectory. This role has the potential to shape the future trajectory of an early-stage, dynamic, and nimble organization at a pivotal time.

Benefits

jobs.title: Care Navigator
jobs.excerpt: About Think of Us Think of Us (TOU) is transforming the child welfare system into one where young people and families can heal, develop, and thrive.
jobs.description:
About Think of Us

Think of Us (TOU) is transforming the child welfare system into one where young people and families can heal, develop, and thrive. We drive purpose-driven work aligned with meaningful systems change, powered by data and the insights of lived experience. Our focus is on prevention, keeping families strong before crisis, and on building kinship-first systems so children grow up with people they know and trust. Through bold collaborations with leaders and innovators across the public and private sectors — from Presidential Administrations to local providers — we identify leverage points and co-create solutions that re-architect child welfare for the future.

Here’s what this looks like:

  • Built the Lived Experience Engine into the largest dataset of its kind (51,000+ voices), powering AI tools and shaping reforms
  • Partnered with California to launch the Kinship Accelerator in 8 counties, backed by $150M and a budget increase from $317M → $896M
  • Drove a national kin-first shift: 39 states (plus 5 tribes) adopting kinship standards, unlocking $3B for families
  • Operate one of the largest direct resource networks, connecting 1,827 families to $28M+ in support

Our team members share a commitment to driving systems change through creative problem-solving, obsessive curiosity, and a love of quickly driving innovative, measurable, and impactful results.

Position Overview

Department: Programs & Services - Direct Services

Reports to: Senior Manager, Direct Services

Direct Reports: N/A

Location: Remote, California

Category: Full-Time, Exempt

Think of Us is building a new kind of direct service practice — one that is human-centered, technology-enabled, and designed from the start to generate the intelligence needed to change systems at scale. The Care Navigator is a founding practitioner in that model.

Where a Community Responder opens the door, the Care Navigator walks through it with you. This role is defined by sustained, relationship-based navigation — holding TAY and kinship families in California through the full arc of their journey, not just the first moment of contact. The Care Navigator carries complex, evolving caseloads, goes deep on individual circumstances, and stays present through transitions, setbacks, and progress over time.

This is not traditional case management. The Care Navigator is a practitioner, a knowledge generator, and a co-designer — someone who delivers high-quality direct support while simultaneously helping codify what a 21st-century digital navigation practice actually looks like. Working within an emerging digital practice model, Care Navigators leverage technology-assisted intake, smart follow-up workflows, and real-time data tools — while keeping the lived experience and voice of the people they serve at the center of every interaction.

We make it a priority to welcome those who have personal and/or professional experience with the child welfare system as a core value of Think of Us.

Key Responsibilities

The Care Navigator's work moves through four interconnected practice areas — from first contact to sustained support to the systems intelligence that makes this work replicable at

scale.

EngagementHow the Care Navigator finds, reaches, and builds the trust that makes everything else possible.

  • Serve as a consistent, trusted point of contact for TAY and kinship families — building ongoing relationships that extend well beyond a single interaction or referral cycle, and meeting people where they are through phone, text, email, and digital platforms.
  • Build and sustain relationships with California community partners to enable warm referrals and collaborative problem-solving on behalf of the families we serve.
  • Deploy micro-cash grants strategically as an engagement and stabilization tool — using these touchpoints to deepen trust, reduce barriers to participation, and capture structured data on family need.
  • Activate crisis support protocols when needed — leveraging ConnectMe to identify appropriate resources and coordinate with relevant partners to ensure timely, stabilizing care.

AssessmentHow the Care Navigator develops a clear, evolving picture of who someone is, what they need, and where they are in their readiness to move forward.

  • Conduct comprehensive, Motivational Interviewing-informed needs assessments using ConnectMe's smart intake tools — grounding every assessment in trauma-informed, culturally responsive practice and building a personalized picture of each person's situation, priorities, and goals.
  • Recognize and respond to change talk — reading where an individual is in their readiness to engage and adjusting navigation strategies in real time to meet them there, rather than moving faster than they are ready to go.
  • Identify gaps in the resource landscape through direct service interactions — flagging emerging needs and systemic barriers to the team to inform strategy, advocacy, and resource development.
  • Collect and document user feedback and satisfaction data — treating each interaction as an opportunity to understand what is and isn't working, both for the individual and for the platform.

Support
How the Care Navigator walks alongside people — helping them access what they need, navigate what's in the way, and build the capacity to move forward on their own terms.

  • Manage an active caseload across multiple stages of the care journey — proactively monitoring progress, identifying emerging needs, and adjusting navigation strategies as circumstances evolve over time.
  • Co-develop individualized action plans with each person served — using ConnectMe to track progress, flag pivots, and ensure plans evolve as circumstances change, treating planning as an ongoing practice rather than a one-time intake artifact.
  • Guide individuals through meaningful transitions to community partners, service providers, and government programs — confirming connections are made, troubleshooting barriers in real time, and ensuring no one falls through the cracks.
  • Empower individuals to navigate complex systems on their own terms — using ConnectMe to streamline applications, clarify eligibility, and break down bureaucratic processes that otherwise feel inaccessible.
  • Leverage ConnectMe's technology-assisted directory to match individuals with relevant, culturally responsive services — while continuously assessing whether those resources are accessible, accurate, and responsive to the people we serve.
  • Support individuals who face barriers to digital access or literacy — bridging the gap between technology-enabled tools and the humans who need them most, and flagging accessibility gaps to the innovation team.

Learning & Systems Intelligence

How the Care Navigator turns frontline practice into the intelligence that improves the platform, informs policy, and makes this model replicable at scale.

  • Implement and scale ConnectMe's evolving suite of tools — including technology-assisted intake, automated follow-up, chatbots, and digital referral workflows — as an active participant in an ongoing practice model, not a passive end-user.
  • Document what works, what doesn't, and why — capturing real-time insights from direct interactions that drive continuous iteration of both the platform and the practice model it supports, and generating structured feedback on usability, accuracy, and user experience.
  • Contribute lived-experience and human-centered design perspectives to product and innovation work — participating in design reviews and usability sessions as a practitioner with direct proximity to the population, ensuring tools are built with and for the people they are meant to serve.
  • Contribute to codifying and formalizing technology-enabled practices that increase capacity, scale high-quality support, and generate intelligence that strengthens both service delivery and systems-change efforts.
  • Capture real-time lived-experience data through case notes on navigation interactions — documenting needs, barriers, outcomes, and opportunities in ways that inform both service improvement and policy recommendations.
  • Enter data accurately and on time in compliance with established protocols, maintaining privacy standards and adhering to defined ethical guidelines.
  • Participate in regular team debriefs, learning sessions, and case consultations — contributing frontline insights to the broader organizational learning cycle and to the development of deliverables such as a Theory of Change, Logic Model, and updated Program Manual.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the Innovation and Tech team to surface systemic barriers, generate policy-relevant insights, and contribute to a model for how VSS-generated data can inform state and national advocacy.

About You

We recognize that candidates may not meet every listed qualification. Research shows that individuals from underrepresented groups are more likely to opt out of applying if they don’t meet 100% of the criteria. If you believe you meet many of the criteria and can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply — we want to learn about your unique strengths and experiences.

Qualifications:

  • You bring 3+ years of experience accessing and navigating child welfare systems and/or other social service systems, with ideally 2+ years of professional experience in a direct service, case management, or navigation role. You know what it means to hold someone through a complex situation — not just hand them a list of phone numbers.
  • You are trained or experienced in Motivational Interviewing (MI) — you know how to meet ambivalence with curiosity, build intrinsic motivation, and support people in identifying their own goals. You lead every interaction with Unconditional Positive Regard, cultural humility, and sensitivity to the lived experiences of those you serve. Bilingual ability in Spanish (both written and verbal) is preferred.
  • You are a systems navigator at heart — you understand how to move through complex, fragmented systems on behalf of others, and you don't give up when the path forward isn't clear. You find creative solutions, make connections others miss, and advocate fiercely for the people you serve.
  • You bring personal or professional experience with the child welfare system or other social impact work, or you are deeply committed to learning about these systems. You approach this work with humility, curiosity, and a willingness to grow alongside the communities we serve. You possess an unwavering commitment to centering the voices and experiences of people with lived experience in every part of the work.
  • You are passionate about driving systems change and bring a relentless, solutions-oriented mindset to your work. You thrive in fast-growing, evolving organizations and adapt quickly to new challenges, using change as an opportunity to learn, innovate, and make a greater impact. You persevere in the face of opposition or difficulty and show commitment despite obstacles.
  • You have experience with data entry and documentation in case management, CRM, or tracking systems, and you understand accurate, timely data as a foundation for learning, improvement, and advocacy — not just compliance.
  • You have an active learning mindset when it comes to technology — you are open to exploring, applying, and adapting digital tools to improve efficiency, expand reach, and better serve families. You balance technology with critical thinking and always center the human experience in how you use and evaluate these tools.
  • You bring familiarity with California's child welfare system, county structures, or specific state programs.

Education & Training:

Bachelor's Degree in social work, counseling, human services, or a related field is required. Relevant lived experience and demonstrated professional competency may be considered in lieu of or in addition to formal education. Motivational Interviewing training (foundational or advanced) is strongly preferred and expected within the first 90 days of employment.

Compensation & Benefits

At TOU, we believe that taking care of our people is foundational to the impact we aim to make. Our compensation philosophy is rooted in transparency and a holistic understanding of people’s needs. We believe fair, market-competitive pay is essential to attracting and retaining the exceptional talent needed to achieve our ambitious goals. As a not-for-profit organization, we design our compensation packages—including both salary and benefits—with care and in alignment with our financial sustainability.

The annual salary for this role is $65,000–$75,000. Starting salaries for new hires will be determined based on a combination of the new hire’s relevant experience and market demands.

TOU’S benefits go beyond the basics. They’re designed to support your well-being, growth, and sense of purpose at work and beyond. From comprehensive health coverage to professional development support and meaningful time off, our benefits reflect our commitment to nurturing a workplace where people can thrive, both personally and professionally.

Health & Insurance

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; 50% for dependents.
  • Access to Talkspace for confidential therapy and mental health support.
  • Short-Term Disability, Life, and AD&D Insurance included.
  • Optional Long-Term Disability and Supplemental Life Insurance.
  • Health Care and Dependent Care FSAs available.

Financial Benefits

  • 401(k) Plan for pre-tax retirement contributions.
  • Work-from-home setup stipend to optimize your workspace.

Paid Time Off

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus sick leave and paid leaves of absence.
  • 8 company holidays, plus two organization-wide seasonal breaks.

Learning & Development

  • TOU values continuous learning and invests in the professional development of its employees in alignment with organizational needs based on role, performance, business needs, and Company policies.
  • Regular organization-wide learning sessions on relevant and reflective topics.

Application Instructions

As part of your application, please submit a resume outlining your skills and experiences relevant to this role.

Please note: We do not accept phone inquiries about this position in order to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process for all applicants.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Think of Us is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and value applicants of all backgrounds, knowing that diverse perspectives strengthen our work with children, youth, and families. All qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and for applicants’ religious practices as required by law.

jobs.description:

In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to strategically plan, execute, and deliver projects within established timelines and budgets. What You’ll Do

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated experience managing Time & Materials (T&M) software implementation projects including project budgeting, revenue forecasting, resource planning
  • PMP certified, demonstrating a strong foundation in industry-recognized project management principles
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and software, with the ability to apply best practices across a variety of projects
  • Proven track record of developing, executing, and managing detailed implementation plans in collaboration with clients
  • Exceptional ability to engage and secure buy-in from diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership, clients, and cross-functional teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, conciseness, and effective stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrated success managing a high-volume portfolio of approximately 40 or more concurrent customer implementation projects while maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery commitments.

jobs.title: 3D Modeling & Python Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.excerpt: Project Overview We are sourcing independent 3D Modeling and Python Specialists to provide their expertise for a specialized AI 3D asset collection project.
jobs.description:
Project Overview

We are sourcing independent 3D Modeling and Python Specialists to provide their expertise for a specialized AI 3D asset collection project. As AI models increasingly generate and interact with 3D environments, their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce collision-accurate 3D meshes from 2D reference images, write procedural generation scripts, and deliver structured programmatic outputs (JSON/JS) to train AI systems on geometric construction and trajectory logic.

Project Deliverables & Scope

Operate autonomously to generate precise 3D assets and programmed outputs. Expected deliverables include:

  • Procedural Geometry Generation: Writing Blender Python (bpy) scripts or Three.js/JavaScript code to procedurally generate 3D geometry using geometric primitives and Boolean operations (union, subtraction, extrusion).
  • Mesh Alignment & Export: Producing collision-accurate meshes from 2D reference images (masked + RGB), capturing accurate screenshot alignments, and exporting assets to .obj, .glb, or similar formats.
  • Structured Output & Trajectory Logging: Producing programmatic JSON/JS outputs representing the mesh and maintaining meticulous trajectory logs that capture sequential build actions for reproducibility.
  • Quality Assurance & Workflow Adherence: Auditing all assets against strict quality checklists before submission, maintaining precise file naming conventions, and sustaining high-volume output within a structured annotation platform.

Required Expertise

To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess a strong blend of 3D modeling fundamentals and programmatic scripting skills.

Core skillset includes:

  • Demonstrable proficiency in Blender Python scripting (bpy) and/or Three.js/JavaScript. Note: You must be able to write code to generate outputs; GUI-only modeling experience will not qualify for this project.
  • Deep understanding of geometric primitives (cubes, spheres, cylinders, cones) and Boolean operations, with a focus on low-poly construction rather than high-fidelity, subdivision-heavy sculpting (e.g., ZBrush).
  • Proven experience creating collision-accurate 3D meshes from 2D reference images.
  • Highly detail-oriented with the discipline to maintain trajectory logs, strictly follow file naming conventions, and self-audit work to maintain high reliability scores.
  • Preferred Experience: Background in game asset creation, familiarity with screen recording/keylogging tools, or prior experience within AI/ML data annotation workflows.

We offer a fixed pay rate of $22 per hour. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
