jobs.title: Chief External Affairs Officer
jobs.excerpt: Overview Common Future works to close the racial wealth gap.
jobs.description:
Overview
Common Future works to close the racial wealth gap. Our current economic system does not work
for everyone. Generations of Black and Indigenous communities and other communities of color
have been and are currently intentionally locked out of wealth and power, holding us all back.
Founded in 2001, Common Future is building a future where all people—no matter their race and
class—have power, choice, and ownership over the economy.
As a women-led, multiracial organization, our diverse team of strategists, community organizers,
financial activists, and policy enthusiasts provides capital, operational support, and strategic
partnership to budding solutions addressing racial and economic injustice. To advance racial and
economic equity, Common Future incubates, co-creates, and funds field-defining initiatives and
influences key sectors. We collaborate with leaders who have the imagination and courage to
rethink our economy. We bring initiatives that model how to build wealth and power in excluded
communities to life.
Our culture values include centering equity, being the communities we serve, embracing
experimentation, reimagining what’s broken, collectively solving problems, and modeling a new
way of working. We strive to be an innovator that prioritizes the well-being of our employees.
Read more about us at commonfuture.co.
Purpose

Common Future is seeking a Chief External Affairs Officer to serve as a senior executive leader responsible for building and sustaining the financial foundation and brand reputation that makes our mission possible. This is a pivotal role at a pivotal moment: as the landscape for equity-focused organizations grows increasingly complex and the need for durable, flexible funding becomes more urgent, Common Future needs a bold, relationship-driven leader who can match the ambition of our programmatic work with an equally ambitious funding and communications strategy. The Chief External Affairs Officer will own Common Future's revenue strategy across institutional philanthropy, individual donors, capital raising, and emerging revenue streams, developing a business model that supports both organizational sustainability and economic independence.

Success in the role includes owning a $10M total annual fundraising goal, which includes $6 - 7M in operations and $3M in investment capital. The CEAO will hold a personal portfolio of funder and investor relationships, including high-net-worth and big-bet philanthropic prospects, and will be an active and visible presence in the field, traveling to conferences and convenings (20-25% time) to build new relationships and deepen existing ones.

In addition, the Chief External Affairs Officer will steward Common Future's brand and strategic communications, including providing guidance to the team managing public relations and cross-platform media. This senior leader will remain attentive to the external environment and develop strategies to support the positioning of the Co-CEOs, our organizational impact, and our collective thought leadership.

As a member of Common Future's Executive Leadership Team, the Chief External Affairs Officer will partner closely with the programmatic team leads on revenue strategy, ensuring that fundraising is tightly integrated with programmatic priorities, and will work in a matrixed fashion across the Impact Investments, Initiatives, and Finance teams. They will oversee Fund Development and Strategic Communications, and will set the tone for a culture of excellence, creativity, and deep relationship-building in service of an equitable economy.

Position Responsibilities

    Revenue Strategy and Business Model (30%)

  • Develop, own, and implement a comprehensive revenue strategy across institutional philanthropy, individual donors, high-net-worth giving, capital raising, and online/digital fundraising channels.
  • In close partnership with the Co-CEOs, own a $10M total annual fundraising goal which includes $6 - 7M in operations and $3M in investment capital.
  • Assess existing strategy and infrastructure quickly, identify what is working, and build forward without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Lead and steward Common Future's business model with a cross-organizational lens, identifying opportunities to diversify and strengthen revenue streams, increase unrestricted and flexible funding, and build long-term financial sustainability and economic independence.
  • Partner with programmatic team leads and the CFOO to align fundraising strategy with programmatic priorities, ensuring that restricted and unrestricted funding opportunities are pursued in ways that serve organizational strategy and budgetary allocations.
  • Collaborate across teams to align and integrate revenue strategies organization-wide, including: a) capital raising with Impact Investments and our affiliate organization, Community Credit Lab (CCL); b) restricted grant fundraising with our programs team; c) Finance; and d) digital fundraising.
  • Track, analyze, and report fundraising performance to the Co-CEOs, Executive Leadership Team, and Board.

    • Funder and Investor Relationship Management (20%)

  • Generate, hold, and actively steward a personal portfolio of institutional funders, high-net-worth individuals, and capital investors, with a particular focus on big-bet and transformational giving opportunities.
  • Travel to conferences, convenings, and in-person engagements at least 2 - 3 times per quarter to build and deepen funder and investor relationships and represent Common Future externally.
  • Develop and lead cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies for current and prospective funders across all giving levels, applying an equity lens to how capital is pursued, including prioritizing funders aligned with Common Future's values, challenging extractive funding dynamics, and modeling the kind of capital relationships the organization advocates for in the broader ecosystem.
  • Identify and pursue new philanthropic, corporate, and capital sources aligned with Common Future's mission, including donor-advised funds, national donor circles, and emerging giving vehicles.
  • Support and participate in funder diligence and pre-diligence processes for the CCL Fund and other capital-raising efforts in coordination with the Impact Investments team.

    • Brand, Positioning, and External Relations (20%)

  • Steward and strengthen Common Future's brand, ensuring it is compelling, consistent, and resonant across platforms and external audiences including funders, partners, media, and the broader field.
  • Ensure that Common Future's narrative and brand strategy is tightly integrated with fundraising efforts, creating a coherent and compelling story for diverse audiences.
  • Work collaboratively with communications and programmatic staff to produce high-quality external-facing materials including proposals, impact reports, one-pagers, and case stories, ensuring ongoing, timely, and strategic placement.
  • Ensure high-quality execution of communications across all organizational channels, checking for internal alignment with the strategic plan and theory of change

    • Team Management and Leadership (20%)

  • Directly manage the Fund Development and Strategic Communication teams, with accountability for team performance, professional development, and budget.
  • Rapidly assess team capacity, individual development needs, and systems gaps to build a path forward.
  • Hold a strong vision for the Fund Development team's work as it builds toward achieving organizational revenue goals, and effectively cultivate a culture of excellence, creativity, and accountability.
  • Provide strategic guidance, coaching, and support to direct reports, including on grant writing, funder engagement, pipeline and portfolio management, and systems and operations.
  • Identify and create opportunities to develop the professional expertise of Fund Development team members.
  • Oversee fiscal management of the Fund Development team budget in coordination with the Finance team.
    • Executive Leadership and Cross-Organizational Collaboration (10%)
  • Serve as a member of Common Future's Executive Leadership Team (ELT), partnering with the Co-CEOs and peer executives to shape organizational strategy, culture, and financial sustainability - monitoring progress toward goals, cultivating external relationships, championing change management, and fostering leadership development and succession planning.
  • Make sound decisions with available information and course-correct quickly as new information emerges.
  • Engage as a visible, collaborative leader in both virtual and in-person settings, including supporting the planning and facilitation of Common Future team retreats and convenings.
  • Provide relevant guidance and thought partnership on an ad-hoc basis to team members across the organization, particularly on revenue positioning and external communications.
  • Maintain open communication with the ELT to ensure cross-functional collaboration and shared alignment on organizational priorities.

Desired Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in fundraising, development, or a related field, with demonstrated success raising significant philanthropic and/or investment capital at an executive level.
  • Proven track record of building and closing a portfolio of major donor, institutional funder, and/or impact investor relationships, including experience with transformational and big-bet gifts.
  • Strong brand instincts and experience in organizational positioning, external communications, and supporting executive visibility.
  • Deep understanding of and passion for racial and economic justice, with a clear perspective on how philanthropic and investment capital can be a tool for systems change.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing a multi-channel revenue strategy - spanning foundation grants, individual giving, high-net-worth cultivation, digital fundraising, and/or capital raising.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational change and ambiguity, including building or rebuilding systems, strategy, and team culture, without losing momentum on revenue goals.
  • Experience managing and developing teams at varying levels of seniority and expertise, with a high standard of excellence and accountability.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage authentically with a diverse range of stakeholders, from community members to major institutional funders and high-net-worth individuals.
  • Willingness and capacity to travel 2 - 3 times per quarter for conferences, convenings, and in-person funder engagement, with any accommodations considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply an equity lens to how capital is pursued, what kinds of funders and investors are cultivated, and how funder relationships are built and maintained, modeling the values Common Future advances externally.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking skills, with a high level of intellectual curiosity, a builder and rebuilder mentality, and comfort operating in complex and ambiguous environments.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership, boards, and external stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial style, with enthusiasm for working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Competencies for All Common Future Team Members

  • Understands the Work and Organization
  • Project Management/Planning
  • Relationship Building
  • Strong Communication
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Practices Emotional Intelligence
Our Commitment
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Common Future does not discriminate against applicants or employees due to their race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical ability, hairstyle, previous incarceration, or length of time spent unemployed. As an organization, we are committed to reflecting the diverse communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women, trans, non-binary folks, and BIPOC are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive organization, and we are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job. That candidate may be one who comes from a background less traditional to our field of work, and that’s okay. We would strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described.
Benefits
Common Future offers a work environment that is committed to the wellbeing and support of our employees. We embrace a human-centered approach to our practices and policies. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
•Ongoing 4 day work week, Monday - Thursday, 32-hour workweek, 80% time at 100% pay
•Remote and flexible work options
•20 days of PTO
•18 paid holidays*, including a week off in the Spring and Winter
•Fully paid medical, dental, vision for employees. Dependents covered at 75%
•Access to a flexible spending account (FSA) for medical and dependent expenses
•Paid long-term disability and life insurance
•16-week paid parental leave
•$500 annual professional development stipend
•$500 monthly caregiver stipend
•Immediately vested 4% 403b retirement plan contribution after 90 days
•$800 one-time home office set up stipend for new employees
•$150 per month coworking, home office, and cell phone stipend
•Annual in-person retreat, and more!
*Holidays that fall on Fridays are not rescheduled to another day.
Notes
Applications will be evaluated as they arrive and the position will remain open until filled.
Due to the high volume of applications, our hiring team is not able to field requests for feedback or informational interviews sent via LinkedIn or email. If you are a good match for the role, our team will reach out to you directly.

Under the guidance of the Director of Psychometrics and Quantitative Research, the Psychometrician is responsible for designing and conducting psychometric analyses of test performance; conducting psychometric analyses related to test construction, validity, reliability, equating, and scoring; preparing technical reports; developing, maintaining, and applying quality control procedures; providing quantitative guidance to professional research staff at CAL; and coordinating external quantitative resources on behalf of the organization. The Psychometrician will also provide quantitative guidance to other researchers at CAL and coordinate external quantitative resources on behalf of the organization.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Design, and conduct psychometric analyses for the WIDA ACCESS program
  • Plan, conduct, document and present psychometric and statistical analyses using classical test theory and the Rasch model with Winsteps and Facets software, including analyses related to item quality, rater performance, DIF, reliability and classification consistency, standard setting, equating, scoring, and reporting
  • Investigate and evaluate new approaches to conducting psychometric analyses in language testing
  • Establish and monitor quality control procedures related to quantitative analyses, from data cleaning to final technical reports, ensuring the reliability and integrity of results
  • Provide guidance to professional researchers on proposal design and quantitative analytical approaches upon request and participate in writing quantitatively-oriented portions of proposals as needed
  • Support outreach and collaboration, including research, development and client development activities with external partners, academia, innovators in education and language, and the public as needed

A Psychometrician must have:

  • A Ph.D. in Educational Measurement, Psychometrics, or related field.
  • A minimum of five years of demonstrated operational experience in designing and conducting statistical and psychometric analyses for high stakes testing programs.
  • Strong demonstrated experience in applying the Rasch model to a variety of psychometric issues
  • Experience in conducting analysis on performance and polytomously-scored tasks.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in programming in R or Python.
  • Proficiency in using SPSS, Winsteps, Facets, and other statistical and psychometric software.

The ideal candidate for this role has:

  • Experience working within a psychometric program in a K-12 U.S. Educational Context, and preferably in language testing.
  • Experience communicating effectively in English with clients and internal and external stakeholders in high-stakes contexts.
  • Experience working as a member of a team in producing timely error-free deliverables.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

A Psychometrician must be able to:

  • Create and apply quality control procedures in creating and maintaining databases, conducting statistical and psychometric analyses, conducting other quantitative research, and producing technical reports.
  • Program, document procedures, and instruct junior members of the team in statistical software such as R, Python, SPSS, Winsteps, Stata, and SAS.
  • Create replicable procedures for routine psychometric work.
  • Write narrative to accompany psychometric analyses for technical reports and other documentation.

The ideal candidate for this role has:

  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse, multi-disciplinary professional team of researchers and language testers.
  • Strong demonstrated experience with computerized adaptive assessments.
  • Experience in conducting standard setting study and/or alignment studies.

Travel Requirements

jobs.description:
APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers.
Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve.
We are looking for a Vehicle Protection Sales Specialist to join our Post Purchase Sales team. In this role, you will connect with customers who already own a vehicle and help them understand the benefits of extended protection coverage. By building rapport and identifying customer needs, you will guide customers toward the protection plan that best fits their vehicle and driving habits while contributing to the continued growth of APCO’s protection programs.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with customers from company-provided warm leads to discuss vehicle protection coverage options
  • Quickly build rapport and understand customer needs to recommend the most appropriate coverage plan
  • Clearly explain product features, benefits, and pricing to help customers make informed decisions
  • Use internal systems to manage leads, track follow-ups, and maintain customer records
  • Maintain strong product knowledge and stay current on available coverage options
  • Meet or exceed individual performance metrics including sales conversions, calls, and lead development
  • Participate in team meetings, coaching sessions, and ongoing sales development

What Makes You Successful

    You’ll be successful in this role if you’re a confident communicator who can quickly build trust and guide customers through purchasing decisions. You enjoy working toward goals, stay motivated by performance, and bring a positive, resilient mindset to every interaction.

    You’re also highly organized and self-driven, able to manage your time, follow up on leads, and stay productive in a remote environment. You’re coachable, open to feedback, and continuously looking for ways to improve your performance.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Previous sales or customer service experience (inside sales or phone-based experience preferred)
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule within posted business hours
  • Comfort working in a remote environment with multiple systems and screens
  • Strong verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience, ideally in inside sales or telesales
  • Experience working with CRM or lead management systems
  • Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets

This Role Might Be a Great Fit If You...

  • Enjoy connecting with people and helping them make confident purchasing decisions
  • Are motivated by achieving sales goals and earning performance-based rewards
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment where every conversation is an opportunity
  • Like the flexibility and independence of working remotely while staying connected to a team

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • A fully remote work environment with company-provided leads
  • Coaching, training, and career development opportunities

Schedule Expectations

    This role operates within the following hours:

  • Monday – Thursday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM CST
  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST
  • Saturday: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST

    • Your weekday schedule is set and would vary based on a varying 9 hour shift (1 hour for lunch). Each Warranty Specialist will work one late shift per week and one Saturday a month. You must have a flexible schedule and be available to work during the stated hours as needed. Schedules may be subject to change based on staffing or business needs.

Our platform helps organizations worldwide protect their mission-critical SAP systems through real-time threat detection, vulnerability management, compliance monitoring, and security automation.

We are looking for an experienced Alliances Manager to develop and grow our strategic and technology alliance ecosystem. Reporting to the VP Global Channel & Alliances, you will build long-term partnerships that accelerate revenue growth, strengthen our market presence, and create additional value for customers through joint go-to-market initiatives and solution partnerships.

Working closely with Regional Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Partner Operations, you will execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs), develop alliance-generated pipeline, and drive measurable commercial outcomes across strategic and technology alliances.

Key Responsibilities
Alliance Strategy & Partner Development
  • Develop and execute the regional alliance strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop Strategic Alliances, Technology Partners, SAP ecosystem partners, and Global System Integrators (GSIs).
  • Build executive relationships with strategic alliance partners and drive long-term engagement.
  • Develop and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with strategic partners.
  • Continuously evaluate alliance performance and identify opportunities to strengthen strategic relationships across the SAP ecosystem.

Revenue Growth & Go-to-Market Execution
  • Drive alliance-generated revenue and partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
  • Build and execute joint go-to-market initiatives across co-selling, joint solutions, technology integrations, and market expansion.
  • Increase Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) through strategic partnerships.
  • Support new customer acquisition, expansion opportunities, and strategic enterprise engagements.
  • Collaborate with Regional Sales to maximize alliance contribution across the sales cycle.

Pipeline & Strategic Account Collaboration
  • Build predictable alliance-generated pipeline aligned with regional revenue objectives.
  • Conduct account mapping with alliance partners and GSIs.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities across partner customer portfolios.
  • Lead opportunity reviews and joint customer engagements with alliance partners and Regional Sales.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data, pipeline quality, and forecasting.

Partner Enablement & Performance
  • Develop alliance enablement programs and coordinate commercial and technical training.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on joint campaigns, webinars, events, and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and monitor Joint Business Plan execution.
  • Track alliance performance through defined business and sales KPIs and provide regular business updates to the VP Global Channel & Alliances.

Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise software, cybersecurity, SAP ecosystem sales, strategic alliances, or business development.
  • Proven success managing Strategic Alliances, Technology Alliances, or enterprise partner ecosystems.
  • Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), SAP consulting partners, technology vendors, and enterprise software partners.
  • Demonstrated success building partner-generated pipeline and delivering measurable revenue growth.
  • Experience developing and executing Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of alliance business models, enterprise sales methodologies, and joint go-to-market strategies.
  • Excellent commercial negotiation, executive relationship management, and communication skills.
  • Experience managing pipeline, forecasting, and CRM processes.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  • Experience within the SAP ecosystem.
  • Experience selling cybersecurity or enterprise software solutions.
  • Knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Value Selling.
  • Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms.

Important Information
  • This is a fully remote position within the assigned region.
  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available.

Our Offer
  • The opportunity to shape strategic partnerships within one of the fastest-growing SAP cybersecurity companies.
  • Competitive salary with an attractive performance-based bonus.

  • Modern sales, collaboration, and partner enablement tools.
  • Close collaboration with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and the Global Channel & Alliances organization.
  • Professional development opportunities and long-term career growth in a rapidly expanding international software company.

What Makes It Special to Work With Us
Flat hierarchies await you at our company. If you have a good idea or knowledge, feel free to contribute. Because as a newcomer, your opinion is just as important. We want you to feel comfortable with us: arrange your working day and your way of working according to your preferences. At the end of the day, it's the results that count, not your presence in the office.

jobs.description:

That’s what it takes to work at Fuss & O’Neill – because that’s what we do for the communities in which we work: we create, innovate, and design long-lasting improvements that improve quality of life. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our growing building systems team and play a key role in the planning, design, and delivery of complex mechanical systems for a diverse portfolio of projects. This position offers the opportunity to lead high-impact work across commercial, industrial, education, and municipal facilities while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and designers.
The ideal candidate is a seasoned mechanical engineer with strong technical expertise in HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection systems, a passion for mentoring junior staff, and the ability to manage projects from concept through construction. This role combines hands-on engineering, project leadership, and client engagement, making it well suited for a professional looking to take the next step in their career within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

This position may sit fully remote with travel as needed to job sites within the Northeast.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead mechanical design and serve as project manager for building systems projects, including HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection systems.
  • Develop and review construction documents, technical specifications, and cost estimates.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements (e.g., ASHRAE, local building codes).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, and budgets for assigned projects.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for select projects, building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Coordinate and manage multi-disciplinary design teams, including internal civil, structural, and electrical staff.
  • Oversee construction administration activities, including submittal review, responses to RFIs, and site visits.
  • Lead and participate in internal and external project meetings, maintaining clear communication with clients, consultants, and contractors.
  • Support proposal development, level-of-effort estimating, and project planning.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical development within the mechanical team.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design for building systems (HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection).
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit for MEP design.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, plumbing systems, fire protection, and applicable building codes and ASHRAE standards.
  • Experience managing projects through design and construction phases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and project teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with BIM coordination tools preferred.
  • Ability to travel to job sites in CT, MA, and RI.
This position may be open to a flexible, part-time arrangement of 20+ hours per week. Candidates seeking a reduced schedule are encouraged to apply.

Benefits

  • Schedule Flexibility: Customize your work schedule to fit your life.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health benefits to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Continuous Learning: Access to online courses, conferences, and learning materials to fuel your professional growth.
  • Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge with our generous paid time off policy.
  • Career Advancement: Clear paths for promotions and the opportunity to take on new challenges.
  • Fun Team Culture: Regular team-building activities, happy hours, and company outings.

The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

jobs.excerpt: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you It takes 15 years to move a single drug from the lab to patients, and a huge share of that journey goes into pharma's pre-launch, launch and commercial activities.
jobs.description:
Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

It takes 15 years to move a single drug from the lab to patients, and a huge share of that journey goes into pharma's pre-launch, launch and commercial activities.

Onomi exists to make pharma and HCP live engagement work better. We give pharma teams one solution to run their in-person and virtual engagements while capturing every interaction in their CRM. We call this “live engagement intelligence” and over 100 pharma companies use our solutions worldwide.

By making events easier to manage and measure, we help pharma create better experiences for HCPs, at a lower cost. Our solution turns complex congress engagements, webinars, standalone meetings, advisory boards and field-led meetings into meaningful connections that drive results for commercial and medical teams.

This position is the ideal role for an agency/pharma meetings project manager or event/meeting planner with experience in congress/convention or medical education planning and execution, and interested in technology, engagement and analytics.

You bring 2+ years of prior experience in congress engagement, KOL and pharma stakeholder management, congress and medical education event project planning and execution. You know the quirks of event approval workflows across Commercial, Medical and Legal Review, not just that they exist, but how they actually slow things down and how to work them.

As a Project Manager, Life Sciences with Onomi, your role will be to lead and execute end-to-end congress, webinar, adboard and medical education event projects both onsite and remote.

This will involve independently building, configuring and launching our suite of live engagement apps (web, mobile, portal, video, AI) using our SpotMe Backstage Content Management System (30%).

You will be professionally managing our customers, and other senior stakeholders with clear, timely communications to enhance the HCP experience adding value across the entire project lifecycle (20%).

As you approach the live event, you will coordinate closely with stakeholders to ensure seamless execution on event day. You will be training faculty, field sales team, booth staff and agencies, and thoroughly reviewing the event apps to guarantee flawless delivery. You will ensure that onsite technology (interaction tracking with apps, microapps, iPads, badge printers) has been fully configured and tested end-to-end. (20%).

For the live event, your responsibilities may vary depending on the type of modules being used but may include ensuring speakers are fully briefed and prepared, whether they're presenting in a webinar, hosting a virtual session, or speaking onsite at a medical standalone or symposium. You will be responsible for all event operations running smoothly for both virtual and face to face projects (20%).

Following the event, you'll handle post-event communications, analyze event data, and deliver detailed reports, dashboards and recommendations to the customer, highlighting successes and identifying areas for future improvement (10%).

Objectives - The problems you will solve

During your 6-month ramp-up period:

In your first 3 months, you will onboard, get hands-on with our product and solutions, become familiar with our existing standard operating procedures and get introduced to our services, implementation, product and sales teams. This means you will:

  • Learn Backstage and our product by building and test driving a mobile app and webinar during your first week
  • Building all of your existing and new events in Backstage with minimal supervision, demonstrating quality follow-up emails and no errors in all core modules of the event found during the Project Reviews
  • Getting trained on how we deliver projects at Onomi, develop a deep understanding of the CongressIQ value proposition and experience it by shadowing colleagues in a full project lifecycle in month 1/2
  • Managing at least 3 complete congress or life science projects end-to-end - including onsite presence for at least 2 events

In your first 6 months, you have:

  • Become an advocate for our medical education tactics, successfully influencing faculty members to adopt them
  • Gone global, completing an international onsite project with our Europe/APAC team or one of our Europe/APAC customers
  • Mastered the full Onomi playbook by leading and completing a project in each of our core life sciences use cases: webinar, congress, medical education and advisory board
  • Been consistently recognized by clients for delivering best-in-class contributions that elevated event execution and enhanced overall participant experience and outcomes

At 12 months, as a SpotMe product and CongressIQ subject matter expert, you will have grown well beyond delivery into a trusted, multi-format expert who shapes how we run programs:

  • Led an average of ~7 onsite congress or life science projects per quarter (≈28 per year), or 13 remote projects per quarter, or an equivalent mix
  • Started growing the next generation of PMs, supervising 2-5 projects per quarter alongside junior/associate team members
  • Stepped up to Program Lead on one of our brand engagement programs, owning that program objectives are met and that there is continuity across the life of the program
  • Driven new business, by successfully concluding a meaningful upsell deal through one of your referrals and/or joining at least one business development activity with our sales team (webinar, tradeshow, speaking engagement, or RFP pitch)

This role requires frequent travel, out of hours availability and weekend work. About 20 to 40% of your time will be spent traveling onsite. Project planning typically occurs 3-9 weeks in advance, depending on project type.

What you need to be great at

  • Congress, meetings and event project management and process workflows with strong industry expertise: you bring deep expertise in pharma meeting and congress planning and execution, whether from agency or corporate backgrounds. You understand pharma priorities at every stage - before, during, and after events - and
  • translate complex workflows into clear, effective standard operating procedures that keep everything running smoothly and aligned with business goals.
  • Building strong stakeholder relationships with a service-driven mindset: you adeptly engage US and EU customers, KOLs, and medical societies by understanding their unique needs - you navigate and plan every interaction with an extreme sense of service, aligning with corporate pharma stakeholders and KOLs.
  • Influence and escalation: you understand how pharma decision-making works and confidently escalate to leadership when necessary to move projects beyond initial hurdles and bypass common delays and objections.
  • Technical dexterity: you have the ability to effectively and confidently deliver practical solutions (build and ship).
  • Balancing compliance with business needs: you can skillfully balance pharma regulatory compliance and legal review processes with business objectives, navigating and resolving potential roadblocks without compromising project momentum.
  • Product-smart: you understand not every customer request translates directly into a feature. You have the ability to generalize needs and prioritize solutions that deliver true value.
  • Fluent German and English

This role sits at approximately the 2-4 year experience level in event or meeting management - or a closely related function.The total compensation for this role is adjusted based on location, experience and travel frequency.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

  • Experience designing, developing and testing software
  • Extensive hands-on experience with the design and development of high-volume/low-latency services
  • Business and operational awareness
  • Good communication skills & EQ – able to work in a diverse team

We ask a lot of each other at JUMO, but we give a lot too.
You will love

  • Work with a modern but pragmatic Tech Stack (i.e. Kotlin + Spring Boot for Backend, TypeScript + React for Web and Mobile, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, Flink, Datadog, GitHub Actions + ArgoCD for CI/CD, AWS), building a highly scalable distributed system

About Abalone Bio

Abalone Bio is a biotech company pioneering the discovery and design of functionally active antibodies, with an initial focus on G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs). We overcome the major challenge of discovering rare GPCR agonist antibodies by using our proprietary Functional Antibody Selection Technology (FAST), a high-throughput, yeast cell-based platform.

Our drug discovery engine is fundamentally differentiated by generating millions of direct antibody sequence-to-function relationships through Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) of functionally active clones. These robust, high-quality functional datasets are orders of magnitude larger than industry standards and serve as the foundation for our cutting-edge AI/ML-driven design capabilities. We utilize sophisticated machine learning models, including Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), to both discover functional activity and design novel, optimized antibody agonists.

We are seeking a talented ML Research Consultant to help us on our mission. You will work closely with our ML team to ideate, implement, and validate the machine learning classifiers and generative models that will ultimately improve our therapeutic design platform, translating functional activity data into breakthrough biologics.

What You Will Do

  • Evaluate Sequence-Function Models: Design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art machine learning models, including Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs), to predict functional activity of GPCR agonist antibodies.

  • Implement Generative Models: Design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art generative models using Reinforcement Learning or Bayesian Optimization for de novo GPCR agonist antibody design.

  • Experimentation: Design and execute rigorous ML experiments with clear hypotheses and documented outcomes and next steps.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s (5+ years of experience) or Ph. D. degree (2+ years of experience) in Bioinformatics, Biophysics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience solving complex business problems in the life sciences using ML or statistical methods

  • Excellent communication skills particularly in the context of cross-functional life science teams

  • Understanding of modern deep learning architectures and optimization techniques as well as fundamentals of machine learning.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing deep learning models using frameworks like PyTorch.

  • Strong proficiency in python and the scientific computing stack (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).

  • Proficiency with software engineering best practices, version control (Git), and testing frameworks.

  • Experience with Transformer architectures, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), or Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) applied to biological sequence or molecular/structural data.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Theoretical foundations and practical experience with methods in computational structural biology, e.g., protein structure prediction, molecular dynamics, coarse-grained modeling, etc.

  • Experience with high-throughput screening data, particularly NGS analysis, flow cytometry, or other assays that link genotype to phenotype.

  • Direct experience with Protein Large Language Models (PLLMs), generative modeling, and/or Reinforcement Learning (RL) in a protein engineering context.

  • Background in developing models predicting antibody developability characteristics (e.g., stability, aggregation).

  • Background in molecular/cell biology, antibody discovery, bioinformatics.

Rate: 125-250 per hour depending on experience, up to 10 hours / week

Aufgaben

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu Cloud-Architekturen, DevOps-Strategien und Plattformkonzepten mit Fokus auf nachhaltige, tragfähige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.

  • Du entwirfst Zielarchitekturen für CI/CD, Container- und Infrastrukturlandschaften und übersetzt geschäftliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Du berätst zur Einführung von DevOps-Praktiken, Plattform-Engineering-Ansätzen und Self-Service-Modellen, von der Strategie bis zur Operationalisierung.
  • Du entwickelst Architekturentscheidungsvorlagen, Referenzarchitekturen und Governance-Konzepte für Monitoring, Logging und Security in Multicloud-Umgebungen.
  • Du moderierst Architektur-Workshops, präsentierst auf Entscheiderebene und überzeugst sowohl IT-Führungskräfte als auch technische Teams von deinen Konzepten.
  • Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung in komplexen Beratungsprojekten und wirkst an der strategischen Weiterentwicklung unseres Cloud- und DevOps-Beratungsportfolios mit.

Qualifikation

  • Du kannst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (bspw. in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik) vorzeigen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung.
  • Mehrjährige Beratungserfahrung als Cloud- oder DevOps-Architekt, idealerweise im Kontext regulierter Branchen.
  • Tiefes konzeptionelles Verständnis von Cloud-Service-Management- und Brokerage-Plattformen, sowie Erfahrung in deren Integration in komplexe IT-Landschaften.
  • Fundiertes Architekturwissen zu Kubernetes (OpenShift, Rancher), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), GitLab CI und gängigen Hyperscalern (AWS, Azure, GCP) und Sovereign/Private Cloud (OpenStack)

  • Programmierverständnis in Sprachen wie Python, Go oder Java, ausreichend, um technische Diskussionen auf Augenhöhe zu führen und Konzepte einordnen zu können.
  • Du kommunizierst und präsentierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2).
  • Deine Arbeitsweise ist gekennzeichnet durch eine Hands-on-Mentalität, ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation und eine serviceorientierte Denkweise.
  • Du bist teamfähig, dokumentierst klar und nachvollziehbar und gibst dein Wissen aktiv weiter.

Wir sind stolz darauf, dass es bei uns im Team eine sehr geringe Fluktuation an Mitarbeitenden gibt. Es ist uns wichtig, tolle Charaktere nicht nur zu finden, sondern auch zu halten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.excerpt: About Capitex Capitex is a specialist contract and interim staffing firm focused exclusively on financial crime compliance.
jobs.description:
About Capitex

Capitex is a specialist contract and interim staffing firm focused exclusively on financial crime compliance. We place experienced KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud and transaction monitoring professionals with banks, financial institutions and regulated firms across the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates and the United States.

Our clients come to us when they are under regulatory pressure and need vetted, capable people quickly — often within 24 to 48 hours. That speed only works because the administration behind it is precise. Since we were founded in 2021 we have built our reputation on exactly that combination.

We are a small, senior team. There are no layers to go through, decisions get made the same day, and the person doing a job is the person who owns it. It also means we hire carefully, because every person makes a visible difference.

The role

This role exists to take the operational running of our contractor and client administration off the desk of our CEO, so the business can grow without the back office becoming a bottleneck.

In practice, you are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Contractors submit their timesheets because you chased them. Compliance files are complete because you collected the documents and followed up on what was missing. Our records are accurate because you keep them that way.

It is detailed, repetitive, deadline-driven work, and in our sector it genuinely matters. Our contractors work inside regulated financial institutions, which means their vetting and documentation have to be right — not roughly right. Getting that consistently correct is the core of this job.

You will report directly to our CEO and work alongside our two client-facing consultants.

What you will be doing

Timesheets and contractor administration

  • Chasing contractors and client managers for weekly and monthly timesheets across three regions
  • Collating approved timesheets and checking them against contract terms
  • Flagging discrepancies, missing approvals and anything that looks wrong
  • Preparing summary schedules for review and sign-off

Vetting, onboarding and documentation

  • Collecting onboarding documents from new contractors and following up on anything outstanding
  • Carrying out identity and right-to-work checks against a defined checklist
  • Requesting and chasing references, and recording the responses accurately
  • Maintaining complete, audit-ready compliance files for every contractor we place

Records, systems and coordination

  • Keeping contractor, client and placement records accurate and up to date
  • Maintaining our SharePoint and Teams file structure
  • Preparing invoice data for review, and issuing approved invoices
  • Liaising with Employer of Record providers on routine onboarding and document requests
  • Tracking key dates: contract end dates, document expiries, payment deadlines
  • Raising problems early rather than waiting to be asked

What this role is not

We think it is only fair to be clear about the boundaries, so you know exactly what you are taking on:

  • You will not authorise or release payments — that sits with our CEO
  • You will not set rates, margins or commercial terms
  • You will not handle escalated debt or difficult client conversations
  • You will not be doing business development or candidate sourcing

Hours and contract

Full time, approximately 10:00 to 18:30 SAST, aligned to UK business hours. Fully remote, based in South Africa. This role is offered on an initial six-month fixed-term contract through Capitex's UAE entity, with a formal review at the end of the term.

Where this can go

We are a growing business and this is our first operations hire. The role has been scoped so that someone who proves reliable on the fundamentals can take on more over time: ownership of invoicing, oversight of compliance, and eventually the wider operational running of the business as we expand across our three markets.

We would rather be honest than oversell. That progression depends on the business continuing to grow and on you demonstrating the accuracy the work demands. But the room is real, and there is no queue of people ahead of you.

How we hire

We keep it short and we give feedback at every stage.

  • Application review
  • A 30-minute introductory call
  • A short practical exercise using anonymised data: reconciling a batch of timesheets, spotting the errors, and drafting the follow-up emails. It takes around an hour.
  • A final interview with our CEO
  • References and offer

Requirements

This role is open to people early in their career. We care more about how you work than about how long you have been working.

Essential

  • One to three years in an administrative, bookkeeping, payroll or back-office support role
  • Genuine attention to detail — you notice when a number does not add up, and you check rather than assume
  • Clear, professional written English; you will be emailing our clients and contractors directly
  • Comfortable following up with people repeatedly and politely until you get what you need
  • Solid Excel skills and general confidence with software and online systems
  • Organised and self-directed — able to work a full day productively without being told what to do next
  • Discreet: you will handle confidential candidate, client and financial information every day

Helpful, but not required

  • Any exposure to recruitment, staffing, payroll or professional services
  • Any background in compliance, banking, financial services or vetting
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint or Teams
  • Any experience working with clients or colleagues in another country

Practical requirements

  • Based in South Africa and able to work UK business hours
  • Reliable fibre internet with mobile data as a backup
  • Backup power — inverter, UPS or solar — sufficient to keep working through an outage
  • A quiet, private space to work from

Benefits

Real ownership from month one, not a queue of someone else's tasks

A direct line to the CEO — no layers, no politics, decisions made the same day

Fully remote

Exposure to financial crime compliance, a growing and well-paid specialism

Genuine room to grow as we expand across the UK, UAE and US

jobs.description:
About BOI

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

About the Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to design and build the products that put AI in front of real users. This is applied engineering work: building responsive front-ends, robust back-ends, and the data and integration layers that connect them to AI systems running in business-critical environments.

You'll take products from idea to deployment, owning the full path including architecture, implementation, performance, and the operational concerns that determine whether a system survives contact with users.

What You'll Do

You'll design, implement, and ship the products that wrap our AI capabilities into something users can actually use. Day-to-day, that means building responsive front-ends, scalable back-end services, and the database and pipeline plumbing in between. You'll work closely with our AI engineers to integrate models, agents, and retrieval systems into customer-facing applications.

You'll also own how we know our products work, including testing, observability, and the feedback loops that let us iterate with confidence rather than guesswork. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, and strategists, and you'll be in client conversations from early scoping through delivery.

What You Bring

You have 3+ years of experience shipping production web applications, and a background in computer science, math, physics, engineering, or another technical or scientific field. You're strong across the stack: comfortable in Python on the back-end (FastAPI or similar), and confident with React, TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling. You know your way around relational databases and the integration work that connects services together.

You take engineering fundamentals seriously. CI/CD, testing, version control hygiene, and code quality matter to you, because they're what let you keep moving fast without things falling over. You're comfortable deploying on a major cloud provider (Azure preferred), and you understand how to balance performance, cost, and maintainability. You've debugged enough production systems to have opinions about it.

You also use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, and MCP-based workflows fluently, and you treat them as a core part of how you ship.

How You Work

You treat product engineering as a craft. You care about UX details, performance, observability, and the underlying engineering that makes the interesting parts possible. You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain and a new set of constraints and every week looks different.

At BOI, you will work with strategists and designers, and most of your clients aren't technical. You're comfortable translating between business problems and technical solutions, and you can hold your own in a client room without a project manager running interference for you.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. New models, new frameworks, and new patterns show up constantly. You enjoy that pace, actively pull in what's useful, and bring it back to the team. You push back when something doesn't make sense, and you care about building products that get used long after the kickoff energy fades.

Contract & Setup

We are open to both permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements. The final setup will depend on your location, work authorization status, and local compliance requirements.

Interested?

If this sounds like a fit, apply with your CV and a short note on a product you've built that you're proud of. Bonus points for something we can actually look at!

jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

About the Role
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Script Writer to join our dynamic content
team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of short-form storytelling, social
media trends, and audience psychology. You’ll be responsible for conceptualizing and writing
engaging scripts for videos, ads, and branded content that resonate with Hindi-speaking
audiences across platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create compelling short-form scripts (under 60 seconds) with strong storytelling flow.
  • Translate content from Regional Language to English and English to Regional Language .
  • Write sharp, attention-grabbing hooks to maximize engagement and retention.
  • Craft platform-specific content for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other channels.
  • Analyze ad metrics (CTR, watch time, drop-off rates) to refine creative strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with video editors, designers, and creative strategists to bring ideas to life.
  • Translate copy ideas into strong visual narratives and impactful storytelling sequences.
  • Identify and adapt to emerging content and creative trends.
  • Simplify complex ideas into relatable and emotionally resonant content.
  • Constantly read and watch diverse content (books, short films, ads) to expand creative
    vocabulary and visual literacy.
  • Provide creative inputs during production to ensure content quality and tone consistency.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Any Bachelor’s degree.
  • 1–3 years of experience in content writing, scriptwriting, or copywriting (preferably digital/video
    content).
  • Proven ability to write short-form content with a strong storytelling structure.
  • Strong command over Regional Language and English (written and spoken).
  • Deep understanding of Indian audiences and cultural nuances.
  • Familiarity with digital metrics and performance-based storytelling
  • Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.
  • Why Join Us?
    We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and
    access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the
    roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts

  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for a Customer Support Executive that is excited about the below Mission and Outcome.

Mission:

We are seeking a proactive Customer Support Executive to deliver exceptional, trilingual (English/Mandarin/Cantonese) remote support for our clients—entrepreneurs and SMEs navigating business incorporation, accounting, and compliance in Hong Kong. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless onboarding, resolving inquiries with speed and empathy, and continuously improving client experiences through collaboration and problem-solving.

As the frontline voice of Sleek, you’ll leverage digital tools (Zendesk, Aircall, Slack) to provide efficient, accurate, and personalized support. Your ability to troubleshoot issues, guide clients through our platforms, and advocate for their needs will directly contribute to Sleek’s reputation as a trusted partner for business growth. If you thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and are passionate about empowering small businesses, we invite you to join our team.

Outcomes:

Multichannel Support:

  • Follow up with clients for feedback and submissions of documents.
  • Resolve customer inquiries via email, live chat, and phone with a focus on speed and clarity.
  • Guide clients through Sleek’s digital platforms (e.g., onboarding, document submissions).

Problem Solving:

  • Troubleshoot issues related to business incorporation, accounting, and more, escalating to internal teams when needed.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with Sales, Compliance, Corporate Secretary, Accounting and Tech teams to ensure seamless service.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify recurring customer pain points and suggest improvements to workflows or help center content.

Requirements:

To do this, you will have a minimum of 2 years experience in in customer support. Fresh graduates are welcome and you will most likely be located in Malaysia.

Must-Haves:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in any field.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in spoken English and Cantonese, Mandarin will be a great advantage
  • Experience: minimum 2 years in customer support (experience in Fintech, SaaS, or professional services preferred).
  • Tech-Savvy: Experienced in navigating digital tools like Zendesk, Aircall, Slack, and Gmail.
  • Remote-Ready: Self-motivated with a dedicated, quiet workspace and stable internet connection.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Basic knowledge of Hong Kong business regulations (e.g., taxes, company filings).
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup/scale-up environment.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

Tech + services savvy: We are a tech-enabled services business, automating traditional, manual processes and delighting customers while doing so. You will thrive as someone who understands and is excited by the challenges and opportunities of utilising software to scale a business.

Problem Solving: You’ll need to be able to think on your feet as this role requires you to identify, diagnose, and resolve production issues quickly, reducing downtime. You will leverage your strong infrastructure and development skills in post-incident reviews to find the underlying cause of failures and prevent future incidents.

Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

Analytical Mindset: You have a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to dissecting problems. You excel at analysing complex systems and processes to identify weaknesses and inefficiencies, and your ability to evaluate multiple scenarios enables you to devise the best testing strategies. You apply data-driven decisions to enhance testing coverage and performance metrics, ensuring the highest standards of software quality.

Collaboration-Driven: You thrive in a cross-functional team environment, working closely with developers, product managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment on requirements and testing goals. You communicate effectively, advocate for quality throughout the development process, and proactively address potential issues before they arise, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for delivering exceptional software.

AI-ready and curious: Sleekbooks already utilises AI capabilities, but there are many more applications to be found and incorporated. We want the candidate to be able to identify additional AI-led applications and be able to ascertain the practicalities of those solutions

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

Self Video / TA Interview

A ~30 minute chat with the Talent Acquisition . They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Case study

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager, where they will give you some real-life challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.

Soft-skills assessment

A ~60 minute chat with a member of the HR or leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

- Your education

- Any criminal history

- Any political exposure

- Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.excerpt: About Better Impact Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.
jobs.description:
About Better Impact

Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.

Our platform helps nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement.

We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing quickly, and our sales team is at the center of that growth.

This is a great moment for the right seller. The mission is strong. The market is large and still under penetrated. Our go-to-market motion is being rebuilt for scale. And there is real quota to win.

About the role

Better Impact is hiring an Account Executive to help carry our next phase of growth. This role will report directly to the VP of Sales.

This is a full-cycle, demo-driven closing role. You will run prospecting, discovery, demo, handle objections, negotiate, and close, primarily with volunteer program leaders at nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, and volunteer centers.

The company has strong fundamentals: a large market, a proven demo-to-close motion, and leadership that is actively investing in the tools, training, and pricing structure that make it easier for you to win. We need AEs who can execute a proven process at volume today, and who want to grow with a team that is actively getting more disciplined, better resourced, and better enabled as it scales.

You will own your full pipeline: qualifying and running demos on inbound, SDR-sourced, and (increasingly) self-sourced leads, managing forecast and deal hygiene in HubSpot, and closing new business against a defined ACV and deal-volume target. You will work closely with your SDR or BDR team members, your VP of Sales, and Customer Success on handoff and onboarding.

What you will do

  • Run a full-cycle sales process from discovery through close: qualify inbound and SDR-set demos, lead a consultative, value-first demo, handle pricing conversations and objections, and close.
  • Build roughly 30% of your opportunity pipeline using outbound campaigns that incorporate calling, emailing and social (LinkedIn) strategies
  • Carry and hit a monthly quota built on ACV and closed-deal volume, with a clear weekly pipeline review and forecast cadence.
  • Build and protect a healthy pipeline, including a self-sourced component through outbound prospecting, sequence follow-up, and reengagement of past closed-lost opportunities.
  • Run demos and discovery from the volunteer's point of view first, not just the administrator's, using Better Impact's established demo methodology and closing checklist.
  • Use discovery to surface the prospect's own urgency rather than manufacturing it, and apply approved urgency and pricing frameworks consistently rather than improvising deal-by-deal.
  • Keep HubSpot pipeline data accurate and current: deal stage, next steps, decision maker and budget holder, and close date, so your forecast can be trusted.
  • Partner with your SDR/BDR and with Customer Success on clean handoffs, so new customers start onboarding with the right expectations and the right contacts.
  • Stay current on product, pricing, and competitive positioning as Better Impact modernizes its platform and pricing structure, and bring field feedback back to the team.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle, closing sales experience, ideally in SaaS or software, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience building and running your own outbound sequences (Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar) alongside inbound demo volume.
  • Comfort running a high-volume, demo-driven sales motion: this is a high-activity role with real deal velocity, not a long, low-volume enterprise cycle.
  • Strong discovery and objection-handling skills, with the ability to sell value and outcomes to a buyer who is not evaluating you on technology for its own sake.
  • Experience or genuine comfort selling to mission-driven, budget-conscious buyers (nonprofits, government, healthcare, education), including the ability to build urgency and justify price without becoming transactional.
  • Disciplined pipeline and CRM hygiene: accurate, current HubSpot data, reliable forecasting, and follow-through on next steps.
  • Coachability: a real track record of taking structured coaching (call reviews, scorecards, scripting) and visibly improving from it.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable presenting to both a single volunteer coordinator and, on larger deals, a broader buying committee.
  • Resilience and self-direction in a fast-changing environment: pricing, packaging, and process are actively evolving here, and you'll be expected to adapt quickly rather than wait for a finished playbook.

Strong pluses

These are not required, but they would help you ramp quickly:

  • Experience selling into nonprofits, volunteer programs, healthcare systems, higher education, or government/municipal buyers.
  • Experience with volunteer management, case management, CSR/ESG, or other mission-driven or compliance-adjacent SaaS categories.
  • Experience selling through a merger or major pricing/packaging change, and staying productive through that kind of transition.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot as a sales CRM.
  • Experience with a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Sandler or similar) and comfort working from a defined closing checklist rather than an unstructured pitch.

Benefits

As part of our commitment to supporting you in both your professional and personal life, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefit programs, including:

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission
  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • 401(k) program with an employer match (after 90 days)
  • Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave
