jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe MALPB operates in a complex, fast-moving regulatory environment. The Risk and Compliance team is responsible for ensuring that our expansion is grounded in a bulletproof governance framework that matches the speed of our technology.
Having successfully established our foundational ERM policies, taxonomy, and risk registers, we are entering the integration phase. This team is building the future of "AI-Native" risk management—where governance frameworks are embedded into daily business operations through automated data pipelines and LLM orchestration.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a risk professional who combines strong enterprise risk management (ERM) experience with an analytical mindset and an interest in technology. Grounded in risk, audit, or compliance, you’ll help strengthen risk management across Stripe MALPB by bringing independent judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and clear communication to complex business challenges. ERM expertise is the primary focus, complemented by SQL skills and curiosity about how AI and automation can improve risk and control processes.
We are looking for a rare breed of professional: someone with the executive presence to stand up a banking governance program, combined with the hands-on engineering capabilities to automate it themselves.
As Enterprise Risk Management Lead, you will lead MALPB’s ERM program end-to-end, translating its established framework into consistent practices across the bank. You will provide independent second-line oversight and challenge, deliver clear reporting to management and the Board, and improve how the bank identifies, assesses, monitors, and responds to risk.

Responsibilities

  • Lead risk assessments. Run the annual Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycle, providing independent second-line challenge of first-line risk assessments, risk ratings, and control effectiveness.
  • Maintain core risk infrastructure. Maintain the Master Control Library, Central Risk Register, and enterprise risk taxonomy, with effective version control and change management to reflect evolving operations and emerging risks.
  • Monitor risk appetite and remediation. Aggregate, analyze, and validate Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against Board-approved risk appetite thresholds. Escalate breaches, require appropriate Management Action Plans (MAPs), and track remediation.
  • Deliver decision-ready reporting. Combine quantitative risk metrics with qualitative assessments of emerging risks to produce the quarterly Enterprise Risk Scorecard and present clear, actionable insights to the Management Risk Committee and Board of Directors.
  • Apply data-driven analysis. Use basic SQL queries and existing reporting tools to extract and sample data for control verification, partnering with technical teams on more complex analysis, automation, and system integrations.
  • Use AI to improve execution. Explore and apply AI tools to support control monitoring and testing, partnering with technical teams to develop agents that flag potential anomalies or control deficiencies for expert review.
  • Advance continuous monitoring. Progressively supplement point-in-time testing with automated dashboards and ongoing monitoring of key operational and regulatory controls.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise risk management, operational risk, or risk advisory within a regulated financial institution, fintech company, or Big Four technology-risk practice.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and embedding ERM programs—including RCSAs, KRIs, risk registers, and control libraries—within active, fast-paced business operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret large datasets, assess data quality, and translate findings into meaningful risk insights.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write basic queries for data extraction and analysis.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience constructively challenging senior business leaders and preparing concise, Board-level risk reporting.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to learn how to build and apply AI agents to risk management processes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a regulated fintech company, digital bank, or complex global payments processor.
  • Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, such as ServiceNow or Archer, including how their configuration can support a scalable ERM program.

Job Title: Market Access Manager, Private Sector (Brasilia or Belo Horizonte-Copia)

Job Location: Brazil Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

PLEASE SUBMIT ALL RESUMES/CV'S IN ENGLISH FOR CONSIDERATION

Language Requirement: Fluent English (Spoken and Written is Preferred)

Preferred Experience: Pharmaceutical/Biotech Industry

Location: Sao Paulo Office

Therapeutic Areas: Oncology and Hematology

General Description:

Member of BeOne's access field team professionals whose objective is to interact with stakeholders in the private and public markets, while driving reimbursement of new technologies with payers. Responsible to drive and implement access strategies considering the particularities of each stakeholder aiming at improving the patient journey and expanding access, contributing to a sustainable health system.

Essential Function:

  • Deeply understand of the healthcare system, considering all institutional stakeholders, HCPs, care networks, regulation, legislation and the existing interrelationship.
  • Identify access barriers and opportunities through target accounts, develop and implement action plans to get and maximize access.
  • Good understanding of the Brazilian Onco-hematology market access and the competitive landscape.
  • Patient's journey´s knowledge focused on Onco-hematology to develop customized plans by account to improve patient’s experiences.
  • Responsible for updating the CRM internal system.
  • Develop a sustainable relationship with Access Stakeholders with an ethical, empathetic approach and with the purpose of co-creating constructive projects to improve/expand access for patients.
  • Monitor new regulatory, financial and political trends, anticipating risks and developing strategies by accounts.
  • Interact with BeOne's strategic areas providing inputs for value proposition’s development, pharmacoeconomic analysis, evidence generation and innovative access solutions.
  • Work in partnership with sales team to collect relevant information and build the commercial strategy to ensure competitive proposals aligned with BeOne and customer needs.
  • Implement, monitor and constantly communicate our progress to internal stakeholders.
  • Map opportunities for regional events and lead the way.
  • Work cross-functionally with other areas by developing a culture of one team.
  • Ensure that all decisions taken are aligned with BeOne's governance model, considering decision-making criteria based on the PTRB concept (patient, trust, reputation, business).

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • University undergraduate degree in life science or business; higher qualifications (MD, PhD, MBA) advantageous
  • 5+ years of related experience

Other Experience:

  • Knowledge of the private health system; new technology incorporations process in private market.
  • Knowledge in health economics and of Health Technology Assessment Concepts and Tools.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Travel:Availability

Computer Skills:Standard Computer Skills required (MS Office)

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, fueling stations, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied hydrogen (LH2), and industrial gases industries.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, fueling stations, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied hydrogen (LH2), and industrial gases industries. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with $1.5 B USD in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Job Overview

The Regional Commercial Manager will develop and execute our commercial growth strategy across Latin America, with primary responsibility for growing sales of technical products, packaged equipment and engineered solutions to EPC companies operating within the region.

The role combines direct account leadership and sales execution with responsibility for developing a regional commercial strategy. This strategy will reflect market opportunities, customer feedback, competitive intelligence and our product value propositions, aligned with the company’s market segmentation approach and the strategic direction of Product Directors.

The successful candidate will translate regional opportunities into actionable growth plans, qualified project pipelines and sustainable, profitable sales. Working closely with the Regional Business Line Manager, they will also recommend the market coverage, partnerships and resources needed to strengthen our regional presence.

Responsibilities

Regional Commercial Strategy

  • Lead the development of the Latin America commercial strategy, in collaboration with the Regional Business Line Manager and Product Directors.
  • Prioritise countries, EPC accounts, end-market sectors and product offerings based on market potential, customer requirements, competitive positioning and our ability to deliver.
  • Develop country and account plans with clear objectives, actions, milestones and resource requirements.
  • Use market data and customer feedback to refine product positioning, identify gaps in our offering and recommend opportunities for growth.
  • Evaluate appropriate routes to market, including direct sales, local representatives and strategic partnerships, and recommend the coverage needed to execute the strategy.
  • Translate strategic priorities into regional budget inputs, sales forecasts and pipeline development objectives; adjust plans as market conditions change.

EPC Account Leadership and Business Development

  • Lead commercial relationships with assigned EPC accounts, building engagement across engineering, procurement, project management and executive leadership.
  • Develop existing accounts and secure new relationships with regional EPCs and international contractors delivering projects in Latin America.
  • Identify projects early and position our products during feasibility, front-end engineering and specification development.
  • Understand customer procurement processes, supplier qualification requirements, project schedules and decision-making structures.
  • Build relationships with relevant end users and project stakeholders to support EPC engagement and equipment selection.
  • Coordinate with other regional sales teams on shared accounts and international projects.

Value-Based Selling and Scope Expansion

  • Communicate clear value propositions addressing technical performance, reliability, lifecycle cost, delivery and project execution requirements.
  • Expand individual product opportunities into larger equipment packages by identifying appropriate complementary products, auxiliaries, controls and integration scope.
  • Develop opportunities in adjacent applications using the capabilities of our core products and established technical expertise.
  • Work with Technical Sales, Applications and Product Directors to validate application suitability, define package boundaries and establish competitive positioning.
  • Increase order value and customer penetration while maintaining appropriate margins and disciplined management of scope and risk.

Commercial Execution and Performance

  • Deliver assigned territory sales targets and agreed Management by Objectives (MBOs), covering both sales results and strategic development.
  • Lead opportunity qualification, commercial strategy, proposal follow-up and negotiations within delegated authority.
  • Assess project maturity, funding readiness, purchasing arrangements and competitive position to prioritise opportunities and internal resources.
  • Provide accurate regional sales forecasts and maintain a qualified pipeline aligned with priority markets and product offerings.
  • Maintain current account plans, project information, next actions and opportunity risks in the CRM system.
  • Review performance against targets and implement corrective actions where pipeline coverage, conversion or strategic progress falls behind expectations.
  • Work with relevant internal specialists to address payment terms, currency exposure, logistics and other commercial factors affecting regional competitiveness.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with Technical Sales and Applications teams to develop suitable solutions and timely, competitive proposals.
  • Establish clear opportunity priorities, responsibilities and customer commitments with supporting functions.
  • Maintain commercial leadership and continuity of customer communication throughout technical engagement and proposal development.
  • Provide structured market feedback to Product Directors and Marketing to support positioning, product development and sales tools.

Support effective order handover, ensuring agreed scope, commercial terms and customer expectations are clearly communicated.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of professional qualifications and relevant industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of progressive experience in technical sales, business development or commercial management within industrial equipment, packaged systems or engineered solutions.
  • At least five years in sales management or regional commercial leadership, including developing growth strategies, guiding teams and coordinating resources across functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing country or regional commercial plans, translating market intelligence into measurable business growth.
  • Strong experience selling to EPC companies and managing complex project opportunities within Latin America.
  • A proven record of achieving sales objectives, developing strategic accounts and managing extended sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers.
  • Demonstrated experience expanding core product sales into packaged equipment or broader engineered solutions and developing opportunities in adjacent applications.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin management and contract negotiation.
  • Experience working within an international organisation and influencing technical, product and operational stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English, with willingness to travel regularly throughout Latin America and occasionally internationally.

Desirable

  • MBA or postgraduate qualification in business, leadership or a relevant technical discipline.
  • Experience in industrial gases, LNG, cryogenic equipment or related process industries.
  • Experience developing and managing local representatives, agents or strategic commercial partners.
  • Portuguese language capability, particularly for engagement with the Brazilian market.
  • An established network of EPC and industrial customer relationships within the region.

Personal Attributes

  • A self-motivated commercial leader who combines strategic thinking with active involvement in customer development and sales execution.
  • Effective at working independently, managing time and prioritising opportunities across a geographically dispersed territory.
  • Comfortable building a regional business presence and operating where processes or market coverage are still developing.
  • Collaborative and credible with customers, technical specialists and senior management.
  • Curious, receptive to feedback and willing to adjust strategies as evidence and market conditions evolve.
  • Disciplined in follow-through, commercial judgment and delivering on commitments.

Measures of Success

  • Achievement of territory sales targets and agreed commercial objectives.
  • Development and execution of an approved Latin America commercial strategy.
  • Growth in qualified pipeline and conversion within priority countries, accounts and segments.
  • Increased packaged-equipment sales and successful expansion into adjacent applications.
  • Development of strategic EPC relationships, new accounts and repeat business.
  • Forecast accuracy, CRM discipline and effective use of internal resources.
  • Delivery of agreed MBOs and milestones for regional market development.

EEOC Statement

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Nikkiso CE&IG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Oncology - UK

Job Location: Virtual United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted to high standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. You’ll take ownership of site activities from qualification and initiation through monitoring and close-out, helping sites deliver accurate, timely study data.

Beyond your own sites, you’ll have opportunities to contribute as a Lead CRA on global studies, coordinate and mentor CRAs, support study teams, and provide input into monitoring plans, protocols, CRFs, and study-specific tools.

Your clinical research expertise, sound judgment, and ability to build effective relationships with sites and study teams will help keep studies on track while maintaining compliance with GCP, applicable regulations, protocols, and SOPs.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 6-8 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the UK.


What You'll Do

  • Lead site activities across the study lifecycle, including feasibility, qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, site management, and close-out visits.
  • Monitor protocol adherence, patient safety, informed consent, source documentation, study data, CRFs, and investigational product accountability to support high-quality study delivery.
  • Partner with sites to resolve data queries, maintain Investigator Site Files, complete regulatory and ethics documentation, and provide required documentation for the Trial Master File.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies and work with Project Management to evaluate study deliverables and milestones.
  • Mentor less experienced CRAs and site staff, including conducting accompanied visits, delivering training, and providing guidance on monitoring and site management activities.
  • Review site visit reports and provide clear, constructive feedback while ensuring findings and follow-up activities are appropriately documented.
  • Contribute to Clinical Monitoring Plans, protocols, CRFs, study-specific tools and templates, and process initiatives related to monitoring and site management.
  • Collaborate actively in study team meetings, investigator meetings, and bid defenses while maintaining regular communication with investigative sites.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or Pharmacy degree with at least 3 years of CRA experience; a four-year degree in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or a related science with at least 5 years of CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably nursing or life sciences, with at least 7 years of CRA experience.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Thorough knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, GCP, ICH Guidelines, applicable FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong understanding of two to three therapeutic areas, with the expertise required to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent planning, organization, time management, communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, leadership, and mentoring skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and EDC systems.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, together with fluency in the local language(s) of the countries under responsibility.
  • A valid current passport and driving license.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Analyst
jobs.excerpt: What You'll Do The Senior Tax Analyst is a key contributor to Avalara’s Premium Managed Returns Service (PRS) offering, where you will provide a high level of service to customers enrolled in the Premium Managed Returns Service.
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

The Senior Tax Analyst is a key contributor to Avalara’s Premium Managed Returns Service (PRS) offering, where you will provide a high level of service to customers enrolled in the Premium Managed Returns Service. You will be responsible for identifying areas of improvement as well as serving an elite group of customers with highly complex returns as their primary point of contact. The ideal candidate is highly driven, detail oriented and proficient at balancing multiple priorities. This position directly protects client revenue, mitigates tax exposure, and advances Avalara’s AI-first operational strategy by embedding automation and AI into daily compliance work.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

  • Protects customer revenue through accurate, on-time state and local sales and use tax compliance support.
  • Reduces compliance risk by applying deep jurisdictional expertise and robust variance, exception, and notice management.
  • Increases operational scale by designing and refining Premium Managed Returns Service workflows, data ingestion patterns, and automation that reduce manual effort.
  • Enhances customer trust as a knowledgeable, proactive, senior point of contact for complex portfolios on the PRS product.
  • Raises team capability by mentoring junior analysts and sharing documentation, process improvements, and AI best practices.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Compliance and Filing Operations

  • Prepare, review, and file multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax, business and occupation, and gross receipts tax returns for monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual filing cycles
  • Manage a select portfolio of customer accounts as their dedicated primary point of contact for all returns-related questions and escalations
  • Research and resolve jurisdictional tax notices on behalf of customers with clear, timely, and well-documented communication
  • Perform quality assurance reviews related to sales and use tax content and jurisdiction form changes

Customer and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customers’ sales and use tax returns questions, setting clear expectations and relaying complex compliance information in an accessible, actionable manner
  • Own the onboarding and validation of new sales and use tax returns customers, ensuring a smooth transition into Avalara’s platform
  • Communicate regularly and effectively with customers, jurisdictions, and internal teams as part of research and resolution workflows
  • Take full ownership of customer satisfaction, demonstrating empathy and proactive responsiveness to customer needs

Process Improvement and Team Enablement

  • Identify, develop, and implement automation improvements to serve customers across a variety of market and tax verticals
  • Identify process and technology gaps and recommend improvements that reduce risk, increase throughput, and improve customer outcomes
  • Assist with implementation, training, and documentation initiatives in support of the broader team
  • Coordinate and lead training for junior-level employees, serving as a knowledge resource for critical troubleshooting and in-cycle risk reduction
  • Apply expert knowledge of jurisdiction websites and taxpayer-facing portals, including data input nuances and system limitations

AI Bar Raiser Expectation

This role is an opportunity to be at the leading edge of Avalara’s AI-first mission within one of our most complex and high-stakes compliance operations. We are looking for someone who goes beyond using AI — someone who brings deeper AI expertise than the current team and actively raises the capability of the people around them. The successful candidate will be a genuine AI Bar Raiser: a practitioner who can demonstrate, teach, and institutionalize AI-enabled ways of working that make the entire PRS team faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, reconciliations, exception review, and return preparation while maintaining or improving quality.
  • Use AI to draft clear, professional customer and jurisdiction communications, apply judgment and domain expertise before sending.
  • Summarize complex issues, RCAs, and action plans with AI to improve clarity and reduce preparation time for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and implement at least one AI-enabled workflow enhancement (e.g., standardized prompts, variance review patterns, notice response templates) within the first 12 months.
  • Quantify measurable AI impact such as reduced review hours, faster cycle times, or lower notice/rework rates.
  • Apply AI responsibly in alignment with Avalara security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Share AI best practices, examples, and lessons learned to elevate team productivity and capability.

What You'll Need to be Successful

12-Month Success Signals

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex, multijurisdictional customers on PRS with minimal escalation.
  • Achieve consistent 100% on-time filing performance (or agreed SLA targets) for assigned portfolios.
  • Maintain high accuracy with visible reductions in rework, variances, and notices relative to baseline.
  • Implement at least one documented AI-driven workflow or process improvement adopted by the broader team.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of AvaTax, Returns Console, PRS, including data flows and key configuration patterns.
  • Contribute meaningfully to at least one cross-functional initiative (e.g., product feedback loop, automation pilot, training series) with clear, documented outcomes.
  • Recognized by peers and leaders as a “go-to” SME for PRS based compliance in at least one or two critical domains (e.g., specific jurisdictions, firm segment, workflow type).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field AND a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience in multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax compliance, returns preparation, or tax operations
  • Master’s degree in a relevant field AND a minimum of 3 years of directly related experience may be substituted for the above
    • Note: A degree is required for this role. Work experience alone, without an accompanying degree, does not satisfy the education requirement
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work through ambiguous compliance scenarios
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tax concepts into clear guidance for accounting professionals and internal stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities to meet strict filing deadlines
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new software applications, platforms, and tools
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with depth in Excel (including Power Pivot, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, and related functions)
  • Must be available and working during US business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Masters) in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance
  • Experience with a Big 4 firm, a large corporate tax department of a multinational company, or a large ERP integration
  • Expert understanding of an Avalara customer’s data flow from AvaTax portal to Returns Console
  • Deep understanding of user platform features related to jurisdiction configuration, including nexus, exemptions, marketplace rules, filing calendars, reporting, and transaction data
  • Working knowledge of transaction flow across the business and the downstream impact on returns preparation and filing
  • Familiarity with returns content areas including transaction tax calculation, transaction data flow, returns mapping, and returns filing automation

Bar Raiser Expectations

Avalara’s strongest hires do not simply fill a role — they raise the level of the team they join. This is an opportunity to bring your expertise, your judgment, and your drive to a group of talented compliance professionals and make them measurably better. The right candidate will leave every process, workflow, customer relationship, and colleague stronger than they found them. We are looking for someone who joins Avalara, makes the team better than it is today, and raises the bar for everyone around them.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer outcomes, deadlines, and quality.
  • Exercise sound judgment in decisions that impact customers, scalability, and risk, using data and AI insights where appropriate.
  • Act as a “go-to” SME for critical PRS compliance functions or customers, leading through influence across teams.
  • Leaves processes, workflows, and documentation stronger than found by identifying issues, proposing solutions, and driving them to completion.
  • Elevate peer performance through mentoring, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and modeling Avalara’s AI-first, customer-obsessed culture.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

À propos de l’entreprise

À Torc, nous avons toujours cru que la technologie des véhicules autonomes transformera la façon dont nous voyageons, transportons la marchandise et faisons des affaires.

Leader de la conduite autonome depuis 2007, Torc a passé plus d’une décennie à commercialiser des solutions aux côtés de partenaires chevronnés. Nous faisons maintenant partie de la famille Daimler, ce qui nous permet de nous concentrer uniquement sur le développement de logiciels pour les camions automatisés. Nous transformerons la façon dont le monde transporte la marchandise.

Joignez-vous à notre équipe : catapultez votre carrière au sein de l’entreprise ayant contribué à créer la technologie de conduite autonome (CA). Nous sommes la première entreprise de logiciels de CA ayant eu la vision de faire équipe directement avec un constructeur de camions.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) superviseur(e), Annotation de données d’expérience pour diriger une équipe d’annotateurs(trices) de données qui contribue au processus d’annotation et d’assurance qualité des données de Torc. Dans ce rôle, vous guiderez une équipe chargée d’étiqueter des informations provenant de différents capteurs (notamment des images et des données LiDAR) afin d’aider à entraîner les systèmes d’IA utilisés dans les camions autonomes, tout en assumant le leadership quotidien de cette équipe.

Vos responsabilités

À titre de superviseur(e), Annotation de données, vous allierez vos connaissances pratiques du travail d’annotation à la gestion directe de personnes. Vous serez le guide de votre unité et vous participerez activement au besoin afin de respecter les échéances et de résoudre les problèmes. Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :

Leadership d’équipe

  • Assurer la supervision directe d’une équipe d’annotateurs(trices) de données
  • Élaborer et gérer les plans opérationnels courants de l’équipe
  • Donner des directives aux membres de l’équipe conformément aux politiques établies et aux orientations de la direction
  • Recommander des changements à l’équipe, à l’unité ou aux politiques et procédures
  • Accompagner les membres de l’équipe et soutenir leur développement de carrière
  • Assumer la gestion du rendement de votre équipe, y compris offrir une rétroaction continue et constructive
  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires pairs et l’équipe People Operations pour l’analyse du rendement et les processus connexes liés aux personnes

Supervision de l’annotation et de la qualité

  • S’assurer que l’équipe annote avec précision des objets dans des environnements 2D et 3D, y compris des boîtes englobantes, des cuboïdes et d’autres formes
  • Superviser la révision des données pré-étiquetées afin de s’assurer qu’elles respectent des lignes directrices détaillées
  • Soutenir l’équipe dans l’acceptation, le rejet ou la correction des annotations, et veiller à ce que des notes claires soient fournies lorsque des corrections sont nécessaires
  • Réagir aux changements de procédure ou aux commentaires issus du processus d’assurance qualité et transmettre les mises à jour à l’équipe
  • Aider l’équipe à apprendre et à maîtriser progressivement les outils d’annotation internes

Profil recherché

  • Expérience antérieure en gestion ou en supervision d’une équipe, idéalement dans un environnement de production, d’opérations de données, d’annotation ou un autre environnement axé sur les processus
  • Grand souci du détail et solide compréhension des flux de travail d’annotation et d’étiquetage
  • Capacité à garder une équipe concentrée et efficace lors de tâches répétitives à haut volume
  • Aisance à soutenir plusieurs projets et à réorganiser les priorités de l’équipe au besoin
  • Autonomie et motivation, avec la capacité de diriger une équipe avec une supervision minimale
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication, tant avec votre équipe qu’avec vos partenaires interfonctionnels
  • Capacité à appliquer les commentaires reçus et à favoriser l’amélioration continue des compétences et des méthodes de travail de l’équipe

La connaissance de l’anglais est exigée puisque la personne retenue devra collaborer de façon journalière avec des collègues anglophones aux États-Unis et travailler avec la documentation technique rédigée uniquement en anglais.

Notes supplémentaires sur le poste

Déplacements, formation et sécurité

  • Nécessite de se déplacer vers des lieux à l’extérieur du site; un permis de conduire américain valide et un dossier de conduite sécuritaire sont exigés
  • Peut devoir se déplacer à l’occasion vers d’autres sites; possibilité de déplacements à l’international, ce qui exige de pouvoir obtenir un passeport et les documents appropriés
  • Nécessite l’équipement de protection individuelle (EPI) approprié dans les zones désignées
  • Nécessite une formation technique continue afin de maintenir le plus haut niveau de connaissances dans le domaine

Exigences physiques

  • Capacité de faire preuve de souplesse et volonté de faire occasionnellement des heures supplémentaires
  • Capacité de travailler et de collaborer entre plusieurs sites et fuseaux horaires
  • Exposition occasionnelle aux conditions météorologiques extérieures

Avantages d’être un(e) employé(e) à temps plein chez Torc (Canada)

Torc se soucie de ses membres d’équipe et s’efforce d’offrir des avantages et des ressources pour soutenir leur santé, leur équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, ainsi que leur avenir. Notre culture est collaborative, dynamique et axée sur le travail d’équipe. Torc offre :

Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination par rapport à l’origine ethnique, la religion, la couleur de peau, la nationalité, le genre (y compris la grossesse, les enfants ou autre condition médicale), l’orientation sexuelle, l’identité de genre, l’expression de genre, l’âge, le statut de vétéran ou les handicaps.

Who are we looking for?

  • Experienced Editor or Rising Senior Reporter: A senior or experienced content editor with a track record of acting up into leadership roles, or a senior reporter with a strong record of standard-setting journalism ready to take the next career step.
  • Strategic & Digital Savvy: Possess strong digital publishing, video creation/editing, and social media skills, backed by experience in audience strategy, brand identity, and customer value strategy.
  • Agenda-Setter: A proven track record of leading forward planning, campaigns, and agenda-setting local journalism, supported by strong local knowledge.
  • Inclusive & Collaborative People Manager: Strong people management, delegation, decision-making, and communication skills, with a demonstrable commitment to furthering inclusivity in the newsroom.
  • Core Behaviours: Demonstrable collaboration, determination, imagination, and a relentless focus on our readers.

How we'll look after you

We take good care of our people - and that means more than just a pay packet. Whatever your role, you'll get a range of benefits, including:

  • 25 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), as well as an extra day after you've been with us for three, five and 10 years. We also have a scheme to help you buy extra holiday if you want to.
  • An extra day's paid leave each year to volunteer for a cause close to your community or your heart.
  • Big moment day - an extra day’s paid leave for a moment that matters to you - like getting married, moving house or welcoming a new addition to the family (human or furry!)
  • Help saving for your retirement - we'll match your company pension contributions up to 6% and you can contribute through salary sacrifice.
  • Supportive and progressive people policies - we’re proud to have a range of policies to support people in their lives in and outside work, including enhanced family leave and policies to promote flexibility, inclusion and progression. We believe you shouldn’t have to wait to join us to know what to expect from us, which is why we share this overview of the policies we have in place to support families and carers. If there's something you want to understand more about, just ask - it won’t make a difference to your application.
  • A healthcare cash plan - giving you money back for a range of medical expenses and fast access to doctor's appointments.
  • Car lease scheme - you can buy a brand new electric or hybrid car through our leasing partner, and pay for it through salary sacrifice.
  • Wellbeing support - including a 24/7 assistance programme for you and your family.
  • Financial Wellbeing – Access Stream, our app for managing your finances, pay, rewards and benefits all in one place
  • Access to lots of discounts - including 15% off with Reach's very own online marketplace, Yimbly, where you can buy everything from homewares to beauty products.
  • Interest-free loans - including for season tickets and technology.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick every single box, please don’t let that stop you from applying.

We know that everyone has their own story to tell, and we value potential, passion and the perspectives that different backgrounds bring to our work.

Diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us better serve our audiences, which is why we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and supported. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair and welcoming to all, without discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are looking for an Digital Editor to join us at GloucestershireLive & SomersetLive on a 6 month fixed term contract to cover a Family Leave.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced content editor or an ambitious senior reporter with a strong track record of standard-setting journalism to step into a pivotal leadership role managing the day-to-day operations of our GloucestershireLive and SomersetLive brand teams, while working closely with and supporting our flagship BristolLive newsdesk.

You will play a leading role in shaping brand values, workflows, people and content across both titles. Your goal is to deliver agile, high-impact journalism that informs, inspires, indulges and empowers our readers in their local lives, with a primary focus on accelerating the growth of our subscription model alongside our wider monthly audience targets.

About us

Hello, we’re Reach. Every day, our trusted news, stories and content connect with millions of people where they live - whether that’s on their social feed or at their neighbourhood newsstand; through their local community or their take on the hot topic of the day.

We're home to more than 120 trusted brands - from household names like the Mirror, Express, Daily Star and Daily Record, to local titles like MyLondon, BelfastLive, and the Manchester Evening News, and brands making a splash in the US like the Irish Star.

It's our ability to understand people and the things that matter to them that makes us the UK and Ireland's largest commercial news publisher. We reach 70% of the UK's online population and speak to over 100 million social followers around the world. And we’re just getting started…

Your story, with Reach

As a modern media organisation, we're much more than just news. And it takes a wide range of people and skills to serve diverse audiences, customers and communities like we do.

We know everyone has their own story to tell, so we’ve built an environment where every background is respected and every day is a day to explore.

We’ll help you build a career that works with your life, while giving you the space to create and grow.

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the role

Engine is growing fast, and our go-to-market teams are where that growth shows up first. As Senior People Business Partner for GTM, you'll be the strategic partner to the leaders who run Sales, Account Management and Customer Success, and Partnerships. You'll shape how we hire, ramp, organize, and keep revenue talent. You'll help leaders build a high-performance culture: keeping the bar clear and high, building talent density, and leading teams through fast, constant change.

You'll also work differently from most HR teams. At Engine, People Business Partners run AI agents for routine work, so your time goes to the problems that move the business.

Why this role is different

  • AI is how the work gets done. Agents handle routine requests, reporting, and first drafts. You own the judgment and the outcome.
  • Human-led strategy. We use AI for routine work and save our strategic skills for what matters most: leadership coaching, org design, and professional development. The business owns its goals; we partner with leaders to hit them.
  • High performance is the standard. We build for talent density: the strongest possible team in every seat, a clear and high bar, and fast action when it isn't met.
  • Change is constant. Segments, territories, and teams shift fast. You'll help leaders move through it with clear plans and clear communication.
  • Real scope. You'll partner with senior GTM leaders and help shape how a high-growth revenue organization scales.

What you'll do

Org design and change leadership

  • Partner with GTM leaders to turn revenue goals into people plans: headcount, org structure, spans and layers, and segment or territory changes.
  • Spot talent trends across the GTM organization and shape org plans that put strong talent in critical roles ahead of growth.
  • Lead organizational change in a fast-moving business, such as sales reorgs, new segments, territory shifts, or integrations, from design through communication and adoption.
  • Prepare leaders to communicate change clearly, anticipate reactions, and keep teams performing through transitions.

High performance and talent density

  • Help GTM leaders set clear, high performance expectations and hold them consistently, including direct feedback and timely action on underperformance.
  • Run talent reviews, calibration, and succession planning for GTM, focused on keeping top performers and building talent density.
  • Make sure talent decisions (promotions, ratings, exits) reflect a consistent, high bar across GTM teams.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and People Enablement to raise the hiring bar for quota-carrying roles and shorten onboarding and ramp.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remot
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei uns Mittwochmorgen.  Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark.

Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer.

Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen.

Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel.

Genau das ist dein Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken Paid Social anders

Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter:

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht.

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter.

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie.

Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend.

  • Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl.

  • Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange.

  • Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal

  • Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied.

Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social Ads Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, bis zu zehn Personen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

Product Discovery & Solution Consulting
Partner with prospective clients, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational workflows, pain points, and technical requirements.
Design and recommend tailored PandaPay solutions that align with each client's operational and strategic goals.
Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the solution evaluation process.
Technical Sales & Solution Engineering

Participate in discovery meetings, technical discussions, demonstrations, and solution design sessions.

Product Training & Enablement
Develop and deliver comprehensive product training for internal teams, implementation specialists, sales representatives, channel partners, and clients.
Ensure stakeholders fully understand product functionality, workflows, best practices, competitive positioning, and implementation methodologies.

Product Expertise

Serve as the organization's primary resource for product-related knowledge and technical guidance.
Product Operations & Continuous Improvement

Translate business requirements into structured documentation and actionable recommendations for Product and Development teams.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Product, Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to ensure seamless communication throughout the customer lifecycle.

Product Strategy & Market Intelligence

Strong problem-solving abilities with a customer-first mindset.

Why Join PandaPay?
Joining PandaPay means becoming part of an innovative and rapidly growing fintech organization that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer success. You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Influence product direction and contribute directly to product innovation.

We trust our teams to discover the most impactful problems and deliver solutions that customers love and the business values.

As a discovery-led Product Manager, you’ll collaborate closely with UX, Engineering, and AI to shape customer outcomes - not just ship features. You’ll regularly engage with leading customers such as BMW, NASA, and Miele to uncover their needs and pain points, guiding our R&D efforts to create products that truly make a difference.

You’ll join Bohdan, Dima, Fabian, Rieke, Salar, Sven and Thorsten - together known as the Chaotic Chimeras - a cross-functional product team pioneering how engineers build products for the future. They are the minds behind Synera Run, our web-based execution platform, that is unified with our low-code desktop editor and customer portal to craft one seamless, powerful experience.

By joining us, you’ll help turn our bold product vision into repeatable customer value, shaping the future of engineering with Synera.

👉 Your main focus areas:

  • You lead discovery and validation by engaging with internal stakeholders (e.g. Customer Success, Sales) and directly with customers to uncover user needs and pain points.

  • You collaborate with the Chimeras - our development team of product, design, and engineering experts - to translate insights into impactful product decisions.

  • You join the usual rituals such as daily standups, review meetings and retros. You clarify scope and customer value during the implementation.

  • You frame hypotheses and define measurable product outcomes, such as streamlining customer onboarding or increasing node adoption.

  • You own a problem space, not a backlog: you deeply understand users, map opportunities, and co-create strategy with design and engineering.

  • You continuously prioritize and refine opportunities with your team, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • You align with leadership on product goals and success metrics (e.g. adoption, retention, conversion) to ensure meaningful, outcome-driven progress.

⚡In 6 months:

  • You have a clear understanding of our platform, customers, and workflows.

  • You independently run at least one end-to-end discovery cycle: identifying user pain points, validating hypotheses, and sharing insights that shape roadmap priorities.

  • You ship one initiative that measurably improves customer experience or activation (e.g. increases activation rate, reduces onboarding time).

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You own a core product area and deliver measurable business or user impact (e.g. retention).

  • You establish a healthy, predictable discovery–delivery rhythm with your team: balancing learning, experimentation, and shipping.

  • You are recognized internally as a key voice in product strategy and prioritization, actively shaping discussions on where to invest for customer and business impact.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 68.900 - 89.500 EUR annually

  • Advanced Level: 85.100 - 112.900 EUR annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You’ll have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and help strengthen Synera as a leader in agent-driven engineering.

  • You’ll take ownership from day one, driving meaningful outcomes with real impact.

  • Work with exceptional engineers and designers united by a passion for solving real-world problems.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Strategy & Transformation PMO Analyst

Location: Virtual-first (U.S.-based) | Remote position with travel requirements varying by engagement, up to 50% to client sites in your region. Hiring regionally to serve a global customer base, with priority given to candidates in the Americas and EMEA.
Type: Full-time or Contract-to-Hire

About Global Transformation Group

Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and host of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we turn vision into value. Our mission is to help forward-thinking organizations close the gap between strategy design and execution using the IMPACT Engine System™—a proven transformation framework that builds internal capability, accelerates performance, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

We help organizations accelerate strategy delivery by operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change. From ambitious mid-sized companies to global enterprises, we enable clients to organize, operate, and deliver differently—so they can lead with greater agility, clarity, and confidence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a PMO Analyst—a sharp, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and coordination skills who thrives on creating order from complexity. In this role, you’ll support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise project management and transformation practices across client engagements.

This is a role for someone who loves connecting the dots—between strategy and execution, data and decisions, people and process. You’ll work closely with senior consultants and client teams to provide analysis, insights, and structure that enable high-IMPACT delivery across portfolios, programs, and projects.

What You’ll Do

PMO & Portfolio Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret portfolio and program data to provide actionable insights for decision-making.

  • Support portfolio prioritization, planning, and governance activities, ensuring alignment to strategic goals.

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and presentations that clearly communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.

  • Track benefits realization and ensure project outcomes are tied to measurable business impact.

Project & Process Support

  • Coordinate and track key milestones, deliverables, and interdependencies across initiatives.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining PMO frameworks, templates, and processes aligned with the IMPACT Engine System™.

  • Support project scheduling, resource management, and reporting to ensure accuracy and visibility.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across programs.

Change & Communication Enablement

  • Support change and stakeholder management efforts, ensuring that messages, timelines, and impacts are clearly communicated.

  • Partner with transformation leads to ensure project and portfolio updates are timely, accurate, and aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Help create artifacts, playbooks, and tools that reinforce alignment and adoption across stakeholder groups.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management

  • Participate in project retrospectives, capturing lessons learned and improvement opportunities.

  • Maintain PMO repositories and knowledge bases, ensuring information is current, consistent, and accessible.

  • Contribute to internal GTG innovation efforts by refining templates, tools, and methodologies used across client engagements.

What You Bring

  • 3–6+ years of experience in project management, PMO, or portfolio management support—consulting experience a plus.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data visualization, metrics tracking, and portfolio reporting.

  • Proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Planview, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, Power BI).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex information for executive audiences.

  • Solid understanding of project delivery lifecycles (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).

  • Ability to balance attention to detail with a broader understanding of strategic priorities.

  • PMP, CAPM, or equivalent certification preferred.

  • IMPACT Engine System™ Certification preferred (support provided if not already certified).

Ideal Candidate

You’re a curious problem-solver with a passion for structure, insights, and clarity. You bring both analytical rigor and people skills to the table—comfortable working with data but equally effective communicating its meaning. You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy helping teams perform at their best through thoughtful organization and insight.

We operate like a start-up inside a mature consulting firm: high trust, low politics, and obsessed with impact. If you want autonomy, collaboration, and a platform to grow your consulting and analytical career—this is your seat.

Why Join Us (Instead of a Big Firm)?

Think of us as what the big consulting companies could be—with soul.

  • You implement transformation, not just recommend it.
  • No armies of analysts, no layers of red tape. You work directly with executives and our leadership team.
  • You grow your own thought leadership, not just your billing hours.
  • You’ll help refine the system, not just follow one.
  • You’ll work on what matters. High-impact transformation. Strategic enablement. Long-term capability building.

Career Growth & Development
  • Advance quickly into more senior roles or client advisory positions as you demonstrate mastery.
  • Become a Strategy Navigator™, our highest-tier designation for advisors who shape strategy, not just delivery.
  • Participate in internal innovation and thought leadership, including speaking, writing, and contributing to new IES tools and approaches.
  • Access IES certification, advanced coaching, and mastermind communities to stay sharp and continually evolve your own leadership.

Engagement Model
  • Contract-to-hire: Initial consulting engagement with a strong path to a permanent leadership position.
  • Virtual-first work model, with travel to client locations as needed.
  • Compensation aligned with experience and engagement scope, with opportunities to grow.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining:

  • Why you're excited to join Global Transformation Group, PMO Strategies sister company
  • Relevant experience aligned with this role
  • Your availability and compensation expectations

We’re building something meaningful—and we’re looking for people who are ready to make an IMPACT.

Does this role feel wonderful but a bit intimidating? If you have some, but not all the experience, please submit anyway, as we are going to have multiple PMO and transformation delivery roles. You can also check out our other postings, such as the Project Manager role, that might be a closer fit.

This is a remote position.

Sales – Funnel Management Specialist

Company: PMO Strategies

Location: 100% Remote (Working US Hours)

Employment Type: Full-Time (average 40 hours/week), Independent Contractor

Salary: Hourly Rate Aligned with Experience

Help Us Make Sure No Lead Is Left Behind
Are you the kind of person who notices when something falls through the cracks—and makes sure it *never* happens again? Do you love organizing systems, following up on details, and making sure the right messages get to the right people at the right time?
If you're nodding your head, we want to talk to you.
Join our fast-growing US-based training and consulting company and help us ensure that every potential customer has a seamless, professional, and engaging experience—from the first click to a closed sale and beyond.

About PMO Strategies
At PMO Strategies, our mission is to change the world through IMPACT. We help organizations deliver more business value, faster, through smarter strategy execution.
We support project and transformation leaders with training, coaching, and consulting that helps them drive measurable results. Our clients include some of the world’s most forward-thinking organizations—and we’re growing fast.
Learn more:
PMOStrategies.com
IMPACTEngineBook.com

Position Overview

We’re seeking a Sales – Funnel Management Specialist to own, manage, and continuously improve our lead and sales funnel operations using Zoho CRM, ClickFunnels, and related tools.

This is not a cold-calling sales role.
It is a role that sits at the intersection of systems, sales support, and relationship-centered communication.

You’ll be the first line of coordination when a new lead enters our ecosystem—whether through a form, funnel opt-in, webinar, survey, or direct inquiry. Your responsibility is to ensure every lead is:

  • Routed correctly
  • Followed up thoughtfully
  • Tracked accurately
  • Supported with the right message at the right time

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, loves CRM systems, and understands that real sales success depends on human connection—not just automation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead & Funnel Management

  • Monitor all incoming leads via Zoho CRM, ClickFunnels, website forms, surveys, webinars, and direct inquiries.
  • Assign leads to the appropriate team member (sales, success coach, or automation workflow) based on defined criteria.
  • Ensure timely, accurate follow-up so no opportunity is missed.
  • Track lead status across the funnel and conduct regular audits to prevent lead leakage.
  • Maintain clean, accurate CRM data including tagging, lifecycle stages, and attribution.

Automation & CRM Operations

  • Build, maintain, and optimize automations using Zoho Campaigns, ClickFunnels, and Zapier.
  • Implement tagging structures to track campaign source, behavior, and funnel entry points.
  • Test and troubleshoot workflows regularly to ensure smooth transitions between funnel stages.
  • Maintain SOPs for lead handling, hand-offs, and system workflows.

Sales Support & Coordination

  • Maintain real-time visibility into deal and lead progression within the CRM.
  • Manage lead hand-off protocols to ensure warm leads are followed up within defined timeframes.
  • Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, partnerships, and operations teams to support high-conversion campaigns.
  • Support upsell and post-purchase nurture workflows to extend customer lifetime value.

Reporting & Funnel Optimization

  • Provide regular reporting on lead activity, conversion rates, velocity, and drop-off points.
  • Build dashboards and performance snapshots in Zoho CRM.
  • Identify friction points and recommend improvements to funnels, sequences, or hand-offs.
  • Monitor opt-in rates, email engagement, and CTA performance across funnels.

Relationship-Centered Lead Communication & Sales Support

This role carries a clear human expectation, not just a technical one.

You are expected to:
  • Treat every lead as a real person with unique goals, challenges, and motivations—not just a CRM record.
  • Craft thoughtful, context-aware written correspondence (emails, follow-ups, responses) that reflects our brand voice and builds trust.
  • Adapt tone, message, and timing based on lead behavior, stated needs, objections, and engagement signals.
  • Communicate directly with leads when appropriate to clarify needs, answer questions, or guide next steps—supporting sales conversations rather than disappearing behind automation.
  • Ensure the right message reaches the right person at the right moment, balancing high-touch communication with scalable systems.

This role succeeds when automation supports relationships—not replaces them.

Qualifications
  • Minimum of 3+ years in CRM, sales coordination, or funnel management roles.
  • Deep familiarity with CRM management and related tools (Zoho Campaigns, Forms, etc.).
  • Experience using ClickFunnels, Zapier, and other funnel or automation tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to write clear, human, sales-supportive messaging.
  • Highly tech-savvy and confident managing data, automations, and process flows.
  • Ability to work full-time during U.S. business hours (Eastern or Central Time).
  • Prior experience in a digital marketing, consulting, or online education environment is a plus.

Why Join PMO Strategies?
  • Be part of a passionate, high-performing team on a global mission.
  • Work from anywhere with a flexible schedule.
  • Gain direct access to visionary leadership and professional growth opportunities.
  • Help ensure high-value prospects are nurtured and never missed—making a real IMPACT.

How to Apply
Are you the follow-up champion we’ve been looking for?
Submit your resume, cover letter, and any examples of lead management experience (such as dashboards or SOPs you've created) in this app with the subject line I’m Your Sales Funnel Management Pro.
