Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and host of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we turn vision into value. Our mission is to help forward-thinking organizations close the gap between strategy design and execution using the IMPACT Engine System™—a proven transformation framework that builds internal capability, accelerates performance, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

We help organizations accelerate strategy delivery by operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change. From ambitious mid-sized companies to global enterprises, we enable clients to organize, operate, and deliver differently—so they can lead with greater agility, clarity, and confidence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Regional Delivery Lead—a highly experienced, strategy-minded consultant who can lead complex transformation engagements, guide enterprise teams, and coach leaders to operate as high-performing business navigators. You will deliver and scale the IMPACT Engine System™ across client organizations, building lasting value from the inside out.

This is a contract-to-permanent role designed for professionals who want to have true ownership in transformation—not just advise, but implement. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with executives to build high-IMPACT organizations that deliver on what matters most.

What You’ll Do

Client Delivery & Strategic Leadership

  • Lead full lifecycle implementation of PMO and transformation work across a portfolio of clients and industries, delivering tangible strategic value.
  • Conduct discovery and business alignment sessions that clarify strategic priorities, reveal root causes, and ensure the right focus areas.
  • Build and validate business cases, transformation roadmaps, and service portfolios that guide organizational change and stakeholder buy-in.
  • Design and drive transformation programs that include operational improvements, delivery capability building, KPI implementation, and process optimization.
  • Facilitate strategic workshops and decision sessions that accelerate alignment, build trust, and unlock forward momentum.

Operationalize Strategy Execution

  • Define and evolve PMO and transformation office capabilities to become agile, outcome-focused delivery engines.
  • Establish lean governance structures and performance-driven portfolio management practices that increase speed and accountability.
  • Implement scalable, high-IMPACT solutions that quickly demonstrate business value and build credibility from day one.

Coaching & Change Enablement

  • Coach transformation teams and executives to embrace an agile, business-first delivery mindset rooted in a value-focused approach.
  • Assess and enable change readiness with cultural sensitivity, helping clients lead change with—not to—their people.
  • Model and mentor strategic thinking and adaptive leadership while balancing stakeholder coaching with hands-on delivery.
  • Mentor client-side leaders to become self-sustaining IMPACT Drivers, capable of driving change long after our engagement ends.
  • Lead junior consultants and internal delivery staff, fostering high-performance mindsets and collaborative delivery excellence.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and implement KPI tracking systems that align with value realization frameworks—not just outputs, but true business impact.
  • Conduct delivery retrospectives and lessons learned to inform future iterations and optimize client performance.
  • Evolve client impact roadmaps quarterly, guiding the next cycle of value creation based on real results, not theoretical goals.
  • Contribute to internal innovation, advancing our methodology, content, and tools as part of our collective consulting brain trust.

What You Bring

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PMO, strategy execution, or transformation delivery roles—ideally with a consulting or advisory background.
  • Deep expertise in program/portfolio management, organizational change, and transformation leadership across multiple functions.
  • Exceptional facilitation and executive communication skills, with the ability to guide complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong grounding in organizational change management, with proven strategies for aligning people, culture, and systems during transformation.
  • Experience across methodologies and tools (e.g., Agile, SAFe, TOC, Waterfall, Lean, Planview, Planisware, Six Sigma).
  • PMP, PgMP, or similar certifications preferred; Prosci or change certifications a strong plus.
  • IMPACT Engine System™ Certification preferred (support provided if not already certified).
  • Consulting-firm experience preferred, particularly in client-facing transformation roles or cross-functional engagements.
  • Systems thinker and fast synthesizer, with the ability to go from ambiguity to clarity and from vision to execution rapidly.

Ideal Candidate

You are a strategic operator who thrives on solving messy problems, simplifying complexity, and enabling real business outcomes. You connect dots others miss, build momentum quickly, and lead with both confidence and empathy. You don’t just “manage projects”—you shape organizations.

We operate like a start-up inside a mature consulting firm: high trust, low politics, and obsessed with impact. If you want autonomy, collaboration, and a platform to do the best work of your career—this is your seat.

Why Join Us (Instead of a Big Firm)?

Think of us as what the big consulting companies could be—with soul.

  • You implement transformation, not just recommend it.
  • No armies of analysts, no layers of red tape. You work directly with executives and our leadership team.
  • You grow your own thought leadership, not just your billing hours.
  • You’ll help refine the system, not just follow one.
  • You’ll work on what matters. High-impact transformation. Strategic enablement. Long-term capability building.

Career Growth & Development

  • Advance quickly into more senior roles or client advisory positions as you demonstrate mastery.
  • Become a Strategy Navigator™, our highest-tier designation for advisors who shape strategy, not just delivery.
  • Participate in internal innovation and thought leadership, including speaking, writing, and contributing to new IES tools and approaches.
  • Access IES certification, advanced coaching, and mastermind communities to stay sharp and continually evolve your own leadership.

Engagement Model

  • Contract-to-hire: Initial consulting engagement with a strong path to a permanent leadership position.
  • Virtual-first work model, with travel to client locations as needed.
  • Compensation aligned with experience and engagement scope, with opportunities to grow.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining:

  • Why you're excited to join Global Transformation Group, PMO Strategies sister company
  • Relevant experience aligned with this role
  • Your availability and compensation expectations

We’re building something meaningful—and we’re looking for people who are ready to make an IMPACT.

Does this role feel wonderful but a bit intimidating? If you have some, but not all the experience, please submit anyway, as we are going to have multiple PMO and transformation delivery roles. You can also check out our other postings, such as the Project Manager role, that might be a closer fit.

Company:PMO Strategies

About PMO Strategies

At PMO Strategies, our mission is simple but powerful: to change the world through IMPACT. Headquartered in the United States, we are a globally recognized training, coaching, and consulting firm that empowers organizations to deliver higher returns on investment through strategic project delivery.

We support project managers, leaders, and executives by equipping them with the tools and knowledge they need to build high-performing teams, drive strategic results, and lead transformational change. With a growing client base and team, we’re scaling fast — and we need an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to help us take our reach and results to the next level.

Position Overview

*******

NOTE: WE NEED INFORMATION THIRD PARTY SITES ARE NOT COLLECTING IN ORDER TO PROCESS YOUR APPLICATION. WE RECOMMEND THAT YOU APPLY DIRECTLY ON OUR WEBSITE TO SAVE TIME AND GET YOUR COMPLETED APPLICATION IN FRONT OF OUR HIRING MANAGER THE FASTEST. THANK YOU!
*******
We’re seeking a dynamic Sales & Marketing Manager to help lead our revenue-driving efforts and coordinate a remote team responsible for executing campaigns, funnels, creative assets, and customer engagement activities. This is a hands-on role with strategic input — you’ll roll up your sleeves to execute and optimize marketing and sales initiatives while helping shape and refine the strategies that drive results.

We’re looking to make an investment in someone who wants to grow with us — someone motivated by high expectations, eager to learn, and excited to make a meaningful IMPACT in a growing company. You’ll have the opportunity to learn the inner workings of a fast-moving business, contribute ideas that shape how we scale, and see the direct results of your work as the company grows.

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the performance of marketing and sales initiatives, ensuring campaigns contribute directly to lead generation, conversions, and revenue growth. You’ll work closely with the Founder and leadership team to align activities with business goals and client needs, and you’ll coordinate with a remote team to keep projects moving, teams aligned, and results delivered — all with a strong focus on digital marketing and online sales funnels.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage the day-to-day execution of the sales and marketing function, including planning, implementation, performance tracking, and reporting.
  • Oversee the work of remote team members and contractors across creative, content, CRM, social media, and campaign delivery to ensure projects stay on track and meet quality standards.
  • Own the marketing calendar, coordinating launches, promotions, and campaigns to ensure timely delivery and alignment with company priorities.
  • Write, review, and approve sales and marketing copy, creative assets, and funnels — and support team members by coaching them on effective messaging and conversion-focused copywriting — to ensure brand alignment, quality, and performance before launch.
  • Track and analyze KPIs for campaigns, sales funnels, and launches, providing regular performance reports and actionable insights to leadership.
  • Manage CRM updates, lead routing, and sales process optimization to improve pipeline visibility, follow-up efficiency, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with the Founder and leadership team to translate business goals into executable sales and marketing strategies and initiatives.
  • Facilitate weekly planning and accountability meetings with the sales and marketing team to align priorities, review progress, and address roadblocks.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies in marketing and sales workflows and proactively drive solutions to improve results.
  • Maintain brand consistency and quality standards across all marketing and sales materials, ensuring messaging is clear, impactful, and aligned with company values.

Qualifications
  • Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience managing or coordinating sales and marketing activities, ideally in a digital-first enviroment such as online training, coaching, consulting, or B2B services.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and manage a small remote team, providing clear direction and ensuring accountability.
  • Proven expereince executing and optimizing online sales funnels, marketing automation workflows, and digital campaigns that drive measurable revenue growth.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and sales data to make informed decisions and improve performance.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, and collaboration skills, with the ability to thrive under pressure and manage competing priorities.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding marketing performance goals and contributing to business growth.
  • A growth-oriented mindset, motivated by high expectations and excited to continuously learn and develop new skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail — as part of your application, identify the mistake in this job description and refer to it in your submission.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Zoho, ClickUp, WordPress, Canva, Clickfunnels, and other marketing platforms.
  • Must be able to work full-time during U.S. business hours (Eastern or Central Time preferred).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Why Join PMO Strategies?
  • Collaborate with and coordinate a mission-driven remote team, focused on delivering measurable results and driving business growth.
  • Work directly with our Founder, a globally recognized thought leader in project management and strategy delivery.
  • See the direct results of your work — every campaign you execute will help accelerate growth, drive revenue, and deliver greater value to our clients.
  • Shape the evolution of a fast-growing business, gaining rare exposure to how strategy turns into action inside a scaling company.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities — we’re committed to investing in your growth as our company grows.
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment(with limited travel to conferences we sponsor a few times a year), allowing you to thrive from wherever you are.
  • Be part of something bigger — your work will help PMO and transformation leaders around the world deliver on their strategies and make a global IMPACT.

A Message from Our Founder

At PMO Strategies, we’re not just looking for a contractor — we’re looking for a partner who wants to build something meaningful alongside us. Our mission is to help PMO and transformation leaders around the world deliver on their strategies and make a global IMPACT, and the work you do here will play a vital part in that vision.

This role offers the chance to collaborate closely with our leadership team, gain unique visibility into the inner workings of a growing business, and stretch your skills on meaningful, high-impact projects. If you’re someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving problems, and gets excited about seeing the direct results of your work — I want to hear from you.

— Laura Barnard
Founder & CEO, PMO Strategies

How to Apply

If this position sounds like the perfect next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you. To apply, please complete the application on our website so that we have all the details we need, including:

  • A brief cover letter or introductiontelling us why this role excites you, how your skills align with what we’re looking for, and — most importantly — what lights you up about working with us. The more you show genuine interest in who we are and what we do, the more we’ll invest that same energy in getting to know you.

  • The completed candidate assessment that is part of the next steps on our website.

About Global Transformation Group

Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and hosts of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we help forward-thinking organizations accelerate strategy delivery by closing the gap between strategy design and execution. Leveraging the IMPACT Engine System™, we support clients in building internal capability, improving performance, and delivering measurable business results. We operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change—enabling mid-sized and global organizations to organize, operate, and deliver differently.

About the Role

We are looking for a Project Manager with experience leading delivery in transformation, PMO, or strategy execution environments. In this role, you’ll support end-to-end client engagements using the IMPACT Engine System™, ensuring that plans are executed smoothly, milestones are met, and teams are coordinated across initiatives.

This role is ideal for a proactive, detail-oriented delivery professional who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about helping organizations work smarter and deliver results that matter.

What You’ll Do

Project Coordination & Delivery Execution

  • Manage day-to-day delivery activities across engagements, ensuring progress against milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate multiple client workstreams, including scheduling, document management, reporting, and meeting facilitation.
  • Support client teams through each IES stage, helping deliver assessments, roadmaps, business cases, and MVP implementation.
  • Track action items, dependencies, and risks, escalating blockers early and ensuring visibility across stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment with the IES delivery framework, reinforcing use of standard tools and templates to drive consistency and quality.

Client Engagement & Communication

  • Act as the operational point of contact for client stakeholders and consultants, ensuring smooth information flow and collaboration.
  • Prepare agendas, briefing documents, and status reports to keep internal and client teams informed and on track.
  • Facilitate internal and client team meetings, capturing decisions, surfacing concerns, and maintaining momentum.
  • Support change management and communications activities, helping ensure messages are delivered consistently and timely.

Delivery Quality & Process Support

  • A collaborative, proactive mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Ideal Candidate

You’re an execution expert who loves structure, clarity, and progress. You thrive in dynamic environments, get satisfaction from making things run smoothly, and have an eye for both the details and the big picture. You’re collaborative, curious, and motivated by helping teams succeed.

If you’ve ever wanted to support meaningful transformation—not just manage tasks, but help teams deliver strategy and value—this is the role for you.

Working here is not like working at a typical consulting firm or corporate PMO:

  • You’ll implement real transformation, not just document it.
  • You’ll grow your expertise in the IMPACT Engine System™, a proven framework trusted by leading PMO and transformation teams.
  • You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values trust, autonomy, and learning.
  • You’ll have access to industry-leading training, tools, and coaching through our partnership with PMO Strategies.

  • Why you're interested in this role

jobs.excerpt: deine aufgaben • Du entwickelst und betreibst unsere Plattformen für skalierbare APIs und schaffst die technische Grundlage für unsere Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams.
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst unsere Plattformen für skalierbare APIs und schaffst die technische Grundlage für unsere Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams.
  • Du standardisierst und automatisierst Infrastruktur-, Deploy­ment- und Betriebsprozesse, damit Teams Software schnell, sicher und eigenständig ausliefern können.
  • Du konzipierst, implementierst und optimierst Cloud-native Plattformlösungen auf Basis von Kubernetes, Docker und Infrastructure as Code.
  • Du baust und betreust moderne CI/CD-Pipelines sowie GitOps-Workflows und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Software-Lifecycle.
  • Du entwickelst eigenes Plattform-Tooling sowie interne Services und APIs in Go, Python oder Rust.
  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer API-Infrastruktur, einschließlich API-Gateways, Authentifizierungs- und Autorisierungskonzepte.
  • Du stellst Zuverlässigkeit, Performance und Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform durch Monitoring, Logging, Tracing und Performance-Optimierungen sicher.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwicklungsteams zusammen und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Developer Experience durch standardisierte Plattformservices und Self-Service-Angebote.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung moderner Sicherheitskonzepte wie Zero Trust, Secrets Management und Netzwerksegmentierung.

das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver Cloud- und Container-Plattformen, idealerweise mit Kubernetes und Docker.
  • Du beherrschst Infrastructure as Code, vorzugsweise mit Terraform, und arbeitest routiniert in modernen Cloud-Umgebungen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit API-Gateways sowie gängigen API-Standards und -Technologien wie REST, gRPC, GraphQL und OpenAPI.
  • Du kennst dich mit modernen Authentifizierungs- und Sicherheitsverfahren wie OAuth2, OIDC, JWT oder mTLS aus.
  • Du hast bereits CI/CD-Pipelines und Automatisierungslösungen mit Tools wie GitHub Actions, GitLabCI oder ArgoCD aufgebaut und betrieben.
  • Du programmierst sicher in mindestens einer Backend-Sprache wie Go, Python oder Rust und entwickelst gerne eigene Plattformlösungen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Observability mit und arbeitest mit Monitoring-, Logging- und Tracing-Lösungen wie Prometheus, Grafana oder OpenTelemetry.
  • Themen wie SRE, Verfügbarkeit, Incident Management, Skalierung und Performance-Optimierung sind für dich gelebte Praxis.
  • Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von Netzwerken, Lastverteilung, DNS sowie modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen.
  • Du denkst aus Sicht der Nutzer:innen deiner Plattform und hast Freude daran, die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.
  • Du lebst in Deutschland und verfügst über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis.

wieso polarise?

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Trage dazu bei, die Geschichte eines der spannendsten KI-Infrastrukturunternehmen Europas von Anfang an mitzugestalten und Europas technologische Unabhängigkeit im Bereich KI zu stärken.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Arbeite mit direktem Zugang zum C-Level und gestalte die technische Grundlage unserer Plattform aktiv mit. Du triffst Entscheidungen mit echtem Impact auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und die Developer Experience unserer Teams.
  • Starkes Team: Werde Teil eines wachsenden, hochmotivierten Tech-Teams und arbeite eng mit erfahrenen Engineers und technischen Führungskräften zusammen.
  • Remote-Arbeitsmodell: Arbeite auf eine Weise, die dir hilft, Beruf, Familie und Privatleben wirklich in Einklang zu bringen.

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About IT

The IT team enables Affirmers to work securely and efficiently. We manage internal devices, networks, and systems, ensuring employees can collaborate and perform at their best. Our team supports onboarding, troubleshooting, and scaling technology across locations. We focus on usability, reliability, and security to maintain a productive work environment. The IT team ensures that Affirmers have the tools and support they need—wherever they work.

About the role

As an IT Product Manager, you'll help Affirmers embrace new ways of working and get more value from the technology they use every day. Partnering with IT leadership and teams across Affirm, you'll translate employee needs into product priorities, shape technology roadmaps and lifecycle decisions, and drive adoption of collaboration, productivity, and emerging AI-powered capabilities.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a collaborative, adaptable IT Product Manager to help Affirmers work more effectively by shaping how we manage, use, and adopt collaboration, productivity, and AI-powered workplace technologies.

  • You will partner with IT leadership to define and manage priorities for Affirm's collaboration and productivity tools, including Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and emerging AI-powered technologies.
  • You will turn employee needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into clear requirements, practical solutions, and actionable roadmaps that guide technology improvements.
  • You will help guide the technology lifecycle, from evaluating new solutions and developing business cases to optimizing existing investments, supporting vendor renewals, and recommending when to consolidate or retire tools.
  • You will lead the rollout and adoption of new tools, features, and AI-powered capabilities, partnering with Internal Communications, business leaders, and employee champions to help Affirmers navigate change with confidence.
  • You will connect Affirmers with practical guidance, self-service resources, and learning opportunities—leveraging vendor expertise, existing materials, and on-demand options—to help them build confidence and get more value from workplace technology.
  • You will define success measures, use employee feedback, adoption data, and support trends to evaluate outcomes, and recommend improvements that enhance the employee experience and inform technology priorities.
  • You will partner with IT Engineering, Security, Legal, Procurement, and vendors to deliver solutions that balance employee needs, business value, technical feasibility, cost, and risk.

What We Look For

You bring hands-on technology experience, a product mindset, and a people-first approach to solving problems, collaborating across teams, and helping others embrace change.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in IT product or program management, workplace technology, technology-focussed organizational change management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • You have experience identifying and delivering improvements to employee workflows through enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms, such as Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, or similar technologies, and are eager to apply that same approach to emerging AI capabilities.
  • You have experience gathering stakeholder needs, defining requirements, prioritizing opportunities, and developing actionable plans or roadmaps for technology solutions.
  • You have experience leading technology rollouts, organizational change initiatives, or employee adoption programs that help people confidently embrace new tools and ways of working.
  • You communicate clearly with different audiences and have experience identifying, organizing, and sharing resources that help employees understand and adopt workplace technologies.
  • You use data, employee feedback, and support trends to evaluate technology adoption, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • You build effective relationships across technical and business teams, using sound judgment to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions without direct authority.

Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - 180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - 165,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Description

Regional Sales Director

About the Job

Location: Remote - U.S. East Coast (within the territory)

Territory: East Region - U.S. East Coast (New England, New York/New Jersey, Mid-Atlantic and Southeast) and Eastern Canada

Reports to: VP of Sales

Quota: Regional team quota for the East Region

Compensation: The expected annual base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $225,000, plus performance-based commission, equity, and benefits.

About Us

Novee is the AI penetration testing platform built for a world where attackers operate at machine speed. Founded in Tel Aviv in April 2025 by a team with decades of nation-state offensive security experience - including veterans of Unit 8200, Iron Dome, and elite zero-day research - we're turning that expertise into a platform that thinks like a real attacker, runs continuously, and uncovers the novel vulnerabilities that manual testers and scanners miss.

We raised $51.5M in four months, backed by top investors YL Ventures, Canaan Partners, and Oren Zeev - one of the fastest funding trajectories in offensive security. Our proprietary AI model outperforms frontier LLMs by over 55% on real exploitation benchmarks, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for exceptional people to join our mission: making continuous, intelligent offensive security the new standard.

About the Role

We're hiring our first Regional Sales Director to build and lead Novee's sales organization across the territory.

You'll lead all of our Account Executives in the territory, own the regional number, and turn early traction into a predictable, scalable revenue engine.

You'll work closely with the VP of Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Channels and Product to shape our go-to-market motion in the region, coach the team through complex enterprise and mid-market deals, and step in personally on strategic opportunities.

This is a foundational leadership role for a hands-on sales leader who has built and scaled teams in a high-growth cybersecurity company and still loves being close to customers and deals.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop all Account Executives across the territory, and own the region's bookings target.
  • Build the regional sales function from the ground up: territory design, account planning, hiring plan and team structure.
  • Recruit, onboard and ramp new Account Executives as the team grows.
  • Drive a consistent, disciplined sales process and deal qualification (e.g., MEDDPICC) across the team.
  • Get hands-on in strategic deals: executive engagement with CISOs and security leaders, negotiation and closing.
  • Own pipeline generation and coverage for the region, together with Marketing, SDRs and Channel partners.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on discovery, demonstrations, technical evaluations and proof-of-value processes.
  • Provide accurate, timely forecasts and pipeline reporting to the VP of Sales and the leadership team.
  • Ensure complete and current account, opportunity and deal information in the CRM.
  • Bring field insights on customer needs, competition and pricing back to Product, Marketing and leadership.
  • Represent Novee at customer meetings, industry events and conferences across the territory.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience within the cybersecurity industry — a must.
  • 3+ years leading and developing quota-carrying Account Executive teams, with a proven track record of hitting team targets.
  • Proven success building or scaling a sales team or region in a high-growth startup.
  • Strong personal track record closing complex, high-value deals with CISOs and security leaders.
  • Deep understanding of the cybersecurity market in the territory and an existing network in the region.
  • Experience and success working with early-stage Israeli startups.
  • Strong command of forecasting, pipeline management and sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).
  • Proficiency in CRM systems such as HubSpot and sales analytics and reporting tools.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders at all levels.
  • Highly organized, self-driven and entrepreneurial, comfortable building in a fast-changing environment.
  • Based on the U.S. East Coast, within the territory, with the ability and willingness to travel across the region as required.

Advantages

  • Technical knowledge or familiarity with offensive security, application security, infrastructure, or DevOps tools.
  • Experience being the first sales leader in a new region.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers and MSSPs.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build and lead Novee's sales organization in the region from day one.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values initiative, creativity, and ownership.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity.
  • Competitive compensation with strong performance-based incentives.
  • The opportunity to make a direct, meaningful impact on the company's growth and success.

jobs.description:
Staff Product Designer

Why YOU want this position

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

About the Role

Enverus is looking for a Staff Product Designer to help bring structure, clarity, and a shared design practice to a product organization that is growing fast and scaling its design foundations. This is not a role where you inherit a mature design process. You’ll help create one: deciding what good looks like, setting the standards others follow, and building the systems that let the company move faster with more coherence.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy and craft. You’ll help decide what to build and why, not only how it should look and work.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Product Influence

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.
  • Help define product strategy by connecting user research and behavioral insight with business direction.
  • Shape the “what and why” of product decisions, not only the “how.”
  • Work with ambiguous problem spaces and help turn them into clear, actionable direction.

Design Systems and Foundations

  • Partner with design system manager to evolve, and govern shared foundations, aligning on standards where systems overlap and making deliberate decisions where they diverge across Enverus products.
  • Establish patterns, components, and principles that scale across squads and reduce inconsistency.
  • Operate across squads to ensure coherence, quality, and long-term scalability of the product experience.
  • Read and write front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React) well enough to prototype in production-like conditions, review implementation details, and collaborate closely with Engineering on how the system is built and maintained.

Leading Through Ambiguity

  • Bring structure to a complex, evolving organization: create clarity where little exists today, without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Design ways of working that fit both agile product teams and the more waterfall-style processes that exist across the business.
  • Lead large initiatives that span multiple product areas or systems.

Craft and Quality

  • Set design standards and lead critiques and design reviews across teams.
  • Simplify complex workflows, particularly in data-heavy and domain-specific products.
  • Raise the bar on craft, from interaction details to information architecture to visual systems.

Influence and Communication

  • Frame design vision in business and user terms, and make the case for it to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Align multiple teams around a shared direction, and facilitate discussions that lead to clear decisions.
  • Tell compelling stories with research, prototypes, and data to build conviction.

Mentorship and Capability Building

  • Mentor designers across teams and help grow the design practice from the ground up.
  • Influence design decisions beyond the design team, across the wider Enverus organization.
  • Help build the culture, processes, and habits that a design-led organization needs.

Working with AI

  • Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.
  • Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.
  • Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.
  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • At least 3 years of experience in a staff, senior, or equivalent product design role, with demonstrated ownership of complex work.
  • Strong, mature product design craft across interaction, visual, and systems design.
  • Working knowledge of front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React), enough to collaborate effectively with engineers on design system implementation and product delivery.
  • Experience working in agile product environments, and comfort working within waterfall processes where they exist.
  • Proven ability to establish structure and build systems within an organization that lacks formal processes.
  • Comfort working across multiple design systems or product-specific component libraries.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • High autonomy: you make design decisions, push back when needed, and manage trade-offs without needing detailed oversight.
  • Hands-on curiosity about AI tools and a practical sense of how they can change design and development work.

Preferred

  • Experience building or scaling a design system.
  • Experience designing for complex, data-intensive, or B2B domain products.
  • Experience introducing design practice or process into a company that is early in its design maturity.
  • Experience mentoring designers or leading design reviews across teams.
  • Experience using AI tools in a design or prototyping workflow, and a point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

Benefits

  • Medical

  • Dental

  • Vision

  • Life, AD&D, Disability, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Lifestyle & Wellbeing Program

  • Pet Insurance

jobs.description:
EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. As an AI-enabled service leader, we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO, we’re driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Product Manager will partner with a cross-functional team to bring the EBSCOhost AI Companion functionality to market, with a specific focus on Linked Data functionality powered by the EBSCO Scholarly Graph (ESG). The EBSCOhost AI Companion is a suite of research workflows that help users discover, understand, and engage with research content through natural-language conversational interactions – all powered by AI and Linked Data. Answers / responses are grounded in authoritative EBSCOhost content and include references and links, with further enrichment through industry data services. You will help develop and bring to market solutions for direct use by library users and researchers of all varieties. The Product Manager will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Technology and other departments.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute go-to-market efforts for EBSCOhost AI Companion features, especially those powered by Linked Data from EBSCO Scholarly Graph

  • Collaborate with Technical teams to communicate market needs and feedback

  • Facilitate meetings with library customers and publisher partners, to discuss EBSCOhost AI Companion Linked Data features and benefits, and conduct Beta testing programs with customers and end-users.

  • Define metrics, measure, and assess the impact of AI Companion’s Linked Data functionality post-launch.

  • Build and deliver stakeholder updates

  • Drive business requirements for future roadmap items

Your Team

This role reports to a Vice President of Product Management and works closely with teams across Product Management, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Satisfaction. The Product Management team is comprised of 30+ Product Managers who represent different platform and functionality level initiatives. The team is customer-facing and drives business requirements across the EBSCOhost suite of products and services.

About You

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience
  • Must have experience working closely with customers
  • Comfortable presenting internally and externally, including in stakeholder forums
  • Experience working with Linked Data, knowledge graphs, and library data providers
  • Ability to work collaboratively across the organization with various teams

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience working specifically with Scopus, ORCID, CrossRef, and OpenAlex
  • Understanding of the library industry and how libraries leverage EBSCO products
  • Strength in building a go to market plan from the ground up
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to build credibility with team members and stakeholders.

Pay Range

USD $108,610.00 - USD $155,155.00 /Yr.

jobs.excerpt: We Are: Accenture LearnVantage helps organizations transform how their people learn and work.
jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture LearnVantage helps organizations transform how their people learn and work. We partner with enterprise clients to design and deliver high-quality, scalable, outcome-driven learning that builds the skills their workforces need. Udacity, now part of Accenture LearnVantage, brings deep expertise in technical upskilling through hands-on, project-based online learning. Together we build learning experiences that help people gain in-demand skills in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and more.


You Are:

You are analytical, curious, and highly attentive to detail. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, but you do not guess when the evidence is not there. You like finding the connection between things that may not obviously fit together, and you have the judgment to recognize when something does not align or needs a closer look. You work well within established standards and methods while knowing when to ask questions, challenge assumptions, or raise a risk. You are someone others can rely on for thoughtful, accurate work in a specialized and evolving industry.


The Work:

The Credentialing & Assessments team within Learning Experience connects business and workforce needs with practical solutions for validating skills, knowledge, and experience. As a Credentialing & Assessments Sr Analyst, you will help translate those needs into approaches that are credible, feasible, and aligned to industry practices. Working across internal initiatives and client delivery, you will provide support needed to shape solutions, inform decisions, and move credentialing and assessment work from concept through delivery.

  • Support job task analysis, job analysis, and competency analysis activities by gathering, organizing, mapping, and documenting role and skill requirements.
  • Develop and maintain rubrics and structured evaluation frameworks used to evaluate skills, performance, evidence, work products, or other defined criteria.
  • Conduct alignment mapping and crosswalks across competencies, skills, tasks, learning and assessment objectives, credential requirements, and learning content to established methodologies.
  • Conduct mapping audits and gap analyses to identify missing, insufficient, duplicated, or misaligned coverage across learning, assessment, skills, or credential requirements.
  • Support credential and assessment development activities, including blueprinting, documentation, quality review, validation activities, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Research and analyze credentialing requirements, partner requirements, credential applicability, and alignment to learning and workforce needs.
  • Contribute Credentialing & Assessment expertise to Accenture client delivery teams by executing assigned analyses, workstreams, and deliverables, with 50% of role supporting client delivery.
  • In this role, you will work in the Credentialing & Assessment team and report into a Credentialing & Assessment Associate Manager. This position is US remote.

What's In It for You?

  • You will expand your credentialing and assessment experience across a wide range of business, workforce, and client needs.
  • You will work across learning, skills, assessment, credentialing, and workforce use cases, building a broader view of how these areas connect and inform one another.
  • You will gain exposure to both internal initiatives and client delivery, working alongside practitioners and stakeholders across different industries, technologies, and business challenges.
  • Accenture will continually invest in your craft and growth, with access to certifications, learning resources, and a global community of practitioners

Here's What You Need:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in learning operations, curriculum coordination, credentialing, program administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience maintaining documentation and status trackers across multiple concurrent workstreams using spreadsheets, shared drives, or project tracking tools.
  • Minimum 1 year experience applying credentialing, certification, accreditation, or licensing standards and practices.
  • Bachelor's degree, associate’s degree with 6 years of equivalent work experience, or 12 years of equivalent work experience.

Bonus Points If:

  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to support analysis, document review, summarization, and content auditing.
  • You have experience conducting job task analysis and applying job analysis methodologies.
  • You have experience with assessment design, development, quality assurance, and assessment and item analysis.
  • You have experience with credential issuance, digital badging, or related platforms.
  • You have experience in technical training or technology-focused educational content.
  • You have experience coordinating with external partners, vendors, or governing bodies.

jobs.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team in Brazil.
jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. In this role, you will become part of a small, senior product engineering team for an established US mental health platform where clients book licensed psychologists and psychotherapists, complete with US insurance integrations and subscription billing. You will take full end-to-end ownership of product features—from frontend architecture to backend services and cloud deployment—leveraging a modern stack based on React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Delivery: Design, implement, and deploy robust full-stack features from initial concept through production rollout
  • Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture, including component libraries, design systems, state management, and clear module boundaries for the engineering team
  • Backend & API Development: Build and maintain scalable backend services and APIs (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC), covering authentication, RBAC, billing workflows, and audit logging
  • Code Quality & Testing: Write clean, secure, and maintainable code; establish and drive a risk-based testing strategy with strong end-to-end test coverage
  • Internal Tooling & AI Adoption: Develop internal productivity tooling (CLIs, agent-based workflows) and proactively utilize AI coding tools as force multipliers
  • Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, champion engineering best practices, and mentor teammates in adopting modern standards
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, UX/UI design, and executive leadership to shape the roadmap and guide core UX decisions

Requirements:

  • Experience: 6+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling SaaS products as a Full Stack Engineer
  • Communication: Upper-Intermediate to Advanced (Fluent) English proficiency, both written and spoken
  • Software Design & Architecture:
    • Demonstrated experience designing solutions for complex features and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation
    • Deep understanding of API architectural styles (monolith, microservices, serverless), design patterns, and engineering standards
    • Hands-on experience defining frontend architecture (design systems, shared component libraries) utilized by multiple developers
    • Proven ownership of critical product domains from discovery to launch (e.g., onboarding, billing, access control)
  • Software Development:
    • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and advanced React patterns
    • Solid background in Node.js or Python building high-performance backend services; willingness and ability to work primarily in a Python / FastAPI codebase
    • Strong relational database skills in PostgreSQL (data modeling, schema design, complex queries, and aggregations)
    • Practical commercial experience with distributed systems and event-driven patterns using message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.)
  • Quality Assurance:
    • Hands-on experience with modern testing frameworks across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest)
    • Ability to define, track, and maintain code quality metrics; familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools
  • DevOps & Cloud Deployment:
    • Practical knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
    • Experience deploying, configuring, and operating backend services on a public cloud (GCP or AWS)
  • Ways of Working:
    • High degree of autonomy and seniority: ability to lead a problem space independently, balance technical trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Availability for a 3–4 hour daily working overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) for key ceremonies, planning, and stand-ups

Desirable:

  • Prior experience as a Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, or core team member at an early-stage or growth-stage product company
  • Domain knowledge in HealthTech / Digital Health (HIPAA compliance, health insurance workflows) or FinTech / Payments
  • Production experience with Stripe billing, subscription life-cycles, and payment processing
  • Familiarity with Micro-frontends, Next.js, React Native, or Expo
  • Hands-on experience with Go, Elixir / Phoenix, or gRPC
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / GKE)
  • Experience developing MCP servers, CLI developer tools, or LLM-assisted internal automations
  • Active involvement in hiring, conducting technical interviews, and mentoring junior/middle engineers
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

You will be executing on our inbound/outbound sales motion that supports the hyper-growth & scale of the Sales team at Megaport. In this role, you will have the chance to implement creative processes along the way & shape the world-class processes we are implementing.

Your priority is to respond to our prospects, qualify if Megaport is a suitable solution, and generate new meetings and opportunities from inbound marketing qualified leads and outbound prospecting campaigns.

Who You'll Work With

As a member of this team, you will report to our Sales Development Manager in our GTM Transformation team. You will support the Sales organization and partner with the team closely to execute a winning growth strategy. Most importantly, you'll be joining a tight-knit team of driven SDRs where the bar is high and the culture is higher – we genuinely care about each person winning, and our goal is simple: make you want to punch the air every morning when you show up to work!

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Use Phone/Email/LinkedIn to connect with prospective customers.

  • Follow up, manage, and drive qualified inbound marketing leads to book a meeting and create sales opportunities, with the mission to effectively grow the sales pipeline to achieve our regional revenue goals.

  • Utilize and leverage our various sales and lead generation tools to identify, develop and manage marketing leads effectively including Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks and Zoominfo.

  • Learn & understand how Megaport solutions address various customer pain points. Be able to communicate Megaport value prop to manager and practitioner personas.

  • Identify and source sales opportunities that align with the ideal customer profile for Megaport for the purposes of maximizing solution value and product adoption.

  • Manage & interact with prospects via our website live chat tool.

  • Work side by side with Megaport Sales Executives and other Megaport sellers to help drive Megaport revenue growth.

  • Acquire, update and maintain contact information within the Salesforce CRM, providing the account team with information to ensure opportunities are understood and next steps are clearly identified. Work in coordination with sales executives, solution architects and broader POD account teams to identify potential customers, qualify and schedule demonstrations.

  • Keep informed on new products, services, and other general information of interest to customers, through successful completion of sales training and self-study.

  • Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to execute various demand generation campaigns.

  • Invite and drive attendance to company events and regional trade shows.

  • Develop your sales career through ongoing training and 1:1 coaching.

    • This is an individual contributor and compensation carrying position.

What We Are Looking For

    We are looking for individuals who have a passion to work in a high growth environment and grow their sales career. We expect team members to have the following:

  • Action oriented and highly organized individual who is resourceful, result oriented & adaptable.

  • Excellent time management skills.

  • Strong work ethic & drive to be successful in ambiguous situations, self-motivated, able to solve problems and work with limited direction.

  • A goal-oriented and customer-focused mindset.

  • Ability to handle fast-paced change with new processes and the ability to fail fast & learn fast.

  • Excellent listening, verbal and written communications skills.

  • Display self-discipline and focus to effectively manage an intense and high volume business.

  • A growth mindset, consistently working to improve your skills, be open to feedback and learn constantly.

  • Ability to achieve and exceed weekly, monthly and quarterly goals and production levels as defined by sales management.

  • Ability to build meaningful business relationships with customers, prospects and internal team mates.


    • Preferred but not required

  • A basic understanding of SaaS and/or networking, cloud offerings.

  • Has experience in a fast paced or start up environment.

  • 6+ months of B2B sales development (SDR / ADR / BDR) experience preferred

  • Speaks Japanese

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available
  • Generous leave plans – including 4 weeks of paid annual leave, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely
  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos awards
  • For U.S. employees – access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus a 401(k) plan

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

Role summary

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.

Why this role matters

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work. You will be the person who tracks, communicates, and resolves cross-team dependencies so engineers can stay focused on technical delivery, and leaders can focus on strategy and people.

What you'll do

  • Manage the OKR and epic portfolio across all three programs, including creation, refinement, sequencing, and status tracking.
  • Lead ongoing reprioritization as scope and demand change and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Work with team leads, so each team's agile funnel reflects current priorities and supports committed delivery dates.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early.
  • Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio.
  • Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones.
  • Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early.
  • Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams.

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education.
  • A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies.
  • Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile).
  • Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management.
  • Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives.
  • Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence.
  • Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping.
  • PMP, SAFe, or similar certification (nice to have, not required).

Success measures for the first 6 to 12 months

  • A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM.
  • Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates.
  • Cross-team blockers resolved on a predictable cadence.
  • ASM success measures defined, with regular reporting to leadership.
  • A reduction in program coordination work carried by managers and engineers.

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management. This position involves leading the development of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) plans, conducting study risk assessments, identifying study KRIs (in collaboration with Functional leads), performing ongoing centralized statistical monitoring, remote centralized data review, and facilitating monthly RBQM meetings. works independently and manages report review and issue escalation for more complex studies and/or portfolios of work. Further, the Central Monitor may mentor junior colleagues, and may support the development of processes, procedures and other documentation to ensure a high functioning team

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Lead Development of RBQM Plan: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement comprehensive RBQM plans tailored to each study's specific needs - including identification of critical data & process, definition of KRIs & QTLs and centralized monitoring approach
  • Study Risk Assessment: Conduct thorough risk assessments for clinical studies, identifying potential issues and developing mitigation strategies, in consultation with functional team leads and PM
  • Centralized Statistical Monitoring: Perform centralized statistical monitoring & data analysis on study data to detect anomalies, trends, and potential risks, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
  • RBQM Meetings: lead facilitation of monthly RBQM meetings by supporting review of study data, documenting findings, action plans and coordination of data cleaning activities to support study deliverables
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of data quality and integrity through proactive monitoring and timely interventions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and other departments to support proactive oversight and management and data cleaning for studies
  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on monitoring activities, findings, and recommendations for sponsors and study teams.
  • Operational Insights: Oversee operational study metrics, including data entry trends, SDV backlog, site health trending and proactively communicate issues to study team members to drive towards resolution & proactive remediation
  • Mentor and Support Junior Colleagues: Act as a mentor to more junior Central Monitors - sharing best practices, lessons learned, etc. to improve team performance
  • Sponsor Engagement and Communications: support discussions with Sponsors around risk management and proactive data cleaning

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 5 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and the clinical development process

Other Required:

  • Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English, including strong grammar and scientific vocabulary skills
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Strong understanding of RBQM principles and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems, clinical systems, dashboards, and to leverage these data to assess risk
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management
  • Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

  • CRO experience as a Central Monitor

Skills:

  • Statistical analysis and data monitoring
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Report writing and presentation
  • Collaboration and teamwork

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers

  • Annual professional development budget

  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.
