jobs.title: Web Engineer, Growth
jobs.excerpt: Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS.
jobs.description:
Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.

About the role
You'll build the site, run it, and make it the place enterprise data teams go to discover, see, and try our product, as buyer behavior shifts toward doing more of the research on their own. It's a role for a web developer or engineer who wants to own the whole site, not a slice of it.

We're a small growth team that likes to build. You'll be the team's only engineer, reporting to the Sr. Director, Growth, and working every day with growth, product marketing, and content. As AI changes how marketing gets done, we're investing in how we work: prototyping first, and creating a builder suite that lets the whole team build, not just engineers. You'll have a direct line to the outcome.

What sets this role apart:
  • The site is yours. You're the engineer who owns it, with the tools and support to do it well. You decide how it's built and run, with the freedom to move quickly from an idea to a live page. Owning it runs both ways: when something breaks, it's yours to fix.
  • You'll shape how the site looks, not just how it works.Working from our brand system, you'll take ideas from a prototype, a draft, or a two-line brief to a finished page, with a real say in the design.
  • Every visit counts.Our buyers are a focused, technical audience, so who visits matters as much as how many. You'll make sure every change can be measured, and work with marketing and sales to decide what worked.
  • Today the site runs on WordPress, with PostHog for product analytics.You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves as the site grows.

What you'll do

  • Help marketers ship on their own.Build the foundation of components and templates they launch pages from, so the result looks right without a design review. Step in to add new components when they hit a limit, and build new ideas end to end when they need something the system can't do yet.
  • Improve the journeys that matter most.Work from the homepage and platform pages through to the free trial, demos, and proof-of-value requests. Bring an experimentation mindset: treat each change as a test, judge it by its results, and ship behind feature flags.
  • Build new ways to understand, see, and try the product. Buyers now research with AI and want to try software on their own before they talk to sales. Give them walkthroughs, demos, assessments, and an assistant: start small, scale what they use, and build each one as a pattern we can reuse. You'll shape where this goes with marketing.
  • Run the site and evolve its architecture. Own hosting, security, releases with preview and rollback, performance, consent and accessibility, and structured data for search and AI answers. Shape the architecture and platform underneath so the site keeps up with what we want to build next.
  • Make every conversion land. Every form, chat, or demo signup is captured, matched to the right account, and routed to its owner while the visitor is still on the site. You'll partner on the event schema and own how it's implemented, including what happens when a match fails.
  • Lend engineering depth. Pitch in on the internal AI tools our team builds, helping make them production-ready.

How we'll measure success
From the start, you'll get hands-on with the site's code, its hosting, and every path a buyer takes to reach us. Expect to keep it running and ship improvements while you learn it. From there, success looks like this:
  • When the right buyers convert, it reaches the right person within minutes.
  • Marketers can ship more on their own each quarter.
  • Your changes hold up, and when one causes a problem, it's fixed quickly.
  • Every change has a clear goal, and we decide whether to keep it based on the result.

What you bring

  • Production web engineering. You've built and run a marketing site from components to release, and kept it running when something broke.
  • Reusable page building. You've taken a two-line brief to a shipped page with no designer, and built it so others could reuse it.
  • CMS experience.You've built and updated pages in WordPress or a similar CMS, and you're comfortable picking up a modern front end like React.
  • Forms and CRM integration.You've connected a site's forms or signups to a CRM so each one reaches the right account and owner, and added checks to keep it that way.
Nice to have
You don't need all of these. Most people we'd hire bring experience in two:
  • Improving a page using experiment results, account-level behavior and what sales told you
  • A headless CMS (such as Sanity or Contentful) with a modern front end (React, Next.js, or Astro)
  • A custom capture layer or a thin backend for a marketing site
  • Interactive experiences such as guided product tours, AI assistants, hands-on sandboxes, or personalized pages
  • Structured data that changed how pages appear in search or AI answers
  • A design system, in Figma or in code
  • A multilingual site
  • Getting to know an established codebase quickly, and changing its architecture safely while it stays live
Don't match every line? We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than whether you've done this exact job before. If you're curious and learn quickly, we'd still like to hear from you.

Why Semarchy

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

Semarchy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates difference. We're committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, genetic information, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We're building a workplace where everyone feels they belong.

Knit is the AI-native research agency helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

The Managing Director, Research is a senior people leadership role with significant ownership of people strategy, talent development, and adoption of Knit's AI tools. You will build and develop a team of Directors and Senior Directors, giving them the direction, resources, and support to lead exceptional teams and grow customer relationships.

Responsibilities | What you will own...

You will be accountable for portfolio growth and retention, strong leadership and talent, measurable AI adoption, and reliable delivery. Success means teams meet quality and speed expectations while maintaining healthy utilization, project margins, and sustainable workloads, with customer and researcher feedback shaping continuous Product improvements.

Team leadership | 60%

  • Build and lead the organization. Shape the people strategy, team structure, and leadership capacity needed to support portfolio growth. Align hiring and staffing with customer needs, revenue goals, and productivity opportunities. Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop exceptional leaders and talent. Coach and unblock Directors and Senior Directors, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for business results, research quality, and team health. Own performance management, talent development, and succession planning, creating meaningful growth opportunities for high-potential talent and supporting employee engagement and retention.
  • Drive adoption of Knit's AI tools. Make effective use of Knit's AI tools a core expectation, coaching your team to embed them throughout the research process. Track adoption and improvements in quality, speed, and productivity, remove barriers, and share successful approaches across teams.
  • Build capacity and unblock delivery. Manage staffing and capacity across the portfolio. Resolve resource constraints, cross-functional barriers, and delivery risks while maintaining research quality, healthy utilization, project margins, and sustainable workloads.

Customer management | 20%

  • Own the performance of a key book of business. Own growth, retention, and overall portfolio performance. Partner with researchers, Customer Success partners, and Sales partners to address renewal risks and expand customer relationships. Translate portfolio goals into clear priorities and accountability for each leader and team.
  • Support critical customer moments. Partner on escalations, key renewals, and strategic customer conversations. Give Directors and Senior Directors the senior leadership support they need while ensuring they remain the senior research leads on their accounts.

Product partnership | 20%

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to improve how research gets delivered. Bring a portfolio-wide perspective on customer needs and researcher workflows to help Product prioritize improvements that strengthen customer value and team effectiveness. Support testing of new capabilities and lead adoption across teams.

Required Skills & Experiences

Required:

  • Seasoned market research leader with a strong understanding of quantitative and qualitative methods and what excellent research delivery looks like for enterprise customers.
  • Experience managing people leaders and multiple research teams, with a track record of developing senior talent and building accountable, high-performing organizations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a customer portfolio, including retention, expansion, executive relationships, and resolution of complex customer issues.
  • Experience translating business goals into hiring, staffing, capacity, and talent development plans, balancing delivery quality, team health, utilization, and profitability.
  • Ability to lead organizational change and drive adoption of new tools and ways of working, with measurable improvements in quality, speed, or productivity.
  • Strong cross-functional judgment and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Product, Sales, and Customer Success and lead through ambiguity and competing priorities.

Benefits

Our benefits include equity options; medical, dental, and vision insurance; additional coverage; a company laptop and a one-time technology stipend for onboarding; a company-matched 401(k); and flexible time off. Compensation includes a base salary and variable pay.

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are $250,000-$265,000, comprising base salary and variable compensation. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We strive to be a championship team. Our values guide how we work:

  • Are 1% better every day: Stay curious, learn continuously, and look for ways to improve the business.
  • Play to win: Aim high, take initiative, and follow through with accountability.
  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Focus our energy on the work that matters most.

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power every marketing, product and commercial decision across the business. We're looking for a Data Science leader who believes machine learning only creates value when it changes business decisions.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.

You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.

Responsibilties:

  • Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.
  • Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.
  • Innovation & Industry Leadership: Represent Forbes in strategic conversations with technology partners including Google and Meta while staying connected to advances in AI, machine learning and marketing science. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.

Qualifications:

  • Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
  • Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
  • Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
  • Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
  • Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
  • Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
  • Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
  • A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
  • Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
  • Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
  • Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
  • Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
  • Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
  • Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 8+ years in direct-response or paid social creative production, with at least 3 years managing a production team.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring, developing, andretaininggeneralist Editor/Designers (motion and static combined role) or comparable production hires.
  • Experience managing both full-time teams and contract or freelance production rosters.
  • Strong on-set craft. You can run a shoot yourself, direct non-actor talent, manage time and budget, and ship usable footage.

  • Budget management for shoots and contractor billing.

  • Strong collaboration skills across Creative, Buying, Finance, Legal, and external partners.
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

STRONG PLUSES:

  • An existing network of go-to freelance Producers, DPs, Shooters, and post talent.
  • Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project management tooling.
  • Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: templates, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, prompt libraries, or agentic tooling that compounds team output without diluting craft.
  • Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to inform production priorities.

jobs.description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Studio

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you’ll join a fun, innovative engineering team within the AI & Data Science (AI&D) - organization. You will be part of AI Studio leading the technical delivery of complex AI and automation solutions through discovery, solution design, build, evaluation, production deployment, early stabilization and measurable value, production deployment, early stabilization and measurable value.

You will maintain technical continuity across the lifecycle, working with business stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to shape the simplest viable solution, coordinate execution, make delivery trade-offs, remove blockers and contribute hands-on to critical components. The role combines enterprise solution engineering, applied AI/ML, GenAI, RAG and agents, integration, evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, security, governance and production operations. Technical accountability complements, but does not replace, explicit product, business, compliance and long-term support ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery by clarifying the business workflow, users, intended outcome, value hypothesis, acceptance criteria, operational constraints, data readiness, integration dependencies and production implications;
  • Translate complex problems into an executable solution design, delivery plan, technical workstreams, estimates, milestones, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, release approach and support transition.
  • Build, prototype, review or contribute to critical production components to prove feasibility or unblock delivery, including AI-enabled applications, RAG, bounded agents, intelligent automation, APIs and integrations.
  • Define and maintain the integrated architecture across applications, workflows, data and knowledge pipelines, models, retrieval, agents, APIs, enterprise integrations, identity, access controls, observability and human review.
  • Orchestrate delivery across full-stack engineering, data science, ML and context engineering, testing, platform, security, compliance and business roles;
  • Establish integrated testing, AI evaluation and governance covering functional, performance, security, data, model, retrieval, generation, tool-use, human-oversight and operational behaviour with explicit release thresholds.
  • Coordinate production readiness through CI/CD, staged release, monitoring, logging, SLOs, rollback, recovery, runbooks and controlled deployment; support early issue triage, stabilization and transition to the operating owner.
  • Communicate evidence, risks, trade-offs and status clearly; measure adoption and value and convert delivery lessons into reusable components, accelerators, standards, documentation and playbooks.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a collaborative professional with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree and 1 year of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Master’s degree with 8 - 10 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Bachelor’s degree with 10 - 12 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Diploma with 12 - 14 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical discovery, and value framing: Workflow analysis, intended-use definition, feasibility assessment, data and integration readiness, success measures, estimates, dependency mapping and technical go/no-go recommendations.
  • Enterprise solution architecture and integration: End-to-end design across applications, APIs, services, data and knowledge flows, models, retrieval, agents, workflows, persistence, identity, security zones, enterprise systems and support boundaries.
  • Applied AI/ML and GenAI engineering: Production Python and SQL; classical ML and NLP awareness; foundation-model integration, prompt and context management, RAG, structured output, provenance, citations, bounded tool use, permissions, recovery and human control.
  • Evaluation, quality and regulated delivery: Representative evidence, baselines, gold sets, error taxonomies, expert adjudication, model and retrieval quality, task success, safety, latency, reliability, failure analysis, Responsible AI, privacy, validation, auditability and GxP controls.
  • Cloud, DevSecOps and lifecycle operations: Cloud-native services, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, versioning, observability, SLOs, staged release, rollback, incidents, disaster recovery, capacity, FinOps, runbooks and MLOps/LLMOps.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end technical ownership of at least one production AI, ML, software, data or automation solution that delivered a measurable enterprise outcome.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience designing or reviewing production software, APIs, services, data flows, evaluation pipelines and enterprise integrations.
  • Proven ability to turn complex business problems into coherent technical designs, executable delivery plans, acceptance criteria and production-readiness evidence while coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
  • Advanced capability in at least one role-defining pillar—Applied AI/ML, GenAI/RAG/agents, full-stack and integration engineering, or AI platform/MLOps—plus credible breadth across the production lifecycle.
  • Advanced RAG, knowledge and agent systems: Hybrid or graph retrieval, knowledge graphs, source verification, MCP-style integration, durable or multi-agent workflows, policy enforcement and adversarial testing.
  • Cloud, data and AI platforms: AWS, Bedrock or SageMaker, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven systems, infrastructure as code, MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, observability and FinOps.
  • Full-stack, workflow and automation breadth: JavaScript or TypeScript, modern web applications, API gateways, distributed workflows, process automation, document or vision capabilities and human-AI review experiences.
  • Regulated delivery and capability building: Life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, GxP or validated-system experience; reusable frameworks, accelerators, standards, platform capabilities and mentoring.
  • Excellent critical thinking and ability to create clarity, structure and forward momentum in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong technical leadership through influence, credibility, constructive challenge and hands-on problem solving.
  • Clear communication of evidence, uncertainty, risks, trade-offs, limitations and delivery status to diverse audiences.
  • Sound judgment, ownership and resilience when balancing value, speed, quality, security, compliance, cost, maintainability and supportability across global teams.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Device Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Windows Device Engineer builds the endpoint agent that sits closest to the user. It runs on every Windows machine, sees the traffic, makes decisions locally, and never gets in the way.

You will own the Windows agent end to end, from the C# service and the filter-driver layer to the local TLS proxy and the on-device ONNX models that make real-time decisions. Your agent has to run on enterprise machines that already have Zscaler or Netskope installed, without breaking them or being broken by them.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are not hiring someone who has read about WFP. We are hiring someone who has shipped a network-layer agent to thousands of enterprise endpoints and has the debugging scars to prove it.

Job Description:

  • Own the Windows endpoint agent: You design, build, and maintain the agent as a production-grade Windows service in C#/.NET. You own its installation, auto-updates, resilience, and performance footprint on the end user’s machine.
  • Build the network interception layer: You work with the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) and filter drivers to intercept, redirect, and inspect traffic at the right layer. You know when to use a callout driver, when a user-mode redirect is enough, and what each choice costs.
  • Run a local TLS proxy: You build and harden the local proxy that terminates and inspects TLS traffic on the device. You handle certificate trust, pinning exceptions, and protocol edge cases without degrading the user’s browsing or application experience.
  • Ship on-device AI: You integrate and optimize ONNX models that run locally on the endpoint. That means real-time inference under tight CPU, memory, and latency budgets, with no round trip to the cloud for every decision.
  • Coexist with the enterprise security stack: You make sure the agent works alongside Zscaler, Netskope, and other SSE/SASE and EDR agents already on the machine. That covers proxy chaining, WFP filter priorities, certificate stores, and the conflicts nobody documents.
  • Own quality in the field: You debug real customer environments using ETW traces, WinDbg, and packet captures. You harden the agent against crashes, network drops, and OS updates, and you report reliability in numbers, not anecdotes.

Requirements

  • Seasoned Windows systems engineer: 5+ years of experience building Windows desktop or system-level software in C#/.NET. You are comfortable with Windows services, the Win32 APIs, P/Invoke, and the line between user mode and kernel mode.
  • Deep network-layer experience: You have built with the Windows Filtering Platform or filter drivers in production. You understand TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.2/1.3 well enough to intercept them without breaking them. You have built or maintained a local proxy.
  • Shipped alongside Zscaler or Netskope: You have shipped an endpoint product that had to coexist with Zscaler, Netskope, or a similar SSE/SASE agent on enterprise devices. You know what goes wrong when two agents fight over the same traffic, and how to fix it.
  • On-device ML experience: You have integrated ONNX Runtime, or a similar inference engine, into a client application and tuned it for performance on real user hardware. Experience with DirectML or quantized models is a strong plus.
  • Proof of shipping: You can walk us through an endpoint agent you shipped to production: its architecture, the hardest bug you chased, and what you would do differently. Enterprise deployment experience with MSI/MSIX, Intune or SCCM, and code signing is a plus.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain a driver-level trade-off to a product manager and a deployment issue to a client’s IT team in plain English. You have worked with US or Western teams.

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

Position Summary


The Middleware Patching Engineer is the hands-on engineer who completes patch management work for enterprise middleware and application runtime platforms, including application servers, web servers, messaging platforms, and Java and .NET runtimes, across Windows and Linux environments. The engineer plans, tests, schedules, deploys, validates, and documents patches, and drives failed or overdue systems to closure.


The engineer works with the Vulnerability Engineer to ensure middleware is patched according to priority and customer risk, and with the Patching Automation Engineer to ensure that whatever can be automated is automated. The engineer also coordinates with middleware engineers, application owners, change management, and the Windows and Linux Patching Engineers. Middleware engineers retain ownership of platform architecture and administration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute patching across on-premises and cloud middleware, such as Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, Red Hat JBoss EAP, Apache HTTP Server, Microsoft IIS, IBM MQ, and Java and .NET runtimes.
  • Work with the Vulnerability Engineer to translate vulnerability findings into patch or upgrade plans, prioritized by severity, exploitability, application criticality, and customer risk; track vendor release cycles such as Oracle Critical Patch Updates and Apache and Red Hat advisories; and maintain routine and emergency schedules aligned with remediation timelines and customer requirements.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory of middleware products, versions, patch levels, and bundled components such as Java runtimes; reconcile scanner results against it to find coverage gaps and identify unsupported or end-of-life versions.
  • Review vendor patch documentation and prerequisites; coordinate regression testing with application owners across development, test, staging, disaster recovery, and production; and prepare implementation, validation, and backout plans with change records, approvals, and confirmed backups.
  • Lead readiness and go/no-go reviews and perform or coordinate deployments in approved maintenance windows, using rolling restarts across clustered and load-balanced nodes, then verify applications, services, certificates, and integrations.
  • Troubleshoot patch conflicts, OPatch and installer failures, and post-patch issues; coordinate rollback or recovery, escalate service-impacting failures, and apply lessons learned to future cycles.
  • Manage patch exceptions for unsupported versions or applications that cannot yet accept a patch, documenting compensating controls and remediation plans and retaining evidence for audits.
  • Work with the Patching Automation Engineer to identify and automate every repeatable patching step, such as staging, rolling deployment, health checks, and recovery, and to test and validate those workflows; retain ownership of execution, compliance, and remediation outcomes.
  • Maintain patch calendars, runbooks, and dashboards; report compliance, failures, exceptions, and aging vulnerabilities; and align middleware and operating system patching with the Windows and Linux Patching Engineers.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Six or more years of experience in middleware administration, application server operations, patch management, vulnerability remediation, or a related technical role.
  • Hands-on experience patching enterprise middleware platforms such as Oracle WebLogic Server, Apache Tomcat, Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform, Apache HTTP Server, or Microsoft Internet Information Services.
  • Working knowledge of Java runtime management (JDK and JRE versioning) and certificate and keystore management; basic Linux and Windows Server administration for middleware.
  • Experience planning, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting middleware patches with vendor tools such as Oracle OPatch, including clustered, load-balanced, highly available, and disaster recovery environments.
  • Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, Python, WebLogic Scripting Tool, or Ansible for operational scripting, troubleshooting, and validation.
  • Experience producing patch compliance reports, operational metrics, executive summaries, and audit evidence.
  • Ability to support planned maintenance windows and emergency patch deployments outside normal business hours when required.
  • U.S. Citizenship and U.S. residency required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Middleware, IBM MQ, or IBM WebSphere Application Server.
  • Experience responding to high-profile middleware and library vulnerabilities, such as those affecting Apache Log4j, Apache Struts, or Spring Framework.
  • Experience with Ansible Automation Platform, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, HashiCorp Vault, and JFrog Artifactory.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Power BI or ServiceNow dashboards.
  • Familiarity with National Institute of Standards and Technology guidance, Center for Internet Security controls, Security Technical Implementation Guides for application and web servers, or comparable security frameworks.
  • Experience leading patching activities across multiple customers, business units, or geographically distributed environments.

This role may require access to export-controlled commodities and technology. Therefore, to conform to U.S. export control regulations, applicant should be eligible for any required authorizations from the U.S. Government.

The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

  • Experience teaching or coaching developers

Automation Engineer

RFA is investing heavily in automation and AI to improve client experience, reduce ticket volume, and free our engineers for higher-value work. As an Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain automations across our RMM, PSA, security, and cloud platforms, combining traditional scripting with AI agents, SOAR playbooks, and RPA workflows. Your work will speed up ticket resolution, shorten the time to remediate vulnerabilities, and keep client environments secure, compliant, and consistently configured at scale. You will partner with our service desk, security, and project teams to find the best automation opportunities, deliver them safely, and measure the results.

Responsibilities:

  • You will work closely with other Automation Engineers to administer our server and workstation application monitoring and management platforms.
  • You will provide programming/scripting assistance to support system automation, using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development while reviewing, testing, and validating all AI-generated code.
  • You will review known vulnerability findings and work to develop and deploy automated remediations to client systems.
  • You will build, maintain, and optimize automation policies, scripts, monitors, and self-healing remediations across our RMM platforms (NinjaOne, ConnectWise Automate, etc.) for alert remediation, patching, software deployment, and configuration drift correction.
  • You will design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, LLM APIs) to support ticket triage, summarization, documentation, and common issue remediation.
  • You will develop and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate security alert enrichment, triage, and incident response, integrating with EDR, SIEM, email security, and PSA ticketing.
  • You will build RPA and workflow automations (e.g., Rewst, Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n) that integrate PSA, RMM, documentation, and line-of-business systems through APIs and webhooks.
  • You will establish guardrails for AI and automation, including human-in-the-loop review, testing, version control, logging, and data privacy controls that protect RFA and client data.
  • You will work closely with our other departments to identify opportunities in automating tasks and workflows and provide solutions.
  • You will perform complex configuration, change management and testing activities to support a service-oriented architecture and integration between all applications.
  • You will ensure the performance and reliability of monitoring and management platforms and work with other information technology professionals to resolve performance issues.
  • You will collaborate with Account Management, Sales, and technical leadership by participating in client phone calls and on-site meetings to effectively document and communicate technical requirements.

Qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years’ experience in an applications systems administration, site maintenance administration, systems automation administrator role or similar background in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and complete projects on time in an agile environment
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinker, self-starter and team player
  • Excellent communication with the ability to ask relevant questions to gather relevant details and communicate effectively with clients and internal project stakeholders
  • Demonstrable ability to automate repetitive or redundant tasks using PowerShell or Python
  • Experience with scripting for Windows OS
  • Experience with MSFT Azure and various Azure services
  • Experience with MSFT Intune scripting and software deployments
  • Proficiency with RMM platforms, including NinjaOne, ConnectWise Automate (scripting, monitors, policies, and automated remediation)
  • Experience with SOAR platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel playbooks, Tines, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, or similar), including playbook development and tool integration
  • Experience with RPA and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Rewst, Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and large language models (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) in daily work, including prompt engineering and critical review of AI-generated code and output
  • Understanding of responsible AI use, including data privacy, access controls, and the limitations of AI-generated results
  • Understanding of data analysis techniques with some experience working with data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, PowerBI, Looker, etc.)

Nice to Have:

These are the skills we look for. You don’t need all these skills but the more you have, the better.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related degree -or- equivalent work experience
  • Experience with Linux Server Administration
  • Understanding of REST APIs and their core concepts
  • Experience building AI agents or copilots (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, or LLM APIs) and familiarity with concepts such as tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Experience integrating with ConnectWise PSA, IT Glue, and Microsoft Graph APIs
  • Security automation experience (Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Conditional Access, vulnerability remediation workflows)
  • Experience with Git version control and CI/CD practices for scripts and automations
  • Knowledge of ITIL incident, request, and change management practices
  • Experience with Microsoft Office365 platform tools (Sharepoint, Power Apps, etc.)
  • Knowledge of and experience in networking, DHCP, DNS, monitoring SNMP, WMI, CIM, VMware and ESX servers and .NET programming is a plus

You will also be expected to raise engineering standards through ownership, technical judgment, mentoring, and the responsible use of AI — we expect every engineer, manager, and leader to actively leverage AI to enhance productivity, quality, innovation, and customer value, as AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 106988

Principal AI Engineer

Location:

You will have the flexibility to work fully remotely within Canada. Preference for candidates near Insight hubs in Toronto, Montreal, or Calgary.

Insight at a Glance

  • 14,000+ engaged teammates globally
  • $8.2 billion in revenue in 2025
  • Certified as a Great Place to Work in nine countries in 2025
  • Fortune 500 company, No. 447 in 2025
  • Received 25+ industry and partner awards in the past year
  • $1.4M+ in total charitable contributions globally in 2024

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will provide technical and architectural leadership across complex enterprise AI engagements. You will work directly with customers, executives, sellers, architects, and delivery teams to turn ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-grade AI solutions.

You will design and implement AI agents, multi-agent systems, and reusable AI platforms that use tools, call APIs, reason over enterprise data, and support modern web, mobile, and Power Platform experiences. You will also serve as a senior delivery consultant, guiding technical teams, improving engineering quality, resolving complex challenges, and helping shape the continued growth of Insight’s Data & AI practice.

Along the way, you will get to:

  • Lead the architecture and implementation of production-grade agentic AI systems using Microsoft Foundry, including tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Design reusable AI platforms and agent factories capable of addressing multiple business problems across an enterprise.
  • Apply Agentic SDLC, software-factory, and harness-engineering principles to improve the speed, quality, reliability, and governance of AI-enabled software delivery.
  • Build and manage tools and connectors across the agentic chain, including MCP-based tools, custom APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud services.
  • Develop retrieval-augmented generation and data-centric AI capabilities using Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Implement prompt strategies, guardrails, observability, evaluation loops, and quality controls to improve reliability, security, safety, and performance.
  • Lead technical discovery with customers and translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into practical AI use cases, architectures, and delivery plans.
  • Evaluate when AI is the right solution and when traditional software, automation, integration, or data approaches will provide a better customer outcome.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent customer engagements.
  • Guide engineers and delivery teams through architectural decisions, implementation challenges, production readiness, and technical escalations.
  • Take ownership of engineering quality, architectural consistency, scalability, security, and delivery risk.
  • Partner with sales and presales teams to shape solutions, define scope, communicate value, and support the development of new customer opportunities.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to reusable assets, delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices across the Data & AI practice.
  • Communicate technical recommendations and business value clearly to customer executives, technical leaders, and internal stakeholders.

Be AmbITious: This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, cloud architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Several years of experience serving as a senior technical lead, principal engineer, staff engineer, solution architect, or comparable enterprise technical leader.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical engagements across multiple projects, customers, or enterprise organizations.
  • Advanced experience designing and delivering production APIs, services, integrations, and distributed applications.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions.
  • Current knowledge of agentic workflows, multi-agent systems, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI.
  • Experience with Agentic SDLC, AI-enabled software factories, agent factories, harness engineering, or comparable AI delivery frameworks.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure architecture and delivery experience, including relevant services such as Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring, Azure AI Search, and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Experience building tools, connectors, custom APIs, and MCP-based or comparable enterprise integrations.
  • Strong software development experience using C#/.NET or another modern enterprise programming language.
  • Experience developing modern web applications using React, TypeScript, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience taking AI solutions from discovery and prototype through production implementation and operational support.
  • Experience architecting reusable platforms or frameworks that can support multiple enterprise use cases.
  • Strong customer-facing consulting and technical discovery experience.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive stakeholders and translate technical decisions into clear business outcomes.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, influencing technical teams, and providing architectural leadership without relying solely on formal reporting authority.
  • Demonstrated ownership of engineering quality, delivery risk, production readiness, and complex technical escalations.
  • Ability to manage technical priorities across multiple concurrent engagements.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, commercial awareness, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • A consultative mindset and the ability to help shape, position, and expand customer solutions rather than simply execute assigned requirements.

What You Can Expect

We're legendary for taking care of you, your family, and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

  • Freedom to work from another location, even an international destination, for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join Us Today, Your AmbITious Journey Starts Here.

Insight is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

At Insight, we celebrate diversity of skills and experience, so even if you don't feel like your skills are a perfect match, we still want to hear from you!

Insight does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. Unsolicited resumes will be treated as direct applications from the candidate, and recruiters or agencies who submit candidates for this position without a prior, written vendor agreement will not be eligible for any form of compensation, even if the candidate is hired.

Salary

The base salary range for this position is typically $130,000 - $150,000 CAD with additional bonus and benefits available. However, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case, including experience and location, and we will also consider candidates outside of this range as necessary.

Ingénieur principal en IA (Principal AI Engineer)

Lieu :

Vous aurez la possibilité de travailler entièrement à distance partout au Canada. Préférence pour les candidats situés près des centres d’Insight à Toronto, Montréal ou Calgary.

Insight en bref

  • Plus de 14 000 coéquipiers engagés dans le monde
  • Revenus de 8,2 milliards de dollars en 2025
  • Certifiée Great Place to Work dans neuf pays en 2025
  • Entreprise du classement Fortune 500, 447e rang en 2025
  • Plus de 25 prix de l’industrie et de nos partenaires au cours de la dernière année
  • Plus de 1,4 M$ en contributions caritatives totales à l’échelle mondiale en 2024

Le moment est venu de mettre votre expertise au service d’Insight. Nous ne sommes pas seulement une entreprise technologique; nous sommes une entreprise centrée sur les gens. Nous croyons qu’en libérant le potentiel des personnes et de la technologie, nous pouvons accélérer la transformation et obtenir des résultats extraordinaires. En tant qu’intégrateur de solutions du classement Fortune 500 possédant une expertise approfondie en infonuagique, en données, en IA, en cybersécurité et en périphérie intelligente, nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs décisions numériques complexes.

En tant qu’ingénieur principal en IA, vous assurerez un leadership technique et architectural dans le cadre de mandats d’IA d’entreprise complexes. Vous travaillerez directement avec les clients, les dirigeants, les vendeurs, les architectes et les équipes de livraison afin de transformer des défis d’affaires ambigus en solutions d’IA évolutives et de qualité production.

Vous concevrez et mettrez en œuvre des agents d’IA, des systèmes multiagents et des plateformes d’IA réutilisables qui utilisent des outils, appellent des API, raisonnent sur les données d’entreprise et prennent en charge des expériences Web, mobiles et Power Platform modernes. Vous agirez également à titre de consultant principal en livraison, en guidant les équipes techniques, en améliorant la qualité de l’ingénierie, en résolvant des problèmes complexes et en contribuant à la croissance continue de la pratique Données et IA d’Insight.

En cours de route, vous serez appelé à :

  • Diriger l’architecture et la mise en œuvre de systèmes d’IA agentique de qualité production à l’aide de Microsoft Foundry, y compris l’appel d’outils et de fonctions, l’orchestration en plusieurs étapes et les flux de travail multiagents.
  • Concevoir des plateformes d’IA réutilisables et des fabriques d’agents capables de répondre à de multiples problématiques d’affaires à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
  • Appliquer les principes du cycle de vie du développement logiciel agentique (Agentic SDLC), des usines logicielles et de l’ingénierie de harnais afin d’améliorer la rapidité, la qualité, la fiabilité et la gouvernance de la livraison de logiciels assistés par l’IA.
  • Créer et gérer des outils et des connecteurs tout au long de la chaîne agentique, y compris des outils basés sur MCP, des API personnalisées, des intégrations d’entreprise et des services infonuagiques.
  • Développer des capacités de génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) et d’IA centrée sur les données à l’aide d’Azure AI Search, de Microsoft Fabric et d’autres sources de données d’entreprise.
  • Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’invite, des garde-fous, de l’observabilité, des boucles d’évaluation et des contrôles de qualité afin d’améliorer la fiabilité, la sécurité, la sûreté et le rendement.
  • Diriger la découverte technique avec les clients et traduire des défis d’affaires complexes ou ambigus en cas d’usage, architectures et plans de livraison d’IA pratiques.
  • Évaluer les cas où l’IA est la bonne solution et ceux où des approches logicielles traditionnelles, d’automatisation, d’intégration ou de données offriront un meilleur résultat au client.
  • Assurer le leadership technique dans plusieurs mandats clients simultanés.
  • Guider les ingénieurs et les équipes de livraison dans les décisions d’architecture, les défis de mise en œuvre, la préparation à la production et les escalades techniques.
  • Assumer la responsabilité de la qualité de l’ingénierie, de la cohérence architecturale, de l’évolutivité, de la sécurité et des risques de livraison.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes et d’avant-vente pour façonner les solutions, définir la portée, communiquer la valeur et soutenir le développement de nouvelles occasions d’affaires.
  • Encadrer des ingénieurs et contribuer à des actifs réutilisables, à des normes de livraison, à des méthodologies et à des pratiques exemplaires au sein de la pratique Données et IA.
  • Communiquer clairement les recommandations techniques et la valeur d’affaires aux dirigeants de clients, aux leaders techniques et aux parties prenantes internes.

Soyez AmbITieux : Cette occasion ne concerne pas seulement ce que vous faites aujourd’hui, mais aussi où vous pouvez aller demain. Lorsque vous apportez votre ardeur (Hunger), votre cœur (Heart) et votre harmonie (Harmony) chez Insight, votre potentiel rencontre des occasions continues de perfectionnement, de promotion et d’avancement professionnel.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience progressive en génie logiciel, en architecture de solutions, en architecture infonuagique ou dans une discipline technique connexe.
  • Plusieurs années d’expérience à titre de responsable technique principal, d’ingénieur principal, d’ingénieur « staff », d’architecte de solutions ou de leader technique d’entreprise comparable.
  • Expérience démontrée de la direction de mandats techniques complexes touchant plusieurs projets, clients ou organisations d’entreprise.
  • Expérience avancée de la conception et de la livraison d’API, de services, d’intégrations et d’applications distribuées en production.
  • Expérience pratique de la conception et de la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA, d’IA générative et d’IA agentique.
  • Connaissance à jour des flux de travail agentiques, des systèmes multiagents, de l’appel d’outils, de la génération augmentée par récupération, de l’ingénierie d’invites, des cadres d’évaluation et de l’IA responsable.
  • Expérience du cycle de vie du développement logiciel agentique (Agentic SDLC), des usines logicielles assistées par l’IA, des fabriques d’agents, de l’ingénierie de harnais ou de cadres de livraison d’IA comparables.
  • Solide expérience en architecture et en livraison Microsoft Azure, y compris des services pertinents tels qu’Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, la surveillance, Azure AI Search et Microsoft Foundry.
  • Expérience de la création d’outils, de connecteurs, d’API personnalisées et d’intégrations d’entreprise basées sur MCP ou comparables.
  • Solide expérience de développement logiciel avec C#/.NET ou un autre langage de programmation d’entreprise moderne.
  • Expérience du développement d’applications Web modernes avec React, TypeScript ou des technologies comparables.
  • Expérience du passage de solutions d’IA de la découverte et du prototype à la mise en œuvre en production et au soutien opérationnel.
  • Expérience de l’architecture de plateformes ou de cadres réutilisables pouvant soutenir plusieurs cas d’usage d’entreprise.
  • Solide expérience en consultation auprès des clients et en découverte technique.
  • Capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes de la direction et de traduire les décisions techniques en résultats d’affaires clairs.
  • Expérience de l’encadrement d’ingénieurs, de l’influence sur les équipes techniques et du leadership architectural sans s’appuyer uniquement sur une autorité hiérarchique formelle.
  • Responsabilité démontrée de la qualité de l’ingénierie, des risques de livraison, de la préparation à la production et des escalades techniques complexes.
  • Capacité de gérer les priorités techniques dans plusieurs mandats simultanés.
  • Bon jugement, curiosité, sens des affaires et capacité de bien fonctionner dans des environnements ambigus.
  • Une mentalité de conseiller et la capacité d’aider à façonner, positionner et élargir les solutions des clients plutôt que de simplement exécuter les exigences assignées.

À quoi vous attendre

Nous sommes réputés pour prendre soin de vous, de votre famille et pour vous aider à vous engager dans votre communauté locale. Nous voulons que vous meniez une vie pleine et significative et que vous preniez en main votre carrière chez Insight. Voici quelques-uns de nos avantages :

  • La liberté de travailler depuis un autre endroit, même une destination à l’étranger, jusqu’à 30 jours civils consécutifs par année.

Mais ce qui nous distingue vraiment, ce sont nos valeurs fondamentales : l’ardeur (Hunger), le cœur (Heart) et l’harmonie (Harmony), qui guident tout ce que nous faisons, de l’établissement de relations avec nos coéquipiers, nos partenaires et nos clients à notre contribution positive dans nos collectivités.

Joignez-vous à nous dès aujourd’hui : votre parcours AmbITieux commence ici.

Insight est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité des chances, et toutes les personnes qualifiées qui postulent seront considérées sans égard à la race, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe, à l’origine nationale, à un handicap, au statut d’ancien combattant protégé, à l’orientation sexuelle ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lorsque vous postulez, veuillez nous indiquer les pronoms que vous utilisez et tout accommodement raisonnable dont vous pourriez avoir besoin pendant le processus d’entrevue.

Chez Insight, nous célébrons la diversité des compétences et de l’expérience; même si vous avez l’impression que vos compétences ne correspondent pas parfaitement, nous voulons tout de même avoir de vos nouvelles!

Insight n’accepte pas les curriculum vitæ non sollicités provenant de recruteurs ou d’agences de placement. Les curriculum vitæ non sollicités seront traités comme des candidatures directes de la part du candidat, et les recruteurs ou agences qui soumettent des candidats pour ce poste sans entente écrite préalable avec un fournisseur ne seront admissibles à aucune forme de rémunération, même si le candidat est embauché.

Salaire

Le salaire de base pour ce poste se situe habituellement entre 130 000 $ et 150 000 $ CAD, auquel s’ajoutent une prime et des avantages sociaux. Toutefois, les décisions en matière de rémunération dépendent des faits et des circonstances de chaque cas, notamment de l’expérience et du lieu, et nous considérerons également des candidats dont les attentes se situent à l’extérieur de cette fourchette, au besoin.

jobs.excerpt: What You'll Do Avalara is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams building scalable, cloud-native SaaS solutions.
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams building scalable, cloud-native SaaS solutions. You will help drive execution, improve engineering quality and reliability, and help deliver secure, high-performance systems that simplify tax compliance for customers. You will report to the Director of engineering.

What the Team Does

Our engineering teams build and evolve cloud-native platforms that support tax compliance across large-scale transaction environments. The team focuses on building a platform for our customer experiences and user interfaces with scalable architecture, strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and modern development tools and practices that improve speed, quality, and customer experience.

What you will do

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead multiple Scrum teams across geographies and help create scalable SaaS solutions in a distributed environment. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders, improve engineering execution, and support architectural and operational decisions that strengthen performance, security, reliability, and delivery predictability.

You will also help grow engineering talent, establish development practices, and support adoption of AI-enabled workflows that improve productivity and quality across the software development lifecycle.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

    • Lead and develop distributed engineering teams delivering scalable SaaS solutions

    • Define and execute the technology roadmap for best in class web platform.

    • Drive predictable, high-quality execution across multiple Scrum teams

    • Support architectural decisions that improve scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency

    • Strengthen CI/CD, automation, and DevOps practices to improve deployment speed and quality

    • Be an escalation point for production and customer-impacting issues

    • Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, and other stakeholders to align technical work with our priorities

    • Hire, coach, and develop engineers

    • Use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement

    • Strengthen engineering fundamentals across object-oriented design, microservices, APIs, and secure development

    • Lead adoption of AI-enabled development practices that improve team effectiveness

What You'll Need to be Successful

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

    • 10+ years of software development experience delivering large-scale production systems

    • 2+ years of engineering management or equivalent leadership experience leading distributed teams

Senior Network Engineer

This is a remote position. Occasional travel may be required.

PURPOSE

This position’s primary responsibility is to provide operational support for our clients’ network infrastructure including switches, routers, wireless access points and controllers, and firewalls. In addition to support, the senior network engineer will be involved in designing, deploying, configuring and securing network infrastructure for clients. The successful candidate will have strong project management, organizational, and communication skills, along with a strong sense of urgency. The senior network engineer is defined by technical leadership and the ability to set the standard for the team’s performance in ticket execution, troubleshooting, technical knowledge advancement and customer interactions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Address escalated tickets for complex operational issues in client networks.

  • Maintain clients’ existing networks to ensure stability and compliance, and to address any issues and failures that arise during normal operation.

  • Communicate with clients regarding status of open tasks and projects daily.

  • Drive projects for data network design, development, and implementation, working in conjunction with professional services teams.

  • Follow established processes for all work, adhering to Ascend’s quality standards.

  • Identify and drive opportunities for process improvement.

  • Development of documentation for client networks, including network diagrams.

  • Work with vendors for support case resolution.

  • Assist in mentorship/training of other engineers.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide off-hours support.

PREFERRED SKILLS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Ability to communicate complex technical problems clearly to customers, with appropriate understanding of business impact and empathy for the client’s situation.

  • A strong sense of urgency (required).

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or related degree program.

  • Minimum 5 years advanced Network Engineering experience (preferably at an MSP).

  • Advanced knowledge of cloud networking concepts in Azure and AWS.

  • Extensive knowledge of VoIP technologies preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of network technologies from Fortinet, Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto, and Ubiquiti.

  • Extensive knowledge of network security concepts, tools and strategies.

  • Expert knowledge of network protocols (e.g. TCP/IP, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF), services, and monitoring tools (LogicMonitor experience preferred).

  • Cisco CCNA and/or CCNP, or Fortinet FCP certification or equivalent working experience is required.

  • Ability to learn about new technologies rapidly and continually.

Starting Compensation: $100,000/year

The salary for this position is commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. The range is intended to reflect our commitment to attracting top talent, and the final offer will be based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's previous experience, expertise in the field, relevant certifications, and the specific requirements of the role. Along with a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement savings options, flexible time off (FTO), and professional development opportunities. We are open to discussing compensation and benefits further during the interview process to ensure alignment with the candidate’s expectations and experience.

Ascend Technologies firmly believes that that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not only fundamental values but also powerful drivers of innovation, growth, and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

CORE VALUES

We are seeking highly motivated individuals who have the willingness and ability to demonstrate Ascend core values:
