jobs.description:
What's the role?

As a Strategic Accounts Business Solution Architect, you will partner with HERE’s most strategic and technically complex enterprise customers to turn business challenges into practical, scalable technical solutions. You will lead technical discovery, shape solution architectures, evaluate feasibility and tradeoffs, and help customers move from an idea or business objective toward a clear path to implementation. Your work will span HERE’s geospatial technologies, APIs, data, cloud platforms, and emerging AI capabilities.

You’ll work closely with Account Executives, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and other Business Solution Architects throughout the sales cycle. When useful, you’ll also create or adapt technical demonstrations and lightweight prototypes to validate an approach, bring an idea to life, or show what’s possible.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer Discovery and Solution Architecture

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, use cases, workflows, technical environments, and success criteria.
  • Translate business challenges into technical requirements, solution architectures, and actionable recommendations.
  • Design solutions using HERE APIs, SDKs, geospatial data and services, cloud technologies, and partner capabilities.
  • Apply geospatial concepts and location intelligence to complex business and technical challenges.
  • Evaluate solution options, tradeoffs, dependencies, feasibility, and technical risks.
  • Communicate solution approaches clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Validate Solutions and Bring Ideas to Life

  • Lead technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts with clear objectives and measurable success criteria.
  • Create or adapt demonstrations and lightweight prototypes when they help validate an approach or make a solution more tangible.
  • Explore how geospatial technology, location intelligence, AI, data, and cloud capabilities can be combined to solve emerging customer challenges.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and partner with Product and Engineering to address blockers and identify viable paths forward.

Partner on Strategic Accounts

  • Serve as a technical partner to strategic account teams, helping shape solutions from early discovery through technical validation.
  • Contribute technical perspective to account planning, customer roadmap discussions, and solution strategy.
  • Collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success to solve complex customer needs.
  • Bring customer requirements, technical insights, and market feedback back to HERE Product and Engineering teams.
  • Develop reusable demonstrations, reference architectures, technical guidance, and best practices for the broader BSA organization.

Who are you?

You’re curious, customer-focused, and comfortable working through complex problems where the answer may not be obvious at the start. You take the time to understand a customer’s business, technical environment, and goals before deciding what the solution should look like.

You ask good questions, challenge assumptions when needed, and build trust by solving problems alongside customers rather than simply recommending products. You’re equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior stakeholders and going deep with architects, engineers, and technical teams. You have a strong technical foundation and genuine curiosity about geospatial technology, AI, data, and cloud. Software development is not the primary focus of this role, but you’re comfortable getting hands-on when it helps test an idea, adapt a demonstration, or prove that an approach can work.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience designing and validating enterprise technology solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, cloud technologies, data, integrations, and modern software architectures.
  • Experience applying geospatial, mapping, spatial data, or location intelligence concepts to business or technical problems.
  • Experience leading technical discovery, solution design sessions, workshops, evaluations, or proof-of-concepts.
  • Ability to move between business objectives and technical detail, translating complex challenges into practical solution approaches.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, or similar cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, GIS, Geography, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with mapping, GIS, routing, navigation, geocoding, search, spatial analytics, or other location technologies.
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Familiarity with AI, generative AI, large language models, or AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, prototypes, or reference solutions.
  • Programming or scripting experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with large enterprise or strategic customers.

Why HERE?

HERE combines global location data, enterprise-grade technology and deep real-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.

The expected base salary range for this position is $96,000 - $138,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

jobs.title: Spécialiste en Fiabilité des Sites II (Linux/AWS/Surveillance des systèmes)
jobs.excerpt: Le ou la Spécialiste en fiabilité des sites II contribue à la stabilité opérationnelle et à la performance des plateformes d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad, tout en gagnant progressivement en autonomie.
jobs.description:
Le ou la Spécialiste en fiabilité des sites II contribue à la stabilité opérationnelle et à la performance des plateformes d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad, tout en gagnant progressivement en autonomie. Cette personne assume la responsabilité de tâches définies liées à la surveillance, à la maintenance des bases de données et aux opérations infonuagiques, répond aux incidents avec une autonomie croissante et participe à l’amélioration des systèmes et des processus. En développant son expertise en administration de systèmes, en performance SQL et en infrastructures cloud, elle joue un rôle actif dans le maintien des normes élevées de disponibilité sur lesquelles les établissements de santé s’appuient.

Principales responsabilités

  • Assurer la fiabilité des systèmes dans les environnements de production en surveillant l’état de l’infrastructure, en enquêtant et en résolvant de façon autonome les problèmes de performance, et en garantissant une disponibilité constante des plateformes d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad, tout en escaladant les situations complexes aux spécialistes seniors lorsque nécessaire.
  • Exécuter et optimiser la maintenance des bases de données SQL en réalisant des tâches de maintenance courantes et non courantes, en analysant les problèmes de performance des requêtes de base, en soutenant les opérations de sauvegarde et de récupération, et en transmettant les besoins de réglage avancé aux membres seniors de l’équipe.
  • Soutenir les opérations d’infrastructure cloud en administrant et en maintenant des déploiements dans le cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), en mettant en œuvre des changements d’infrastructure selon des modèles établis et en contribuant à la migration de systèmes on-prem vers des environnements cloud.
  • Répondre aux incidents avec une prise en charge accrue en diagnostiquant de manière autonome les problèmes systèmes et bases de données de complexité modérée, en exécutant les mesures correctives, en participant aux analyses des causes fondamentales et en recommandant des mesures préventives afin de réduire les récurrences
  • Contribuer aux initiatives d’amélioration continue en identifiant des opportunités d’automatiser les tâches manuelles répétitives, en améliorant la couverture de surveillance et la précision des alertes, en mettant à jour les guides opérationnels et la documentation, et en participant à des projets d’équipe visant à renforcer la fiabilité de la plateforme.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en administration de systèmes, ingénierie de fiabilité des sites (SRE), opérations techniques ou dans un rôle connexe soutenant des environnements de production.
  • Connaissance pratique de l’administration de SQL Server, notamment l’exécution de requêtes, les concepts d’indexation, les sauvegardes et restaurations, ainsi que les tâches de maintenance de bases de données.
  • Expérience pratique avec au moins une plateforme cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluant les principes fondamentaux de calcul, de stockage et de réseautique.
  • Maîtrise de l’administration de serveurs Windows et/ou Linux, incluant les scripts et l’automatisation (PowerShell, Bash ou Python).
  • Expérience avec des outils de surveillance et d’observabilité (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog ou équivalents) pour identifier et analyser les problèmes systèmes.
  • Baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information ou expérience équivalente.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières

  • Certification cloud (AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator ou équivalent).
  • Expérience avec les systèmes informatiques de santé, particulièrement les plateformes PACS, RIS ou d’imagerie médicale.
  • Connaissance des normes de données de santé et des exigences de conformité (HIPAA, DICOM, HL7).
  • Expérience avec des outils d’infrastructure en tant que code (Terraform, CloudFormation, modèles ARM).
  • Familiarité avec les technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Connaissance des concepts de haute disponibilité de SQL Server (Always On, clustering, réplication).
  • Compréhension des pratiques DevOps et des pipelines CI/CD.
  • Capacité à participer à une rotation de garde (on-call).
  • Flexibilité pour répondre à des incidents critiques en dehors des heures normales de travail.

Exigences relatives aux déplacements

Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour soutenir des escalades clients ou favoriser la collaboration au sein de l’équipe (jusqu’à 10 % du temps).

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Cloudticity, our mission is to make every human on earth healthier by enabling healthcare organizations to leverage public clouds like AWS and Azure in order to deliver modern innovations and key insights. We enable healthcare organizations to be more effective at what they do by providing them with the tools, infrastructure, and guidance to build highly secure, available, and scalable solutions. Work from anywhere in the U.S.

We are a global, fully remote company serving some of the most innovative leaders in healthcare technology. This individual will own the full sales motion, drive revenue growth, and help shape the future of Cloudticity's go-to-market strategy. Initially operating in a hands-on sales leadership capacity, this person will be responsible for developing and closing strategic opportunities while building the foundation for a scalable sales organization.   • Experience developing and managing sales pipelines, forecasts, and performance metrics.

  • Ability to travel onsite to healthcare accounts to drive strategic meetings.
  • Positive, "can do" attitude with a collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset.

jobs.description:

Held is seeking an experienced Cyber Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance Analyst to join the Cyber Security GRC Team and support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of key elements of the Cyber Security Program. The role will collaborate closely with Cyber Security Engineering and Operations, IT, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Human Resources, business stakeholders, control owners, auditors, and third-party providers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assess cyber risks and control effectiveness; validate evidence, document findings, and track remediation.
  • Maintain policies and support SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, and other applicable compliance requirements.

  • Support security awareness, policy communications, training, and related evidence.
  • Support DR/BCP and incident-response governance, including plan reviews, exercises, documentation, and lessons learned.
  • Prepare GRC reports, metrics, and KPIs; monitor asset compliance and regulatory developments.
  • Use approved AI securely and validate outputs; assess AI risks and support agent governance, including human oversight, data protection, access controls, secure MCP tools, testing, logging, and change control.

Essential Qualifications

  • Cyber risk and control assessment: Experience conducting risk assessments, evaluating control design and operating effectiveness, validating evidence, documenting findings, and tracking risk treatment and remediation through closure.
  • Framework and regulatory compliance: Practical ability to map SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and NIST CSF 2.0 requirements to policies, processes, controls, and evidence; working knowledge of PHI/ePHI safeguards and applicable privacy requirements.
  • Governance and audit support: Ability to develop and maintain Cyber Security policies and processes, coordinate audit evidence and corrective actions, and support disaster recovery and business continuity plan reviews, exercises, and evidence collection.
  • Third-party risk management (TPRM): Experience reviewing vendor security controls and supporting third-party risk assessments, documenting gaps, coordinating with vendors and control owners, and tracking remediation.
  • AI governance and responsible use: Ability to use approved enterprise AI tools in GRC workflows while protecting confidential, personal, client, and regulated information; validate AI-assisted outputs, identify unsupported assumptions, and apply human oversight and risk-based review to AI use cases and vendors.
  • Security awareness and training: Ability to support the development of security awareness and training programs, communicate security policies clearly, and maintain training evidence.

  • GRC automation platforms: Hands-on experience with Drata, ServiceNow GRC/IRM, Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, LogicGate, or comparable tools for controlled GRC workflows.
  • Advanced AI and agent governance: Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, or comparable tools; familiarity with low-code agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, access controls, prompt-injection and data-leakage risks, testing, logging, output validation, and guidance such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP, or ISO/IEC 42001.

jobs.description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to build Northbeam's mobile attribution product and the data collection layer underneath it. You'll own our client-side SDKs (JavaScript today, iOS next) and the high-throughput APIs that ingest the events they send.

This is a fullstack role with a strong backend and scaling bent. Our microservices run in both TypeScript and Python, so you'll move between the two daily, and ship React UI when a feature needs it. You'll also partner with our Conversions API (CAPI) team on event ingestion.

The ideal person has built web analytics or event tracking at real volume and cares as much about a reliable SDK as about the systems that catch its data.

Your Impact

  • Build Northbeam's mobile attribution solution end to end: SDK, ingestion APIs, data model, and the dashboard views customers use to act on it.
  • Design and own our client-side SDKs in JavaScript/TypeScript, and help shape our iOS SDK, so they capture events accurately with minimal impact on customer site and app performance.
  • Build and scale high-throughput APIs and microservices in TypeScript and Python that ingest, validate, and route event data from our customers' sites and apps.
  • Partner with the CAPI team to ingest server-side conversion events and deliver them reliably to ad platforms.
  • Own the reliability of these ingestion paths: load testing, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning.
  • Ship frontend features in React and TypeScript when a product experience needs them.
  • Scope projects with product managers, data scientists, and customer success, and help set technical direction for how Northbeam collects data.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building production software, with deep fullstack experience in TypeScript/JavaScript across frontend and backend.
  • Professional experience building services or APIs in Python, and comfort working across TypeScript and Python microservices in the same system.
  • A track record designing and scaling high-throughput APIs: you've handled request volume, latency, queuing, retries, and idempotency in production.
  • Hands-on experience with web analytics or event tracking: building tracking SDKs, pixels, or tag libraries, designing event schemas, and working within browser constraints like cookie restrictions and ad blockers.
  • Proficiency in SQL; experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse.
  • Startup instincts: you turn ambiguous product needs into sound architecture and ship production-ready code with minimal guidance.
  • Interest in mentoring other engineers and raising the bar for what the team ships.

Bonus Skills & Experience

  • iOS SDK development in Swift, or building SDKs that third-party developers install and depend on.
  • Familiarity with mobile attribution: mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit, and Apple's App Tracking Transparency.
  • Experience with server-side conversion APIs such as Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or the TikTok Events API.
  • Streaming or event pipeline experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar) on GCP or another major cloud.
  • Experience in marketing, e-commerce, or ad-tech.
Base Salary Range
$165,000—$210,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible!

What are we looking for?

You’re a QA Engineer, but not the kind who lurks in the shadows waiting to yell "bug!" at the worst possible moment. Instead, you are the one with the capital "E" - the one who cares about quality like a craft, not a checklist. You know perfection is a myth like 100% test coverage - but reliability, predictability, and confidence? Those are very real, and you’re here to make them happen.

You don’t just break things. You read the room of the system. You feel when something’s off before it explodes into a 3 a.m. incident that people need to wake up to fix. You ask the uncomfortable questions early - the ones that save everyone later, and the ones the code monkeys will totally hate. You see patterns forming where others just see "one weird possibly minor edge case."

You’re a collaborator, not a gatekeeper. You don’t lob tickets over the wall and disappear. You talk, you clarify, you trace problems back to their roots and help rip them out. When it’s time to be firm, you are - but you never hide behind process for the sake of process.

You like structure, but you’re not a robot. You know when a release needs a microscope, and when "good enough" is actually the right call for the product and those who build it.

At the end of the day, you make everyone and everything around you better. Engineers trust you. Product listens to you. And once you are done with what you do, fewer people get surprised in the morning.

What will you be doing?

  • Validate that what’s built is what the business actually asked for - not what development thought they asked for
  • Help assess release readiness, verification and risk
  • Validate bug fixes and new features before release
  • Identify edge cases, regressions, and integration issues
  • Collaborate closely with engineers during development
  • Provide clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps and context
  • Plan, execute, and document manual QA across applications
  • Test backend APIs and frontend user flows
  • Work with existing QAs and Developers to define and improve QA processes, standards, and checklists
  • Where needed, support and maintain your own automated test cases to reduce repetition
  • Conduct internal and external UATs
  • Query databases when required to support the execution of your manual tests
  • Continuously look for ways to reduce recurring issues and rework
  • Support & Communicate documentation within project management tools such as Jira and Notion

Requirements

What will you bring along?

  • 7+ years of experience in QA for web-based applications
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Excellent ability to manage and interpret product requirements
  • Experience in digital product QA, web apps, e-commerce, and similar.
  • Strong experience testing APIs (REST, JSON, HTTP concepts)
  • Experience testing modern frontend applications (React, HTTP, CSS, Vue, etc.)
  • Familiarity with test automation tools and frameworks
  • Comfortable working in agile / iterative environments
  • Experience working closely with product owners and engineers on technical products
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines from a QA perspective
  • Familiarity with iOS devices (Xcode simulator)
  • Basic knowledge of SQL
  • Experience designing test strategies or improving QA processes
  • Exposure to performance, security, integration and/or exploratory testing

We are always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits

How We Support Our Contractors

  • €38/hour + retention bonus scheme: Competitive contractor rate with a generous bonus paid every 6 months based on your time with us.
  • Top-Notch Workstation: We provide the latest MacBook, branded merchandise, and everything you need for an optimal work environment.
  • Global Co-Working Access: Work from a global network of co-working spaces to keep your work-life dynamic and flexible.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy full flexibility in work location and hours, supporting a work-life balance tailored to your needs.
  • Events and Gatherings: Participate in exciting events throughout the year, including team gatherings, cultural events, and other fun activities.

jobs.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote, US and EMEA preferred but not required

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to own how Fingerprint looks, feels, and works on the web. You’ll design and build fingerprint.com, communicating our vision of a fraud-free internet and showcasing Fingerprint’s device intelligence platform through clear, compelling experiences for developers and the teams evaluating our product.

We’ve formed a dedicated website engineering pod to raise the website to the level of the best product sites on the internet, and you’ll join it as the person who owns the overall look and feel. You’ll work alongside the pod’s design engineers and engineers, plus partners across Design, Marketing, and Growth, taking projects from early concepts through production. You’ll move between design tools like Figma and the browser, explore new visual directions, and build interactions that help people understand what Fingerprint can do.

This role leans toward design. We’re looking for exceptional taste and craft, paired with the engineering skills to implement your own designs directly in the browser with speed and attention to detail. You care about typography and layout as much as clean code and a performant, accessible experience. You’re naturally curious, you start things without waiting for a ticket, and you’re excited to use AI to explore designs rapidly. You’ll be given near-unlimited tokens to go crazy. You’ll help shape the website’s design system, propose improvements, and see your work through to launch and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the look and feel of fingerprint.com, designing and building core website experiences, including our homepage, product pages, pricing, and navigation, from initial exploration through responsive implementation and launch.
  • Turn technical product concepts into clear visual explanations and interactive demos that help developers understand and evaluate Fingerprint.
  • Refine typography, composition, motion, and interaction details to make the website feel distinctive and cohesive across devices.
  • Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and page patterns that connect our visual language to production code and help the team ship faster.
  • Build accessible, mobile-friendly, performant experiences that follow web best practices, working with the website pod on maintainable code, page speed, and consistent behavior across browsers.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Growth on product launches and website experiments, turning clear objectives into design concepts and production code.
  • Carry work through review, testing, and release, then use feedback and website data to improve usability and conversion.
  • Take initiative: contribute ideas proactively, share prototypes early, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between creative ambition, implementation effort, and delivery.
  • Find creative ways to use AI to ship high-quality work at speeds not possible with human-only input, such as machine-readable design specs, skills or internal tools, and evolve those workflows as the tools change.

Qualifications:

  • 6–10 years of related working experience designing and building for the web, with a track record of owning projects end to end as a hands-on individual contributor.
  • An active portfolio website and/or GitHub/social profile showing websites or interactive experiences that demonstrate exceptional design taste and production frontend development. We want to understand what you personally designed and built.
  • Strong visual and interaction design fundamentals, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and responsive layouts.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript skills, with experience building production websites using React and modern web frameworks like Astro.
  • Hands-on experience with canvas animations and shaders, and comfort prototyping motion and interactions directly in the browser.
  • Fluency in Figma and a habit of exploring ideas both in Figma and in code, using AI coding tools to iterate.
  • A practical understanding of web performance, accessibility, and browser behavior, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues in your own work.
  • Experience turning an open-ended brief into a finished experience, explaining design and technical decisions, and incorporating feedback from different disciplines.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate clearly in a distributed team, with care for both the quality of the result and the pace of delivery.
  • Experience using AI-first workflows to accelerate parts of the design process and enable other teammates to ship high-quality assets.
  • Preferred experience with , WebGL, motion.dev, and Blender or 3D animation
  • Technical B2B product experience highly preferred
  • Astro, interactive data visualization is a plus
  • Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom.

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and EMEA region and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $103,000 - $180,000 USD.

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

New York City: $150,000 - $180,000 USD

Chicago: $126,000 - $145,000 USD

United Kingdom/Ireland: $103,000 - $119,000 USD

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

Pindrop's Cloud Engineering teams build and operate infrastructure so reliable, automated, observable, and performant that product engineers can focus entirely on creating innovative, global solutions—without worrying about what's running underneath them.

We are a high-energy, deeply collaborative team with an unrelenting passion for reliability, scalability, and automation. If uptime, observability, and infrastructure-as-code are part of your personal belief system, you'll feel right at home on the Pindrop Cloud Engineering team.

Please note: We are hiring for this role in Ukraine and are seeking candidates who are currently based in Ukraine.

What you'll do

Who you are

  • You can understand systems end-to-end, become a subject matter expert, and confidently troubleshoot, configure, and improve platforms.
  • You make thoughtful, high-impact recommendations across automation, architecture, security, and maintainability.

  • You remain resilient, optimistic, and solution-oriented in the face of ambiguity and change.
  • You are adaptable, resourceful, and able to keep the big picture in mind while navigating details.

You have

  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, automated cloud systems across multiple regions and zones in AWS and GCP.
  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) and service mesh technologies.
  • Strong background in observability systems for monitoring, alerting, and performance analysis.

Your First 90 Days

  • Get set up with accounts, tools, and access.
  • Learn our products, services, workflows, and environments.
  • Understand team expectations and begin contributing to projects.

What We Offer

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

jobs.description:
SeniorProduct Manager, AI

Location: LatAm, Remote in Colombia

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI to lead end-to-end product delivery for complex GenAI and agentic AI engagements. This role demands deep AI fluency, hands-on prototyping ability, and the product judgment to navigate non-deterministic systems at enterprise scale. It is ideal for an experienced AI product leader who can own the full arc of an engagement — from framing the problem through shipping a production-grade agentic solution — while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

In this role, you will work as the primary product lead on a cross-functional AI delivery team, owning the roadmap, defining agent behavior, running evals, and guiding delivery from discovery through phased rollout. You'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineering on architecture decisions and the communication skills to frame AI tradeoffs clearly for executive audiences.

Why This Role Matters

Senior Product Managers, AI are how Robots and Pencils turns AI ambition into shipped agentic systems. On the engagements you lead, you own discovery and delivery end-to-end, define the agent behavior and evals that hold up in production, and keep the team focused on outcomes — not just features. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days; that pace holds only when someone owns the product like their own, stays close to both the user and the model, and surfaces the AI trade-offs — latency, cost, quality, safety — before they cost the result.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end product delivery for complex AI and agentic AI engagements, from discovery and hypothesis framing through phased rollout and production readiness
  • Define and maintain AI product roadmaps that connect agent capabilities to measurable enterprise business outcomes
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, stakeholder interviews, and assumption testing — framing the riskiest hypotheses first and de-risking them before committing to build
  • Design and run experiments including POCs, pilot deployments, and scenario-based testing of multi-step agentic workflows, edge cases, and failure recovery
  • Define agent behavior end-to-end including system prompts, tool schemas, context management, summarization, and working memory patterns across multi-step tasks
  • Own backlog management and sprint execution day-to-day on complex AI engagements — prioritizing work, refining agent behavior and requirements with engineering, and keeping the team moving.
  • Own and run evals frameworks covering task completion, reasoning quality, tool selection, failure recovery, and safety — iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions
  • Define success metrics at the agent level including task completion rate, cost per task, escalation rate, and time to resolution alongside business KPIs
  • Establish human-in-the-loop boundaries and guardrails — when the agent acts autonomously, when it escalates, and how to handle non-deterministic output
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot — and agentic frameworks where relevant — to move faster than traditional product

Collaboration & Communication

  • Lead stakeholder working sessions, prioritization discussions, and risk conversations with senior client stakeholders with confidence and clarity
  • Communicate complex AI tradeoffs, agent behavior, and product decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and serve as a reliable, consultative partner throughout the engagement

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead prioritization decisions by balancing business value, technical feasibility, cost, latency, and delivery timelines
  • Frame every request in terms of user and business outcomes, pushing back on feature-level thinking and managing AI hype cycles with realistic expectations
  • Begin mentoring junior AI PMs on the engagement, sharing knowledge on evals, agent design, and AI product delivery practices

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product management with hands-on experience shipping AI features or products
  • Ability to read code (Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript), evaluate architecture decisions, and make informed product tradeoffs on technical constraints
  • Deep understanding of AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems such as planning, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails, and evals
  • Proven ability to prototype AI and agentic solutions using modern AI tools to validate hypotheses and de-risk product decisions (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  • Experience running evals for AI systems and iterating based on results
  • Experience defining agent behavior including system prompts, tool schemas, and human-in-the-loop boundaries
  • Strong experience working with AWS AI services in a product context (e.g., Bedrock, Lambda, SageMaker, Kendra)
  • Strong client communication skills and the ability to frame AI capabilities and limitations for non-technical executive audiences
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the AI landscape evolves rapidly
  • Experience in a consulting or agency environment is a plus.
  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Strands) is a plus.
  • Software engineering background (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript) is a plus.

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Hands-on experience working with open-source LLMs, even in side projects or POCs.
  • Exposure to multi-modal AI (vision, voice, or document AI) beyond text-based agents.
  • Awareness of AI governance or responsible AI frameworks (privacy, safety, model usage policies).
  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.
  • Built for AI's messy reality. You expect non-determinism, you know the gap between a demo and a deployable system, and you'd rather kill a beautiful prototype than ship something that won't survive contact with real users.

  • Experience with C++, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize a modern, cloud-based marketing data platform that powers analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

The core objective of this role is to connect the marketing data platform to our existing unified and centralised business intelligence layer. Much of the work is about building bridges to existing models and layers, so we don’t reinvent the wheel each time. You will deliver high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability, and prepare marketing data structures for AI consumption, including machine learning and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

You are likely to be the only data engineer in the team to begin with. You will have peers to collaborate and share knowledge with, but they sit outside your immediate team (for example, the sister website team with front-end and back-end developers). You will work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.

Platforms

Our platform is currently built onGoogle Cloud (BigQuery), with Microsoft Fabric likely in the longer term. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on GCP and BigQuery, adapting to Azure/Fabric as our platform evolves.
  • Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured marketing and sales data (e.g., social media, organic, web, CRM, CMS, email).
  • Implement lakehouse/warehouse patterns and layered data modelling (e.g., medallion: bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs.
  • Build integrations and “bridges” between the marketing data platform and existing centralised BI models, avoiding duplicated logic and rework.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

  • Deliver model-ready, production-grade marketing datasets for analytics, ML, and optimization.
  • Structure data for AI consumption, including pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures.
  • Use ML lifecycle and catalog/governance tooling, with an emphasis on equivalent tooling for our platform (e.g., Vertex AI, Dataplex), or Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog where relevant.

Data Modelling, Orchestration & Automation

  • Design logical and physical data models focused on the marketing problem space, aligned with existing enterprise models.
  • Orchestrate workflows with tools such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, dbt, Dataform, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

  • Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns where they fit the use case.
  • Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using GCP Dataplex or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation).
  • Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

  • Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstreamand upstreamML and AI platforms.
  • Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

  • Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why.
  • Bring a growth mindset and a willingness to translate business needs into scope and tasks that achieve objectives.
  • Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.
  • Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

  • Strong Python and SQL.
  • Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
  • Experience designing data structures for AI consumption.
  • Experience working with marketing and sales data sources (e.g., social media, organic/SEO, web analytics, CRM, CMS, email platforms).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance.

Cloud & platforms (key requirement)

  • Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with BigQuery and the GCP data stack (e.g., Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataform, Cloud Composer).
  • Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure/Fabric), plus demonstrable openness and ability to work across clouds. Candidates with strong AWS or Azure/Fabric backgrounds (Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse) are encouraged to apply, provided they are keen to work on GCP and Fabric.

Architecture & systems thinking

  • Experience with modern warehouse/lakehouse architectures and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance.

Mindset

  • Keen interest or experience in the marketing problem space. You don’t need to be a marketer, but you should enjoy this part of the business and the challenge we are trying to solve.
  • Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable challenging business requirements rather than taking them at face value.
  • Adaptable and eager to work across platforms. Agile or consulting experience is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience withSalesforceandMarketodata integration.
  • Hands-on experience across more than one cloud, or cloud migration experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or Databricks.
  • GenAI and AI data systems (RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation).
  • CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
  • Streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), or ML/experimentation platforms.
  • Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

  • Private health insurance
    We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.

  • Education program
    We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.

  • Wellbeing program
    We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!

  • Free beverages
    Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.

  • Events
    We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.

  • Competitive conditions
    Besides a competitive salary and 24 days of vacation, you will join annual company events with the whole team.

  • Challenging projects
    Ready for a challenge? We guarantee you'll find challenging projects at Valtech!
  • Cool colleagues
    What's the most important thing in a job? Cool colleagues with whom you spent most of the time during the week. We have a lot of them!
  • Honest feedback
    Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

About the Role

We are hiring a Research Engineer to help train our next generation of large language models. You will design, run, and scale training experiments on thousands of GPUs, and turn research ideas into production-grade models.

You will join a small team of researchers and engineers who own the full model lifecycle: data, pre-training, post-training, and evaluation. Research and engineering are not separate here: you will write the code, run the experiments, and shape the conclusions.

Key Responsibilities – What You'll Do

  • Design and run large-scale pre-training and fine-tuning experiments, from small ablations to full training runs.

  • Study scaling laws to choose model size, data mix, and hyperparameters under a fixed compute budget.

  • Improve training efficiency through parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, FSDP), mixed precision, and custom CUDA or Triton kernels.

  • Diagnose and fix training instabilities such as loss spikes, divergence, and hardware failures.

  • Build and improve data pipelines, including filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, and dataset mixing.

  • Implement ideas from recent research papers and test whether they hold at scale.

  • Build evaluations that measure real model capabilities and track results rigorously.

  • Work closely with the alignment, infrastructure, and product teams, and share findings through clear write-ups.

Required Qualifications – What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience training deep learning models, or a PhD in a related field (computer science, mathematics, or physics).

  • Strong Python skills and deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX.

  • Practical experience with Transformer architectures, including attention, tokenization, embeddings, and positional encodings.

  • Experience with distributed training on multi-node GPU clusters (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, or similar).

  • Solid foundations in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and optimization.

  • Ability to read a research paper, implement it from scratch, and judge whether it works.

  • Rigorous experimental habits, including clean baselines, ablations, reproducible results, and experiment tracking.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Preferred Qualifications – Nice to Have

  • Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL) or well-known open-source contributions.

  • Experience pre-training an LLM from scratch, at any scale.

  • Post-training experience, including supervised fine-tuning, RLHF, DPO, or other preference-optimization methods.

  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to Mid-Market customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities, explain them to customers of all types, and measure success of desired business outcomes
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of experience in an Implementation Consultant, Customer Success manager, account management, customer onboarding, or strategic consulting role. Mid-Market SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Experience defining business outcomes, measuring success through clear metrics and KPIs, and establishing ROI
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Has strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Has experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
  • Is well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, networking, automation, or control systems
  • Has experience with integration projects — at minimum, able to comprehend RESTful APIs; experience with scripting languages like Python is a plus
  • Has IoT, hardware, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Has a background in Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations a plus
  • Is a resourceful self-starter who proactively troubleshoots and solves problems independently
  • Has practical experience using AI tools to build reports, automate tasks, or improve daily efficiency

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$66,261.36—$100,227.27 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
